2610.name: Chocobo Fly
2610.description: A freshwater fishing lure made from a chocobo feather. The faint aroma of stable hay brings back memories of a simpler time.

2611.description: A light plug lure made to resemble a minnow. Especially effective when used to land fish swimming close to the water's surface.

2612.description: A polished brass lure shaped like a spoon so it will oscillate when dragged through the water, attracting fish. Especially effective in lakes.

2614.description: A caddisfly-shaped lure crafted from a crow feather. Recommended for freshwater fly fishing novices.

2615.name: Silver Spoon Lure
2615.description: A polished silver lure shaped like a spoon so it will oscillate when dragged through the water, attracting fish. Especially effective in lakes.

2616.name: Steel Jig
2616.description: The weight of this steel lure allows for casting great distances, such as from coastlines.

2617.name: Sinking Minnow
2617.description: A heavy plug lure made to resemble a minnow. Effective in attracting fish from both surface and floor.

2618.name: Snurble Fly
2618.description: A freshwater fishing lure made from a snurble tuft.

2619.name: Heavy Steel Jig
2619.description: The sheer weight of this steel lure allows for casting tremendous distances, such as from coastlines.

2620.name: Spinner
2620.description: A metal river lure designed to resemble both a mayfly and a minnow, allowing for use in a variety of different situations.

2622.name: Mythril Spoon Lure
2622.description: A polished mythril lure shaped like a spoon so it will oscillate when dragged through the water, attracting all manner of lake and marsh life.

2623.name: Wildfowl Fly
2623.description: A freshwater lure made from a wildfowl feather. Its uncanny resemblance to a mayfly makes it irresistible to vilekin-feeding fish such as trout.

2624.name: Topwater Frog
2624.description: A light freshwater lure crafted to resemble a frog. Best suited for larger prey such as pikes and certain trout.

2625.name: Rainbow Spoon Lure
2625.description: A shiny blacklip oyster shell lure shaped like a spoon so it will oscillate when dragged through the water, attracting all manner of aquatic life. Especially effective in lakes.

2626.name: Spinnerbait
2626.description: Several small spinners joined together to resemble a school of fish. Especially effective in rivers.

2627.name: Streamer
2627.description: A freshwater fly designed to sink below the water's surface, and by doing so, attract the larger carnivorous fish living near the floor.

2628.name: Yumizuno
2628.description: A curved man-made lure used traditionally in the Far East, the name means literally “bow horn.” Increases chances of landing a big catch, even when casting from shore.

※Cannot be retrieved once used.
※Can be used up to 10 times.

Meal benefits when used:
  **VIT Bonus:** +4% (Max 3)
  **Gear Durability Bonus:** +1
  **EXP Bonus:** +3%
  **Duration:** 30m
  (Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

9330.name: Triple Cream Coffee
9330.description:
Freshly roasted ground coffee beans percolated to perfection and mixed with an equal amount of thick dairy cream.

**EXP Bonus:** +3% **Duration:** 30m
(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

9331.name: Bacon Bread
9331.description:
Soft dough mixed with thick-sliced bacon and twisted into a pattern resembling a sheaf of wheat.

**EXP Bonus:** +3% **Duration:** 30m
(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

9332.name: Flint Caviar
9332.description:
Salted eggs of the rare emperor fish. Often referred to as black diamonds, the eggs are a delicacy that can only be afforded by the wealthiest of connoisseurs.

**EXP Bonus:** +3% **Duration:** 30m
(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

9333.name: Shark Fin Soup
9333.description:
The massive fin of a megalodon, boiled in a rich Far Eastern broth until soft and gelatinous. While not included in the soup, the remainder of the sharkflesh is salted and dried until rock hard, then shaved into paper-thin slices which, when boiled in hot water, create a savory soup that is the base of countless other recipes.

**EXP Bonus:** +3% **Duration:** 30m
(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

9334.name: Haddock Dip
9334.description:
A thick salty dip made from a purée of haddock, raw egg, and mashed popotoes. A favorite of Roegadyn tribes hailing from the north seas.

**EXP Bonus:** +3% **Duration:** 30m
(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

9335.name: Bacon Broth
9335.description:
Though technically a soup, this Ixali dish consists mainly of large slabs of smoked bacon boiled with several other lesser ingredients.

**EXP Bonus:** +3% **Duration:** 30m
(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

9628.description: A complex blend of cereals and leafy greens believed to improve a race chocobo's stamina.

9718.name: Longcase Chronometer
9718.description: A precision instrument for telling time. Its towering silhouette adds a touch of gravitas to the ambience of any room.

9719.name: Oriental Bathtub
9719.description: A large bathtub designed in the Doman fashion.

9722.name: Kotatsu Table
9722.description: A table designed in the Doman fashion. The underside has been treated with strange Eastern magicks to emit heat during the winter months.

9723.name: Wax Vegetables
9723.description: While far less nutritious than real vegetables, these wax replicas will look nicer in your pantry.

9724.name: Guildleve Counter
9724.description: A counter designed to replicate those found in Adventurers' Guilds across Eorzea. This model comes complete with a built-in light that can be used to illuminate leve plates.

9726.name: Glade Tea Set
9726.description:
For the denizens of the Twelveswood, the consumption of tea is a means of relaxing the mind, allowing for uninhibited communion with nature.

※Cannot be retrieved once used.
※Can be used up to 10 times.

Meal benefits when used:
  **Spell Speed Bonus:** +4% (Max 12)
  **VIT Bonus:** +4% (Max 7)
  **Gear Durability Bonus:** +2
  **EXP Bonus:** +3%
  **Duration:** 30m
  (Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

9727.name: Riviera Supper
9727.description:
While for most La Nosceans supper consists of huddling around a fire pit while sopping up a splash of rancid fish stew with a hunk of moldy bread, those who have found their fortune on the seas prefer a multiple-course extravaganza certain to leave even the most wealthy Ul'dahn speechless.

※Cannot be retrieved once used.
※Can be used up to 10 times.

Meal benefits when used:
  **Determination Bonus:** +4% (Max 4)
  **VIT Bonus:** +4% (Max 5)
  **Gear Durability Bonus:** +2
  **EXP Bonus:** +3%
  **Duration:** 30m
  (Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

9728.name: Oasis Breakfast
9728.description:
Considered the most important of the day's seven meals (preceding both pre-midday mead and eleventh bell tarts), the Ul'dahn elite rarely miss this opportunity to gorge themselves before moving on to the next opportunity to gorge themselves.

※Cannot be retrieved once used.
※Can be used up to 10 times.

Meal benefits when used:
  **Critical Hit Bonus:** +4% (Max 21)
  **VIT Bonus:** +4% (Max 13)
  **Gear Durability Bonus:** +3
  **EXP Bonus:** +3%
  **Duration:** 30m
  (Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

9730.name: Oriental Altar
9730.description: A miniature wooden altar hung in Doman houses, allowing people to worship the gods within the privacy of their own homes.

9733.name: Dead Man's Chest
9733.description: “If the *man* who once owned the *chest* is now *dead*, he won't mind anyone else using it.” Such was the logic employed when removing this sturdy treasure coffer from Sastasha.

9734.name: Oak Low Barrel Planter
9734.description: A barrel planter crafted from oak.

9735.name: Valentione's Cake
9735.description:
A decadent chocolate cake emblazoned with the House Valentione coat of arms.

※Cannot be retrieved once used.
※Can be used up to 10 times.

Meal benefits when used:
  **VIT Bonus:** +4% (Max 18)
  **Gear Durability Bonus:** +2
  **EXP Bonus:** +3%
  **Duration:** 30m
  (Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

9736.name: Royal Partition
9736.description: A luxurious partition designed to resemble those used in the sultana's palace.

9737.name: Order of Nald'thal Lectern
9737.description: A carved wooden podium not unlike the ones used by the Order of Nald'thal to deliver their sermons.

9738.name: Green Tea Set
9738.description:
Far more bitter than its black counterpart, green tea is by far the beverage of choice in Far Eastern Doma. To offset the sharpness of its flavor, it is oft accompanied by something sweet, such as sticky rice cakes.

※Cannot be retrieved once used.
※Can be used up to 10 times.

Meal benefits when used:
  **VIT Bonus:** +4% (Max 13)
  **Gear Durability Bonus:** +2
  **EXP Bonus:** +3%
  **Duration:** 30m
  (Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

9739.name: Dried Well
9739.description: Have you dreamed of owning your very own well, but are plagued by one or more of the following psychological ailments: acrophobia, claustrophobia, aquaphobia, bathophobia, or cleithrophobia? Well fear no longer. This quality stone well, manufactured in Eorzea with 100% Eorzean materials, requires no hole to be dug, no ground to be sanctified, and no chain letters to be passed along to your dearest enemies.

9740.name: Oriental Striking Dummy
9740.description:
A striking dummy designed in the Doman fashion.

※Up to three dummies may be placed in a single estate, regardless of type.

9744.name: Wild Banana Tree
9744.description: A green, leafy tree transplanted from an island in the Cieldalaes. The word “banana” is actually a bastardization of “pamama,” the term used in the fruit's native habitat.

9745.name: Personal Astroscope
9745.description: A miniature astroscope used by aspiring astrologians to peer into the farthest reaches of the firmament.

9746.name: Riviera Garden Table Set
9746.description: A round outdoor table and matching chairs designed in the riviera fashion.

9748.name: Retainer Cartonnier
9748.description:
A wooden receptacle for use by retainers to store goods entrusted for sale while protecting them from the elements.
※Can only be placed outdoors.

9749.name: Retainer Counter
9749.description:
A wooden counter for use by retainers.
※Can only be placed outdoors.

9766.name: Spotted Interior Wall
9766.description: An interior wall bespeckled with a hypnotically random pattern of colorful dots certain to drive any sane man to his wit's end.

9767.name: Wavy Interior Wall
9767.description: An interior wall covered from top to bottom in colorful wavy lines certain to induce seasickness in even the most hardened sailor.

9768.name: Tatami Flooring
9768.description: Woven from sweet-smelling rush grass, tatami flooring is the perfect complement to any home furnished in the Doman fashion.

9769.name: Monochrome Flooring
9769.description: Marble floor tiling alternately colored black and white.

9770.name: Oasis Cobble Flooring
9770.description: Cobbles commonly used in Ul'dahn roadways and plazas.

9771.name: Star Chandelier
9771.description: Ceiling-mounted lighting expertly crafted to resemble the moon and stars.

10071.name: Model Magitek Bit
10071.description:
An exact 1:9 scale replica of a ceruleum-powered magitek bit (Ultima Weapon action figure not included).

Use item to acquire the model magitek bit minion.

10086.name: Tinker's Calm
10086.description:
A tonic commonly used by Disciples of the Hand to increase focus, allowing for enhanced results when deconstructing complex creations.

**Duration:** 10m

10100.name: Petrified Orb
10100.description: A perfect sphere carved from a petrified tree and polished to enhance its natural luster.

10101.name: Mummer's Daggers
10101.description: A decorated pair of knives used by mummers in their traveling grotesqueries. The blades have been dulled to prevent injury.

10102.name: Lapdog Collar Bell
10102.description: A tiny copper bell commonly affixed to the collars of Ul'dahn lapdogs to inform owners the location of their precious pets.

10103.name: Fluorite Lens
10103.description: Carved from a shard of clear fluorite, this lens exhibits higher optical performance than a normal glass lens.

10104.name: Patent Leather
10104.description: Saurian leather that has been treated with linseed oil to give it a glossy black finish.

10105.name: Camlet
10105.description: An expensive fabric woven from camel hair. Imitations are common, though this piece appears to be legitimate.

10106.name: Enchanted Quicksilver
10106.description: This sample of hydrargyrum has been imbued with powerful magicks.

10107.name: Duck Broth
10107.description: While this broth can be made by simply boiling down the bones of a duck, true culinarians make it a point to brown the bones before adding them to a mixture of savory vegetables and fresh spring water.

10332.name: Battered Fish
10332.description:
Deep-fried and accompanied by a generous portion of thick cut popotoes. Most delicious when sprinkled with a dash of malt vinegar.

**EXP Bonus:** +3% **Duration:** 30m
(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

10346.name: Stained Crystal Interior Wall
10346.description: An interior wall fitted with countless colorful stained crystal panels.

10349.name: Magnificent Mogdelier
10349.description: Marvelously majestic lighting worthy of a moogle king.

10350.name: Hive Ceiling Fan
10350.description:
A ceiling-mounted fan created with the wings of the Gnathic primal Ravana.

※One per estate only.

10351.name: Deep Hive Ceiling Fan
10351.description:
A ceiling-mounted fan created with the wings of the Gnathic primal Ravana. It literally hums with the Lord of the Hive's untamed power.

※One per estate only.

10373.name: Magitek Repair Materials
10373.description: Various materials used in the repair and maintenance of large-hulled airships and submersibles.

10942.name: Astral Silk Dress Gloves of Casting

12051.name: Atrophied Atomos
12051.description:
Putting money where this voidsent's mouth is merely results in devoured money.

Use item to acquire the atrophied Atomos minion.

12055.name: Clockwork Barrow
12055.description:
Take a load off your shoulders. You deserve it.

Use item to acquire the clockwork barrow minion.

12058.name: Iron Dwarf
12058.description:
He prefers the term “little iron person.”

Use item to acquire the iron dwarf minion.

12062.name: Steam-powered Gobwalker G-VII
12062.description:
Gobwalker exhaust can be used to steam hams.

Use item to acquire the steam-powered gobwalker G-VII minion.

12081.name: Highland Barding
12081.description: A suit of chocobo armor outfitted with multiple layers of leather and fur to protect its wearer from the elements.

12082.name: Expanse Barding
12082.description: A suit of chocobo armor designed to resemble Bismarck, the Lord of the Mists.

12083.name: Hive Barding
12083.description: A suit of chocobo armor designed to resemble Ravana, the Lord of the Hive.

12084.name: Alpine Chair
12084.description: A simple chair designed in the alpine style.

12085.name: Alpine Round Table
12085.description: A round table designed in the alpine fashion. Will seat twelve, but with some difficulty.

12086.name: Alpine Tea Set
12086.description:
Add an air of nobility to your residence with this set of antique pewter.

※Cannot be retrieved once used.
※Can be used up to 10 times.

Meal benefits when used:
  **Piety Bonus:** +4% (Max 19)
  **VIT Bonus:** +4% (Max 26)
  **Gear Durability Bonus:** +3
  **EXP Bonus:** +3%
  **Duration:** 30m
  (Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

12087.name: Stuffed Carbuncle
12087.description: The right paw of this plush Carbuncle is raised to beckon fortune into a household or place of commerce. Effectiveness varies.

12088.name: Oriental Breakfast
12088.description:
The Domans break their fast with a simple, yet balanced meal consisting of rice and several small side dishes.

※Cannot be retrieved once used.
※Can be used up to 10 times.

Meal benefits when used:
  **Skill Speed Bonus:** +4% (Max 28)
  **VIT Bonus:** +4% (Max 26)
  **Gear Durability Bonus:** +3
  **EXP Bonus:** +3%
  **Duration:** 30m
  (Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

12089.name: Nameday Cake
12089.description:
While not common amongst the poorer classes, many Eorzean highborn practice the custom of decorating a cake for family members celebrating their namedays.

※Cannot be retrieved once used.
※Can be used up to 10 times.

Meal benefits when used:
  **Spell Speed Bonus:** +4% (Max 28)
  **VIT Bonus:** +4% (Max 26)
  **Gear Durability Bonus:** +3
  **EXP Bonus:** +3%
  **Duration:** 30m
  (Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

12090.name: Cake Tray
12090.description:
A multi-tiered tray stacked with several varieties of luscious sweetcakes and tarts.

※Cannot be retrieved once used.
※Can be used up to 10 times.

Meal benefits when used:
  **Direct Hit Bonus:** +4% (Max 28)
  **VIT Bonus:** +4% (Max 26)
  **Gear Durability Bonus:** +3
  **EXP Bonus:** +3%
  **Duration:** 30m
  (Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

12091.name: Oriental Supper
12091.description:
Rather than large portions of one or two dishes, Doman suppers consist of one or two bites of several painstakingly prepared culinary creations served with a bowl of steamed rice.

※Cannot be retrieved once used.
※Can be used up to 10 times.

Meal benefits when used:
  **Determination Bonus:** +4% (Max 19)
  **VIT Bonus:** +4% (Max 26)
  **Gear Durability Bonus:** +3
  **EXP Bonus:** +3%
  **Duration:** 30m
  (Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

12092.name: Riviera Lunch
12092.description:
A freshly prepared lunch, complete with portions large enough to satisfy the meanest of appetites.

※Cannot be retrieved once used.
※Can be used up to 10 times.

Meal benefits when used:
  **Tenacity Bonus:** +4% (Max 28)
  **VIT Bonus:** +4% (Max 26)
  **Gear Durability Bonus:** +3
  **EXP Bonus:** +3%
  **Duration:** 30m
  (Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

12094.name: Toy Box
12094.description:
A toy box that is opened by sliding several interlocking pieces of wood.

※One per estate only.

12095.name: Glade Half Partition
12095.description: A partition designed in the glade fashion, but reaching only less than halfway to the ceiling so as to provide privacy without making the room feel smaller.

12096.name: Oasis Half Partition
12096.description: A partition designed in the oasis fashion, but reaching only less than halfway to the ceiling so as to provide privacy without making the room feel smaller.

12097.name: Cask Rack
12097.description: A rack allowing for the horizontal storage of multiple ale kegs or wine barrels.

12098.name: Display Stand
12098.description: A cylindrical stand designed for displaying various objets d'art and spoils of war.

12100.name: Royal Plotting Table
12100.description: A replica of the table used in the Ul'dahn royal war room to conceive and confirm battle strategies.

12101.name: Round Banquet Table
12101.description: A large round table suitable for banquets, reunions, bacchanals, and other manner of large-scale social gatherings. Easily sits twelve to thirteen knights.

12103.name: Bearskin Rug
12103.description: For maximum romantic effect, place rug directly in front of a fireplace, light a few candles, and crack open a bottle of aged Ishgardian brandy.

12104.name: Gordian Bureau
12104.description:
A writing desk crafted from gears found inside the right arm of the mechanical fortress Alexander.

※One per estate only.

12105.name: Savage Gordian Bureau
12105.description:
A writing desk crafted from gears found inside the right arm of the mechanical fortress Alexander. Magicks imbued within the furnishing cause the bureau to emit a soft glow that, while no one can see, all believe is there.

※One per estate only.

12106.name: Gordian Chair
12106.description:
A chair crafted from gears found within the right arm of the mechanical fortress Alexander.

※One per estate only.

12107.name: Savage Gordian Chair
12107.description:
A chair crafted from gears found within the right arm of the mechanical fortress Alexander. Magicks imbued within the furnishing have been known to stimulate the backsides of those who sit on it for any extended period of time.

※One per estate only.

12108.name: Star Sapphire Music Box
12108.description: This expertly crafted music box plays only one half of a melody. Pair with a star ruby music box to complete the song.

12109.name: Star Ruby Music Box
12109.description: This expertly crafted music box plays only one half of a melody. Pair with a star sapphire music box to complete the song.

12111.name: Expanse Fountain
12111.description:
An outdoor fountain created from the baleen of Bismarck, Lord of the Mists.

※One per estate only.

12112.name: Boundless Expanse Fountain
12112.description:
An outdoor fountain practically pulsing with magicks created from the baleen of Bismarck, Lord of the Mists.

※One per estate only.

12113.name: Topiary Moogle
12113.description: A specially bred shrub pruned to the shape of a merry moogle.

12114.name: Standing Signboard
12114.description: A V-shaped sign used by shop owners to inform passersby of items on sale within.

12115.name: Laundry Pole
12115.description: A long pole upon which wet laundry is hung to dry in the sun. Take care when drying smallclothes, for the realm is rife with codpiece thieves.

12214.name: Grade 1 Wheel of Recreation
12214.description: A cylindrical wheel crafted from metal and aspected crystal which, when placed on a stand and spun repeatedly, accumulates an aetherial charge. When fully primed, the wheel can be used to initiate the company action Jackpot (increased MGP payout at the Manderville Gold Saucer).

12231.name: Farreach Canvas
12231.description: Originally conceived by inhabitants of the sparsely settled Farreach to withstand the gale-force winds ceaselessly blowing on the Bloodbrine Sea, this rugged sailcloth is one of few materials suited to air travel.

12232.name: Cassia Lumber
12232.description: Processed cassia lumber. Even with its bark removed, the wood still harbors a faint sweet scent.

12233.name: High Allagan Chimera Leather
12233.description: A large piece of specially treated chimerical leather used by the Allagan Empire to craft high armor.

12234.name: Lupin Plot
12234.description:
Each plant will produce a “stalk” of violet flowers more than a fulm tall.

※Up to ten flower plots may be placed in a single garden, regardless of type.

12235.name: Explorer's Campfire
12235.description: All the essential culinary tools─camp stove, iron pot, and stump settle─for dining on the wild side.

12518.name: Mythrite Nugget
12518.description: A small nugget of impure mythrite.

12520.name: Hardsilver Nugget
12520.description: A small nugget of impure hardsilver.

12522.name: Aurum Regis Nugget
12522.description: A small nugget of impure aurum regis.

12523.name: Aurum Regis Ingot
12523.description: An ingot of smelted aurum regis.

12524.name: Titanium Nugget
12524.description: A small nugget of impure titanium.

12526.name: Adamantite Nugget
12526.description: A small nugget of impure adamantite.

12528.name: Mythrite Rivets
12528.description: Short mythrite pins with large heads. Used in connecting metal plates.

12529.name: Titanium Rivets
12529.description: Short titanium pins with large heads. Used in connecting metal plates.

12530.name: Adamantite Rivets
12530.description: Short adamantite pins with large heads. Used in connecting metal plates.

12542.name: Tiger's Eye
12542.description: A golden brown jewel consisting of many colored layers. When polished, it resembles the eye of a tiger─a legendary beast believed to be the ancestor of the coeurl.

12543.name: Agate
12543.description: A cloudy pink jewel consisting of many colored layers.

12544.name: Star Ruby
12544.description: A red jewel that has been shaped and polished instead of faceted, creating the illusion of a six-pointed star within the stone.

12545.name: Star Sapphire
12545.description: A blue jewel that has been shaped and polished instead of faceted, creating the illusion of a six-pointed star within the stone.

12546.name: Opal
12546.description: A milky white jewel that, depending on the angle at which it is held, will exhibit a rainbow of color within the stone.

12547.name: Citrine
12547.description: A yellow jewel almost identical to topaz, but several times softer.

12550.name: Carnelian
12550.description: A translucent red jewel. Its relative softness makes it easy to carve, and it has been used by royalty throughout history for signet rings.

12561.name: Cloud Mica Whetstone
12561.description: A whetstone carved from cloud mica. Used for sharpening metal or stone blades.

12562.name: Archaeornis Leather
12562.description: A large piece of cured archaeornis skin.

12563.name: Wyvern Leather
12563.description: A large piece of cured wyvern skin.

12564.name: Dhalmel Leather
12564.description: A large piece of cured dhalmel hide.

12565.name: Dragon Leather
12565.description: A large piece of cured dragon skin.

12566.name: Amphiptere Leather
12566.description: A large piece of cured amphiptere skin.

12567.name: Griffin Leather
12567.description: A large piece of cured griffin hide.

12580.name: Holy Cedar Lumber
12580.description: Processed cedar lumber purified with holy water.

12582.name: Hallowed Chestnut Lumber
12582.description: Processed dark chestnut lumber purified with hallowed water.

12584.name: Astral Birch Lumber
12584.description: Processed birch lumber treated so that its elemental aspect tips towards astral.

12588.name: Rainbow Cloth
12588.description: Several yalms of undyed rainbow cloth wrapped around a short wooden distaff.

12589.name: Holy Rainbow Cloth
12589.description: Several yalms of rainbow cloth purified with holy water and wrapped around a short wooden distaff.

12590.name: Ramie Cloth
12590.description: Several yalms of undyed ramie cloth wrapped around a short wooden distaff.

12591.name: Hallowed Ramie Cloth
12591.description: Several yalms of ramie cloth purified with holy water and wrapped around a short wooden distaff.

12592.name: Chimerical Felt
12592.description: Several yalms of soft undyed felt created by matting down several layers of hair taken from chimera manes.

12593.name: Astral Silk
12593.description: Several yalms of silk treated so that its elemental aspect would tip slightly towards astral.

12594.name: Rainbow Thread
12594.description: Multicolored yarn spun from rainbow cotton.

12595.name: Ramie Thread
12595.description: Strong, absorbent yarn spun from ramie.

12596.name: Crawler Silk
12596.description: Silk gathered from crawler cocoons and spun into a thin lustrous thread.

12601.name: Enchanted Mythrite Ink
12601.description: Ink fortified with mythrite sand to improve aetherial conductivity.

12602.name: Enchanted Hardsilver Ink
12602.description: Ink fortified with hardsilver sand to improve aetherial conductivity.

12603.name: Enchanted Aurum Regis Ink
12603.description: Ink fortified with aurum regis sand to improve aetherial conductivity.

12604.name: Holy Water
12604.description: Water blessed by an anointed Halonic Orthodox priest. Used to exorcise most evil spirits from worldly items.

12605.name: Hallowed Water
12605.description: Water blessed by an anointed Halonic Orthodox priest. Used to exorcise evil spirits from worldly items.

12606.name: Astral Oil
12606.description: Refined oil with an unbalanced elemental aspect tipping towards astral.

12607.name: Growth Formula Epsilon
12607.description: This alchemically formulated potation accelerates the growth of foliage.

12608.name: Growth Formula Zeta
12608.description: This alchemically formulated potation accelerates the growth of foliage.

12610.name: Crystal Glass
12610.description: This exceptionally transparent glass does not actually contain any crystal, but earns its name for being as clear as crystallized aether.

12611.name: Black Firesand
12611.description: A higher concentration of saltpeter makes this flammable powder slightly more explosive than normal firesand.

12612.name: Grade 1 Strength Dissolvent
12612.description: When applied to items such as battle gear, this alchemical liquid will dissolve away minute amounts of aether aspected to elements detrimental to strength, and by doing so, better attune the item and its wearer to the remaining beneficial elements.

12613.name: Grade 1 Dexterity Dissolvent
12613.description: When applied to items such as battle gear, this alchemical liquid will dissolve away minute amounts of aether aspected to elements detrimental to dexterity, and by doing so, better attune the item and its wearer to the remaining beneficial elements.

12614.name: Grade 1 Vitality Dissolvent
12614.description: When applied to items such as battle gear, this alchemical liquid will dissolve away minute amounts of aether aspected to elements detrimental to vitality, and by doing so, better attune the item and its wearer to the remaining beneficial elements.

12615.name: Grade 1 Intelligence Dissolvent
12615.description: When applied to items such as battle gear, this alchemical liquid will dissolve away minute amounts of aether aspected to elements detrimental to intelligence, and by doing so, better attune the item and its wearer to the remaining beneficial elements.

12616.name: Grade 1 Mind Dissolvent
12616.description: When applied to items such as battle gear, this alchemical liquid will dissolve away minute amounts of aether aspected to elements detrimental to mind, and by doing so, better attune the item and its wearer to the remaining beneficial elements.

12617.name: Grade 2 Strength Dissolvent
12617.description: When applied to items such as battle gear, this alchemical liquid will dissolve away minute amounts of aether aspected to elements detrimental to strength, and by doing so, better attune the item and its wearer to the remaining beneficial elements.

12618.name: Grade 2 Dexterity Dissolvent
12618.description: When applied to items such as battle gear, this alchemical liquid will dissolve away minute amounts of aether aspected to elements detrimental to dexterity, and by doing so, better attune the item and its wearer to the remaining beneficial elements.

12619.name: Grade 2 Vitality Dissolvent
12619.description: When applied to items such as battle gear, this alchemical liquid will dissolve away minute amounts of aether aspected to elements detrimental to vitality, and by doing so, better attune the item and its wearer to the remaining beneficial elements.

12620.name: Grade 2 Intelligence Dissolvent
12620.description: When applied to items such as battle gear, this alchemical liquid will dissolve away minute amounts of aether aspected to elements detrimental to intelligence, and by doing so, better attune the item and its wearer to the remaining beneficial elements.

12621.name: Grade 2 Mind Dissolvent
12621.description: When applied to items such as battle gear, this alchemical liquid will dissolve away minute amounts of aether aspected to elements detrimental to mind, and by doing so, better attune the item and its wearer to the remaining beneficial elements.

12622.name: Draconian Potion of Strength
12622.description:
This intoxicating concoction brewed from an ancient dragon recipe temporarily increases strength.

**Duration:** 15s

12623.name: Draconian Potion of Dexterity
12623.description:
This intoxicating concoction brewed from an ancient dragon recipe temporarily increases dexterity.

**Duration:** 15s

12624.name: Draconian Potion of Vitality
12624.description:
This intoxicating concoction brewed from an ancient dragon recipe temporarily increases vitality.

**Duration:** 15s

12625.name: Draconian Potion of Intelligence
12625.description:
This intoxicating concoction brewed from an ancient dragon recipe temporarily increases intelligence.

**Duration:** 15s

12626.name: Draconian Potion of Mind
12626.description:
This intoxicating concoction brewed from an ancient dragon recipe temporarily increases mind.

**Duration:** 15s

12644.name: Aurum Regis Cylinder
12644.description: This small music box cylinder is studded with myriad pins arranged in a queer pattern. When placed in a music box and attached to the motor, the cylinder will rotate, causing the pins to strike the box's comb, creating music.

12706.name: Goblin Jig
12706.description: A metal lure designed by goblin fishers to vibrate rapidly, thus making it more appealing to hungry fish.

12707.name: Bladed Steel Jig
12707.description: An all-purpose fishing lure crafted by combining three smaller lures.

12842.name: Ishgardian Tea
12842.description:
Rather than adding milk to boiling water that has been infused with tea leaves, as is the fashion in lower Eorzea, Ishgardian tea is brewed by boiling yak milk and letting dried Coerthan tea leaves steep right into the hot liquid.

**EXP Bonus:** +3% **Duration:** 30m
(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

12843.name: Frozen Spirits
12843.description:
A cool concoction made by fermenting cloud bananas and Old World figs, freezing them with ice crystals, then mashing and mixing the fruit into a slush-like consistency.

**EXP Bonus:** +3% **Duration:** 30m
(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

12844.name: Hot Chocolate
12844.description:
A sweet beverage commonly drunk in the Holy See, but rarely seen in Foundation due to inability of most of Ishgard's poorer residents to procure the relatively rare and expensive ingredients.

**EXP Bonus:** +3% **Duration:** 30m
(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

12845.name: Fig Bavarois
12845.description:
A ripe Old World fig encased in a lightly sweetened jelly.

**EXP Bonus:** +3% **Duration:** 30m
(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

12846.name: Sohm Al Tart
12846.description:
A traditional Ishgardian cake made up of several stacked layers tapered to resemble Sohm Al, a peak sacred to the Dravanians. Ishgardians believe that devouring the mountain will grant them fortune in their struggle with the dragons.

**EXP Bonus:** +3% **Duration:** 30m
(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

12847.name: Marron Glace
12847.description:
Chestnuts peeled and soaked in honey for several moons until the entire fruit is permeated with sweetness.

**EXP Bonus:** +3% **Duration:** 30m
(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

12848.name: Creme Brulee
12848.description:
A vanilla-flavored egg custard drenched in a sweet syrup that is then heated with a fire crystal until a crisp brown shell is created.

**EXP Bonus:** +3% **Duration:** 30m
(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

12849.name: Kaiser Roll
12849.description:
A round Ishgardian bread first made by Halonic monastics who, when brewing ale, would add barm and leftover malt to their daily loaves.

**EXP Bonus:** +3% **Duration:** 30m
(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

12850.name: Ishgardian Muffin
12850.description:
Leavened bread that is cooked on a griddle rather than in an oven. Cornmeal is dusted on the dough before cooking to prevent sticking to the pan.

**EXP Bonus:** +3% **Duration:** 30m
(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

12851.name: Liver-cheese Sandwich
12851.description:
Several slices of a ground liver loaf sandwiched between two halves of a kaiser roll.

**EXP Bonus:** +3% **Duration:** 30m
(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

12852.name: Almond Cream Croissant
12852.description:
A flaky crescent-shaped pastry sliced in two and buttered with a sweet creamy paste made from almonds.

**EXP Bonus:** +3% **Duration:** 30m
(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

12853.name: Sauteed Porcini
12853.description:
Fragrant porcini mushrooms sliced and sautéed in butter. Simple, yet elegant.

**EXP Bonus:** +3% **Duration:** 30m
(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

12854.name: Morel Salad
12854.description:
A fresh green salad topped with sautéed morels.

**EXP Bonus:** +3% **Duration:** 30m
(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

12855.name: Grilled Sweetfish
12855.description:
A simple dish created by piercing a lightly salted fresh sweetfish with a sharpened stick and slowly roasting it over an open flame.

**EXP Bonus:** +3% **Duration:** 30m
(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

12856.name: Baked Pipira Pira
12856.description:
A plump pipira pira wrapped with butter and porcini mushrooms and baked in an oven, the steam trapped in the leaf slowly cooking the fish to the perfect flakiness.

**EXP Bonus:** +3% **Duration:** 30m
(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

12857.name: Urchin Loaf
12857.description:
Sea urchin corals mixed with mushrooms and herbs into a paste that is then placed back into the urchin shell and baked until hard.

**EXP Bonus:** +3% **Duration:** 30m
(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

12858.name: Cockatrice Meatballs
12858.description:
Ground lean cockatrice meat hand rolled into bite-sized balls and fried in oil.

**EXP Bonus:** +3% **Duration:** 30m
(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

12859.name: Royal Eggs
12859.description:
A breakfast dish consisting of an Ishgardian muffin sliced into halves and topped with salmon, a poached egg, and a creamy yellow sauce made from butter and egg yolks.

**EXP Bonus:** +3% **Duration:** 30m
(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

12860.name: Deep-fried Okeanis
12860.description:
Thinly sliced okeanis fried in oil.

**EXP Bonus:** +3% **Duration:** 30m
(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

12861.name: Baked Onion Soup
12861.description:
A hearty bouillon soup filled with sweet onions, covered with shredded cheese and baked in an oven until golden brown.

**EXP Bonus:** +3% **Duration:** 30m
(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

12862.name: Beet Soup
12862.description:
Sliced magma beets and lean loaghtan meat slow-cooked with vegetables and served with a dollop of rich sour cream. A dish popular throughout Ishgard, though families in the Brume often use the meat of animals easier to find in the district's dark back alleys.

**EXP Bonus:** +3% **Duration:** 30m
(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

12863.name: Emerald Soup
12863.description:
A bright-green soup made by cooking down emerald beans until they break down into a ghastly paste. Despised by children both high- and lowborn.

**EXP Bonus:** +3% **Duration:** 30m
(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

12864.name: Clam Chowder
12864.description:
A milk-based soup made with various shellfish, but most often clams.

**EXP Bonus:** +3% **Duration:** 30m
(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

12865.name: Seafood Stew
12865.description:
A simple stew made from available seafood boiled with tomatoes and spices.

**EXP Bonus:** +3% **Duration:** 30m
(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

12866.name: Stuffed Cabbage Rolls
12866.description:
Ground meat rolled in cabbage and boiled in broth.

**EXP Bonus:** +3% **Duration:** 30m
(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

12867.name: Dhalmel Gratin
12867.description:
Several layers of thinly sliced dhalmel meat and vegetables covered in a creamy white sauce and baked.

**EXP Bonus:** +3% **Duration:** 30m
(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

12868.name: Stuffed Chysahl
12868.description:
Ground okeanis stuffed into a large chysahl head and sprinkled with fresh chives.

**EXP Bonus:** +3% **Duration:** 30m
(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

12869.name: Dhalmel Fricassee
12869.description:
Chopped and braised dhalmel meat cooked in a white stew.

**EXP Bonus:** +3% **Duration:** 30m
(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

12870.name: Snurbleberry Tart
12870.description:
A colorful tart made with blood red snurbleberries.

**EXP Bonus:** +3% **Duration:** 30m
(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

12881.name: Highland Flour
12881.description: Finely milled highland wheat. It has a rich, earthy aroma.

12890.name: Hollandaise Sauce
12890.description: A rich sauce created with butter, egg yolks, and a hint of lemon.

12892.name: Birch Syrup
12892.description: Birch sap boiled down to a thick, sweet syrup.

12894.name: Sour Cream
12894.description: A thick cream created by fermenting yak milk.

12895.name: Fermented Butter
12895.description: Slightly pungent butter allowed to ferment for several days after churning.

12908.name: Vermicelli
12908.description: Thin noodles made with highland flour, eggs, water, and salt. These have been dried and will keep indefinitely.

12912.name: Celestine
12912.description: A light-blue crystalline mineral which, when ground and added to any flammable material, will cause it to burn red.

12913.name: Garlond Steel
12913.description: A lightweight form of steel developed by the eponymous chief engineer of the Garlond Ironworks.

12914.name: Deep-red Enchanted Ink
12914.description: Fortifying ink with powder created by grinding down multi-aspected crystals has been found to improve aetherial conductivity several times more than ink fortified with common metals.

12915.name: Superior Deep-red Enchanted Ink
12915.description: Fortifying ink with powder created by grinding down multi-aspected crystals has been found to improve aetherial conductivity several times more than ink fortified with common metals. The concentration of this bottle's contents appears to be remarkably high.

12916.name: Deep-green Enchanted Ink
12916.description: Fortifying ink with powder created by grinding down multi-aspected crystals has been found to improve aetherial conductivity several times more than ink fortified with common metals.

12917.name: Superior Deep-green Enchanted Ink
12917.description: Fortifying ink with powder created by grinding down multi-aspected crystals has been found to improve aetherial conductivity several times more than ink fortified with common metals. The concentration of this bottle's contents appears to be remarkably high.

12918.name: Deep-blue Enchanted Ink
12918.description: Fortifying ink with powder created by grinding down multi-aspected crystals has been found to improve aetherial conductivity several times more than ink fortified with common metals.

12919.name: Superior Deep-blue Enchanted Ink
12919.description: Fortifying ink with powder created by grinding down multi-aspected crystals has been found to improve aetherial conductivity several times more than ink fortified with common metals. The concentration of this bottle's contents appears to be remarkably high.

12991.name: Orthodox Barding
12991.description: A beautifully ornamented suit of plate armor worn by chocobos in the service of church officiants.

13061.name: Crystal Bell
13061.description:
One ring summons the crafter of coiffures to save you from your passé existence.

※One per estate only.

13069.name: The Unending Journey
13069.description:
A full record of your past adventures, in one massive volume.

※One per estate only.

13070.name: Oriental Tea Set
13070.description:
Bring a touch of the exotic to teatime with this collection of authentic Doman woodware.

※Cannot be retrieved once used.
※Can be used up to 10 times.

Meal benefits when used:
  **Piety Bonus:** +4% (Max 28)
  **VIT Bonus:** +4% (Max 27)
  **Gear Durability Bonus:** +3
  **EXP Bonus:** +3%
  **Duration:** 30m
  (Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

13071.name: Manor Oven
13071.description: A large cooking oven designed in a similar fashion to the unit found in Haukke Manor's kitchens.

13072.name: Manor Counter
13072.description: A large counter designed in a similar fashion to the unit found in Haukke Manor's kitchens.

13075.name: Oriental Round Table
13075.description: A low, circular table used for sitting on the floor.

13076.name: Mhachi Coffin
13076.description:
A faithful replica of a coffin discovered in the Void Ark.

※One per estate only.

13077.name: Funguar Chair
13077.description: A low stool designed to resemble a mushroom.

13078.name: Mahogany Partition Door
13078.description: A partition and door combination, reaching to the ceiling and so sturdy that it may as well be a wall.

13084.name: Topiary Chocobo
13084.description: A specially bred shrub pruned to the shape of a chipper chocobo.

13088.name: Sephirot Root
13088.description:
A masterful objet d'art created using the sap of the Fiend. 

※One per estate only.

13089.name: Sephirot Tree
13089.description:
An imposing objet d'art of a sacred tree. 

※One per estate only.

13090.name: Oriental Grass Plot
13090.description:
A tall variety of wild grass with stalks that end in large silver tufts of wispy flowers.

※Up to ten flower plots may be placed in a single garden, regardless of type.

13091.name: Dravanian Down Tree
13091.description:
A unique species of flora found only growing in the Sea of Clouds. As its seeds do not take in soil from the lower realm, the trees must be planted and raised on sky islets before being transplanted.

※Up to ten flower plots may be placed in a single garden, regardless of type.

13095.name: Cob Inner Wall
13095.description: A rustic wall made of soil, straw, and lime.

13096.name: Manor Flooring
13096.description: Flooring similar in design to that used in Haukke Manor.

13097.name: Faerie Chandelier
13097.description: This delicate light fixture will remind you the wood is alive and always watching...

13276.name: Wind-up Illuminatus
13276.description:
Comes complete with two hands, both blue as an Illuminati baby's bum.

Use item to acquire the wind-up Illuminatus minion.

13284.name: Wind-up Ifrit
13284.description:
It doesn't bleed. You cannot kill it. (But you may discard it at your leisure.)

Use item to acquire the wind-up Ifrit minion.

13589.name: Adamantite Francesca
13589.description: A small throwing axe forged from adamantite.

13590.name: Pterodactyl Strap
13590.description: A thin leather strap cut from the cured hide of a pterodactyl.

13591.name: Titanium Alloy Mirror
13591.description: The reflective surface on this mirror has been achieved through countless days of buffing and polishing.

13592.name: Titanium Alloy Square
13592.description: A thin, tiny plate of hammered titanium alloy.

13593.name: Dispelling Arrow
13593.description: Not actually an arrow, but rather a warding charm carved into the shape of one.

13594.name: Blessed Fletchings
13594.description: Arrow fletchings crafted from the large, rigid feathers of an eagle and then blessed by an anointed Halonic priest.

13595.name: Kingcake
13595.description: A festive ring-shaped cake baked from brioche dough.

13596.name: Moogle Miniature
13596.description: A small ceramic figurine bearing the likeness of a plump moogle.

13637.name: Max-Potion
13637.description: This spiritous concoction instantly restores a considerable amount of HP.

13638.name: Max-Ether
13638.description: Processed via the alchemical extraction of aetheric essence occurring in elemental crystals, the contents of this vial instantly restore a considerable amount of MP.

13726.name: Iron Clapper
13726.description: A short piece of iron loosely affixed to the inside of a bell, causing it to ring when the clapper strikes the bell's wall.

13742.name: Steamed Staff
13742.description:
Not actually a staff, but a dish made from steaming a freshwater fish known as a retribution staff─a long, thin wavekin believed to be the cause of storms.

**EXP Bonus:** +3% **Duration:** 30m
(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

13743.name: Sesame Cookie
13743.description:
Tales of a blue monster who greedily devours these baked delights have frightened children across the realm for generations.

**EXP Bonus:** +3% **Duration:** 30m
(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

13747.name: Titanium Alloy Ingot
13747.description: A durable alloy created by smelting titanium with zinc.

13748.name: Cloud Cloth
13748.description: Soft, light cotton woven from rare cloud cotton bolls.

13749.name: Pterodactyl Leather
13749.description: A large piece of cured pterodactyl skin.

13758.name: Cassia Block
13758.description: An expertly cut cube of fragrant cassia lumber.

13842.name: Replica High Allagan Grimoire of Casting

13843.name: Replica High Allagan Grimoire of Healing

14045.name: Orchestrion
14045.description:
A furnishing that is sure to delight guests and residents alike, as they while away the hours listening to some of their favorite tunes.

※One orchestrion of any type per estate only.

14047.name: Stuffed Onion Prince
14047.description: Attempting to peel away the layers of what makes this plush prince so glum will leave you with less than you started out with. As well as a mess of fabric.

14048.name: Pudding Floor Lamp
14048.description: A slimy floor lamp designed in the likeness of a pudding.

14049.name: Pudding Throw Rug
14049.description: A slimy throw rug designed in the likeness of a pudding.

14050.name: Pudding Settee
14050.description: A slimy settee designed in the likeness of a pudding.

14051.name: Pudding Desk
14051.description: A slimy desk designed in the likeness of a pudding.

14052.name: Alpine Supper Set
14052.description:
This warm array of comfort food has become a treat for special occasions amongst the commoner families of Ishgard, who have been known to save their coin for moons to procure the ingredients.

※Cannot be retrieved once used.
※Can be used up to 10 times.

Meal benefits when used:
  **Skill Speed Bonus:** +4% (Max 29)
  **VIT Bonus:** +4% (Max 28)
  **Gear Durability Bonus:** +3
  **EXP Bonus:** +3%
  **Duration:** 30m
  (Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

14053.name: High House Supper Set
14053.description:
An extravagant multiple-course meal enjoyed by the nobility of Ishgard on saint feast days and other ceremonious occasions. 

※Cannot be retrieved once used.
※Can be used up to 10 times.

Meal benefits when used:
  **Determination Bonus:** +4% (Max 28)
  **VIT Bonus:** +4% (Max 27)
  **Gear Durability Bonus:** +3
  **EXP Bonus:** +3%
  **Duration:** 30m
  (Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

14058.name: Dinosaur Skull
14058.description: The crown of an ancient beast. While one may find it comical to stick his or her head in its mouth, collectors warn that its teeth are still razor-sharp and there have been unfortunate accidents.

14059.name: Dinosaur Skeleton
14059.description: The torso and legs of an ancient beast. Scholars are unsure why its modern cousins still have short arms, but they argue they must be of some merit in their hunting habits.

14060.name: Dinosaur Tailbone
14060.description: The tail of an ancient beast. Some believe that when struck with a mallet, the hollowed tailbones emit pleasant-sounding notes.

14061.name: Topiary Sabotender
14061.description: A specially bred shrub pruned to the shape of a scampering sabotender.

14064.name: Living Arch
14064.description: An aging stone bridge covered in ivy and moss. Perfect for the romantic rendezvous.

14065.name: Shishi-odoshi
14065.description:
A fountain from the Far East originally used to scare away creatures and neighbors come to nibble on garden patches. 

※Up to five may be placed in a single estate, regardless of type.

14066.name: Faust Striking Dummy
14066.description:
A striking dummy created by the Illuminati to train their ranks for combat.

※Up to three dummies may be placed in a single estate, regardless of type.

14068.name: Alpine Chandelier
14068.description: A sumptuous chandelier designed to complement alpine residences.

14069.name: Alpine Flooring
14069.description: Floorboards designed to complement alpine residences.

14070.name: Alpine Inner Wall
14070.description: An interior wall designed in the alpine fashion.

14080.name: Sephirotic Barding
14080.description: A suit of chocobo armor designed to resemble Sephirot, the Fiend.

14093.name: Wind-up Garuda
14093.description:
Hopefully she will not HEEHEE haha HEEE!!! too loudly in your ear.

Use item to acquire the wind-up Garuda minion.

14094.name: Wind-up Titan
14094.description:
Placing this wind-up Titan on an elevated surface may compel it to knock everything else to the ground. 

Use item to acquire the wind-up Titan minion.

14095.name: Wind-up Leviathan
14095.description:
Your flesh cannot feed this minion of the deep. 

Use item to acquire the wind-up Leviathan minion.

14134.name: Spiced Cider
14134.description:
A warmed jug filled with piquant apple juice mulled with zested ginger and cloves, complete with a stick of cinnamon.

**EXP Bonus:** +3% **Duration:** 30m
(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

14135.name: Apple Strudel
14135.description:
A handful of chopped apples glazed with birch syrup are thinly wrapped in a warm flaky crust, topped with just a sprinkling of cinnamon.

**EXP Bonus:** +3% **Duration:** 30m
(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

14136.name: Peperoncino
14136.description:
Noodles tossed in mature olive oil that has been infused with solstice garlic and dragon peppers.

**EXP Bonus:** +3% **Duration:** 30m
(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

14137.name: Boscaiola
14137.description:
A hearty dish of chewy noodles, heaped with a generous portion of seasonal mushrooms and drowned in tomato sauce.

**EXP Bonus:** +3% **Duration:** 30m
(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

14138.name: Loaghtan Steak
14138.description:
A tough cut of loaghtan meat soaked in a marinade of paprika, sherry, and thyme and grilled over an open flame.

**EXP Bonus:** +3% **Duration:** 30m
(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

14139.name: Oyster Confit
14139.description:
A serving of succulent Coerthan oysters on the half shell, simmered in rich olive oil and seasoned with fresh spices.

**EXP Bonus:** +3% **Duration:** 30m
(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

14140.name: Angler Stew
14140.description:
A thick, creamy stew brimming with tender chunks of fish, onions, and chives.

**EXP Bonus:** +3% **Duration:** 30m
(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

14141.name: Sweet Gnomefish
14141.description:
A gnomefish boiled in sweet birch syrup. The glaze preserves the fish for days after cooking.

**EXP Bonus:** +3% **Duration:** 30m
(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

14149.name: Eikon Iron Ingot
14149.description: An ingot of smelted iron blessed by a primal.

14152.name: Eikon Cloth
14152.description: Finely woven cloth blessed by a primal.

14155.name: Eikon Leather
14155.description: A large piece of cured beastkin skin blessed by a primal.

14157.name: Treated Camphorwood Lumber
14157.description: A processed length of camphor lumber, treated with an alchemical agent to harden the wood.

14158.name: Camphorwood Lumber
14158.description: Processed camphor lumber. Its piquant aroma remains years after harvesting, making it a favorite for use in armoires and furnishings.

14161.name: Camphor
14161.description: The waxy, crystallized remnants of a liquid drawn from steamed bits of camphorwood.

14171.name: Grade 3 Strength Dissolvent
14171.description: When applied to items such as battle gear, this alchemical liquid will dissolve away minute amounts of aether aspected to elements detrimental to strength, and by doing so, better attune the item and its wearer to the remaining beneficial elements.

17880.description: A pipe box of oriental design, complete with an ashtray and compartments for several varieties of tobacco.

17882.description: An exquisitely crafted partition of traditional Doman design.

17884.name: Teahouse Bench
17884.description: A folding bench commonly found in Far Eastern teahouses, complete with a paper parasol to shield tea-drinkers from the elements.

17886.name: Featherlight Shortsword
17886.description: A sword so lightweight, even the elder steward Fremondain can wield it with relative ease.

17888.name: Heavy Uchigatana
17888.description: A katana forged to be, above all else, durable.

17890.name: Custom-made Hammer
17890.description: A remarkably small hammer intended for use on projects requiring extreme delicacy.

17892.name: Examination Uchigatana
17892.description: A katana forged as your final test, and to be delivered to a prominent noble house.

17894.name: Paladin Mail
17894.description: A titanium-alloy breastplate fit for a paladin.

17896.name: Titanium Kote
17896.description: Lightweight gauntlets of Far Eastern design, forged with titanium for added durability.

17898.name: Tournament Somen
17898.description: Lightweight headgear of Far Eastern design. For use in Hingan tournaments known as “gozen-jiai.”

17900.name: Lominsan Hara-ate
17900.description: A breastplate that combines Hingan design with Lominsan craftsmanship, bringing east and west together at last.

17902.name: Sample Silver Ring
17902.description: A silver ring set with a single brilliant lapis lazuli recovered from the crown of Nanamo Ul Namo's mother.

17904.name: Precision Spectacles
17904.description: A pair of corrective glasses crafted to accommodate for J'khebica's failing eyesight.

17906.name: Sample Chronometer
17906.description: A small desktop chronometer to be employed in the training of apprentices.

17908.name: Tribute Orchestrion
17908.description: An elegant and compact orchestrion custom-made by the Crown Gemworks as a tribute for the sultana.

17910.name: Large Dhalmel Cape
17910.description: A dhalmel hide expertly trimmed and prepared for stuffing.

17912.name: Grizzly Bear Gloves
17912.description: A thick pair of protective gloves crafted from the tanned hide of a grizzly bear.

17914.name: Dashing Dhalmelskin Jacket
17914.description: Sophisticated outerwear for the discerning gentleman *or* woman.

17916.name: Large Gagana Cape
17916.description: A gagana hide expertly trimmed and prepared for stuffing.

17918.name: Elegant Bustle
17918.description: A bustle dress of Ishgardian design, featuring extra hoops and springs to prevent unsightly sagging.

17920.name: Winsome Spring Dress
17920.description: A beautiful dress crafted with only the finest materials.

17922.name: Seductive Bustier
17922.description: A bustier of Thavnairian design, cut low to distract potential business clients, thus providing the upper hand in negotiations.

17924.name: Tennyo Hagoromo
17924.description: A billowy kimono of Far Eastern design named for angelic beings from Hingan folklore.

17926.name: Intellectuary
17926.description: A sweetened tonic believed to improve cognition.

17928.name: Twice-fermented Mun-Tuy Juice
17928.description: Fermenting Mun-Tuy extract twice greatly lessens the beans' natural bitterness, resulting in a smoother aftertaste. Side effects of the beverage include a decided loosening of the tongue.

17930.name: Luminol
17930.description: When applied to an object that has recently been in contact with blood, this alchemical admixture will change color.

17932.name: Potent Dissolvent
17932.description: Dissolvent so potent it will eat through almost anything.

17934.name: Doman Rice Balls
17934.description: Simple triangular balls of steamed sticky rice sprinkled with naught but a pinch of sea salt so that one might appreciate the subtle flavors of the original ingredients.

17936.name: Doman Udon Broth
17936.description: Golden savory stock taken by boiling flakes of a dried bonito. Used in many varieties of Far Eastern cuisine, including the noodle dish, udon.

17938.name: Nigiri-zushi
17938.description: One of many types of sushi, nigiri-zushi is called such because chefs use their hands to grip (nigiri) and form small balls of vinegared rice onto which are placed various items such as vegetables or fish.

17940.name: Doman Sukiyaki
17940.description: Originally introduced to Doma by Ala Mhigan merchants, sukiyaki is a popular dish that consists of thinly sliced meat and vegetables cooked in sweet and savory soy-based sauce.

17953.name: Carbuncle Bed
17953.description: This quaint pallet will never *betray you* a good night's sleep.

17954.name: Table Orchestrion
17954.description:
All the music from your world, all in the palm of your...table.

※One orchestrion of any type per estate only.

17955.name: Mounted Flower Vase
17955.description:
Is your table cluttered with ashtrays, deathmouse pelts, or forbidden tomes, leaving little to no room to display those beautiful begonias? This wall-adorning vase would like a word with you.

Select flowers can be displayed within.

17956.name: Stuffed Dhalmel
17956.description: One of the tallest beastkin known on Eorzea, the dhalmel is almost as majestic in your living room as it is in the wild. Almost.

17957.name: Stuffed Gagana
17957.description: A majestic gagana, gutted, tanned, and stuffed, so as not to wrinkle the noses of your houseguests.

17958.name: Oriental Pipe Box
17958.description: A pipe box of Far Eastern design, complete with an ashtray and compartments for several varieties of tobacco.

17959.name: Oriental Dressing Case
17959.description: A dressing case of Far Eastern design, featuring a large mirror of polished metal and countless compartments for jewelry and sundry maquillage.

17960.name: Doman Partition
17960.description: A partition of traditional Doman design for use in both homes and places of business.

17961.name: Lakshmi Miniature
17961.description:
A statuette depicting the Lady of Bliss, Lakshmi. (Qalyana chieftainess unsurprisingly missing.)

※One per estate only.

17962.name: Susano Miniature
17962.description:
A statuette depicting the Lord of the Revel, Susano. (Legendary blade Ame-no-Murakumo included. Second “O” missing, and nowhere to be found.)

※One per estate only.

17967.name: Oriental Sushi Lunch
17967.description:
An exotic Far Eastern dish of sweet, vinegared rice, raw fish, and marine flora prepared to stimulate not only the tongue, but the eyes.

※Cannot be retrieved once used.
※Can be used up to 10 times.

Meal benefits when used:
  **Critical Hit Bonus:** +4% (Max 35)
  **VIT Bonus:** +4% (Max 36)
  **Gear Durability Bonus:** +3
  **EXP Bonus:** +3%
  **Duration:** 30m
  (Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

17968.name: Oriental Soba Lunch
17968.description:
An exotic Far Eastern dish of earthy buckwheat noodles eaten by dipping them into a chilled broth of soy sauce and fish stock.

※Cannot be retrieved once used.
※Can be used up to 10 times.

Meal benefits when used:
  **Skill Speed Bonus:** +4% (Max 35)
  **VIT Bonus:** +4% (Max 36)

  **EXP Bonus:** +3%
  **Duration:** 30m

17969.name: Oriental Udon Lunch
17969.description:
An exotic Far Eastern dish of thick flour noodles swimming in a hot broth of soy sauce and fish stock.

※Cannot be retrieved once used.
※Can be used up to 10 times.

  **VIT Bonus:** +4% (Max 36)

  **EXP Bonus:** +3%
  **Duration:** 30m

17970.name: Oriental Rice Ball Lunch
17970.description:
A simple Far Eastern dish consisting of hand-shaped balls of lightly salted rice wrapped in dried seaweed.

※Cannot be retrieved once used.
※Can be used up to 10 times.

  **VIT Bonus:** +4% (Max 36)
  **Gear Durability Bonus:** +3
  **EXP Bonus:** +3%
  **Duration:** 30m

17971.name: Easel
17971.description: A three-legged wooden frame upon which a painting may be placed to cozen your kith and kin into believing you were responsible for the masterpiece.

17983.name: Eastern Teahouse Bench
17983.description: A wooden folding bench and accompanying papercraft umbrella similar to those found at Hingan teahouses.

17984.name: Topiary Carbuncle
17984.description: A specially bred shrub pruned to the shape of a curious Carbuncle.

17994.description: A faithful replica of the grand chandelier found in Fortemps Manor.

19807.name: Doman Tea
19807.description:
An after-supper beverage naturally sweetened with dried persimmons. Widely popular in the Far East.

**EXP Bonus:** +3% **Duration:** 30m
(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

19808.name: Loquat Juice
19808.description:
A thick, orange juice freshly squeezed from ripe loquats.

**EXP Bonus:** +3% **Duration:** 30m
(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

19809.name: Buckwheat Tea
19809.description:
A dark, nutty infusion made from steeping buckwheat kernels in boiling water.

**EXP Bonus:** +3% **Duration:** 30m
(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

19810.name: Steppe Tea
19810.description:
A thick, creamy beverage popular on the Azim Steppe made from steeped fermented tea leaves and a generous helping of dzo milk.

**EXP Bonus:** +3% **Duration:** 30m
(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

19811.name: Baklava
19811.description:
A traditional Near Eastern pastry made of a sweetened paste of chopped nuts and honey sandwiched between layers of thin unleavened dough.

**EXP Bonus:** +3% **Duration:** 30m
(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

19812.name: Jellied Compote
19812.description:
Stewed fruit rendered firm with gelatin, then chilled and cut into bite-sized squares.

**EXP Bonus:** +3% **Duration:** 30m
(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

19813.name: Persimmon Pudding
19813.description:
A rich steamed dessert made with puréed persimmons and eggs.

**EXP Bonus:** +3% **Duration:** 30m
(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

19814.name: Chirashi-zushi
19814.description:
One of many varieties of the Hingan dish sushi, this iteration consists of a full bowl of sweet vinegared rice topped with various items such as thinly sliced omelet, salted fish eggs, dried gourd, stewed mushrooms, and other local fare. Commonly eaten at celebratory events.

**EXP Bonus:** +3% **Duration:** 30m
(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

19815.name: Persimmon Leaf Sushi
19815.description:
One of many varieties of the Hingan dish sushi, this iteration consists of sweet vinegared rice topped with fish, pressed into a narrow rectangle, and finally wrapped in green persimmon leaves.

**EXP Bonus:** +3% **Duration:** 30m
(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

19816.name: Popoto Soba
19816.description:
Buckwheat noodles steeped in savory broth and topped with a starchy paste created by grinding a raw mountain popoto.

**EXP Bonus:** +3% **Duration:** 30m
(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

19817.name: Shorlog
19817.description:
Heavily spiced dzo meat charred to perfection over an open flame. Common fare amongst the nomadic steppe tribes.

**EXP Bonus:** +3% **Duration:** 30m
(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

19818.name: Pork Kakuni
19818.description:
Thick slices of succulent Koshu pork slow cooked in a sweet, savory sauce. If prepared properly, the meat literally melts in your mouth.

**EXP Bonus:** +3% **Duration:** 30m
(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

19819.name: Jerked Jhammel
19819.description:
Thin slices of tough jhammel meat salted and dried to preserve for long journeys.

**EXP Bonus:** +3% **Duration:** 30m
(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

19820.name: Egg Foo Young
19820.description:
Succulent crab legs folded into a fluffy omelette and topped with a thick, savory sauce.

**EXP Bonus:** +3% **Duration:** 30m
(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

19821.name: Onigara-yaki
19821.description:
A lobster split in half lengthwise, slathered with a heavily seasoned sauce, and grilled in its shell over an open flame.

**EXP Bonus:** +3% **Duration:** 30m
(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

19822.name: Grilled Turban
19822.description:
A live horned turban cooked in its shell with a splash of soy sauce and rice wine.

**EXP Bonus:** +3% **Duration:** 30m
(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

19823.name: Boiled Amberjack Head
19823.description:
The head of an amberjack boiled in a soy-based sauce with thick-sliced daikon radish.

**EXP Bonus:** +3% **Duration:** 30m
(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

19824.name: Steamed Grouper
19824.description:
A large Zekki grouper steamed whole, then doused in fragrant boiling oil.

**EXP Bonus:** +3% **Duration:** 30m
(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

19825.name: Sweet and Sour Frogs' Legs
19825.description:
Chunks of meaty steppe bullfrog legs, breaded and deep-fried, then tossed in a sweet and tangy vinegar-based glaze with fresh colorful vegetables.

**EXP Bonus:** +3% **Duration:** 30m
(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

19826.name: Tempura Platter
19826.description:
A selection of seafood and vegetables dipped in batter and lightly fried in oil. A Hingan delicacy.

**EXP Bonus:** +3% **Duration:** 30m
(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

19827.name: Stewed River Bream
19827.description:
River bream topped in a sauce made by thickening the broth in which the fish was stewed.

**EXP Bonus:** +3% **Duration:** 30m
(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

19828.name: Charred Charr
19828.description:
Heather charr sprinkled with salt and blackened over an open flame.

**EXP Bonus:** +3% **Duration:** 30m
(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

19829.name: Miso Dengaku
19829.description:
Stiff tofu squares and vegetables impaled on a stick and slathered in a sweet miso sauce then roasted over hot coals.

**EXP Bonus:** +3% **Duration:** 30m
(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

19830.name: Jhammel Moussaka
19830.description:
A Near Eastern casserole made from a spiced jhammel and eggplant mincemeat topped with creamy mashed popotoes.

**EXP Bonus:** +3% **Duration:** 30m
(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

19831.name: Gameni
19831.description:
A hodgepodge of boldly sliced tubers, mushrooms, and hornbill tenders, stewed slowly in a soy-based broth.

**EXP Bonus:** +3% **Duration:** 30m
(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

19832.name: Steppe Salad
19832.description:
A salad of various seasonal tubers tossed lightly in a rice vinegar dressing.

**EXP Bonus:** +3% **Duration:** 30m
(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

19833.name: Crab Croquette
19833.description:
Rich, buttery crab legs blended with fluffy mashed vegetables, rolled into a ball, covered in bread crumbs, and fried to a crispy, golden brown. Best served slathered in a sweet sauce.

**EXP Bonus:** +3% **Duration:** 30m
(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

19834.name: Miso Soup with Tofu
19834.description:
A Far Eastern staple, often eaten multiple times a day, this soup is made by mixing miso paste with light fish stock. Bite-sized cubes of tofu are added near the end of preparation to ensure the pieces retain their shape.

**EXP Bonus:** +3% **Duration:** 30m
(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

19835.name: Fish Stew
19835.description:
A salty broth containing balls of finely ground fish paste. A common dish in Far Eastern coastal settlements.

**EXP Bonus:** +3% **Duration:** 30m
(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

19836.name: Pork Stew
19836.description:
This Far Eastern take on a campsite mainstay features thinly sliced pork belly and various root vegetables in a piping hot miso-based soup.

**EXP Bonus:** +3% **Duration:** 30m
(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

19837.name: Warrior's Stew
19837.description:
A simple stew commonly made of diced dzo chuck and whatever vegetables are readily available. A popular dish amongst the nomadic tribes of the Azim Steppe.

**EXP Bonus:** +3% **Duration:** 30m
(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

19838.name: Kasha
19838.description:
Buckwheat kernels boiled in bouillon to form a soft, hearty porridge.

**EXP Bonus:** +3% **Duration:** 30m
(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

19839.name: Nomad Meat Pie
19839.description:
Ground dzo chuck and various steppe vegetables wrapped in buttery dough and deep-fried in oil.

**EXP Bonus:** +3% **Duration:** 30m
(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

19842.name: Firm Tofu
19842.description: A traditional source of protein in the Far East, tofu is made from curdled soy bean extract.

19843.name: Rice Vinegar
19843.description: One of Far Eastern cuisine's five main seasonings, rice vinegar is slightly more sweet and mild than Aldenard's vinegars of popoto or apple.

19844.name: Beet Sugar
19844.description: A sweetener made by juicing sugar beets and then boiling the extract down until all the water has evaporated, leaving only a fine, grey powder.

19846.name: Cottonseed Oil
19846.description: Cooking oil pressed from ruby cotton seeds. Its high flash point and lack of odor make it ideal for deep-frying.

19848.name: Algae Salt
19848.description: A briny salt harvested by sun-drying then burning sea algae.
