22582.name: Odder Otter Andon Lamp
22582.description: An outdoor lamp with an odder otter motif.

22720.name: Happi Components
22720.description:
Components required to craft festive happi for the Namazu.

※Only for use in Namazu society quests.

22721.name: Altar Components
22721.description:
Components required to craft an altar to the Big One.

※Only for use in Namazu society quests.

22722.name: Mikoshi Frippery
22722.description:
Fanciful frippery for the Namazu's mikoshi.

※Only for use in Namazu society quests.

22723.name: Ceremonial Bow Components
22723.description:
Components required to craft a ceremonial bow for the archery event.

※Only for use in Namazu society quests.

22724.name: Effigy Components
22724.description:
Components required to craft a massive Namazu effigy.

※Only for use in Namazu society quests.

22725.name: Finery Components
22725.description:
Components necessary for the eager Namazu to craft his fincrafted fineries.

※Only for use in Namazu society quests.

22726.name: Ritual Implement Components
22726.description:
Components necessary to craft the ritual implements requested by Seigetsu the Enlightened.

※Only for use in Namazu society quests.

22727.name: Brazier Components
22727.description:
Components necessary to craft braziers that will burn safely through the night.

※Only for use in Namazu society quests.

22728.name: Uchiwa Components
22728.description:
Components necessary to craft uchiwa.

※Only for use in Namazu society quests.

22729.name: Trinket Components
22729.description:
Components necessary to craft inexpensive trinkets the Uyagir will accept.

※Only for use in Namazu society quests.

22730.name: Catfish Lure Components
22730.description:
Components required to craft catfish lures.

※Only for use in Namazu society quests.

22731.name: Azim Steppe Souvenir Components
22731.description:
Components required to craft Azim Steppe souvenirs.

※Only for use in Namazu society quests.

22732.name: Hingan Ritual Paraphernalia
22732.description:
Various items used to invite the spirits of ancestors into the home.

※Only for use in Namazu society quests.

22733.name: Dzo Shear Components
22733.description:
Components required to craft and maintain dzo shears.

※Only for use in Namazu society quests.

22734.name: Buuz Cooking Paraphernalia
22734.description:
Various items used in the cooking of buuz.

※Only for use in Namazu society quests.

22735.name: Mol Tea Ceremony Paraphernalia
22735.description:
Various items used in Mol tea ceremonies.

※Only for use in Namazu society quests.

22736.name: Stable Supplies
22736.description:
A set of supplies essential for running a stable of horses.

※Only for use in Namazu society quests.

22737.name: Drum Parts
22737.description:
A set of parts needed for the assembly of traditional drums.

※Only for use in Namazu society quests.

22738.name: Confetti-making Tools
22738.description:
A set of tools used in the process of making confetti.

※Only for use in Namazu society quests.

22739.name: Substitute Offering
22739.description:
A “secret” offering intended to replace the usual altar fare.

※Only for use in Namazu society quests.

22740.name: Steeping Accessory
22740.description:
An accessory to be used in the Namazu roast-steeping process.

※Only for use in Namazu society quests.

22741.name: Pristine Fruit Figurine
22741.description:
A figurine resembling fruit that looks good enough to eat. Though you probably shouldn't.

※Only for use in Namazu society quests.

22742.name: Land Diving Gear
22742.description:
A set of gear required for the Namazu's latest festival event wherein participants jump from death-defying heights.

※Only for use in Namazu society quests.

22743.name: Culinary Knife Component
22743.description:
A component required to repair a culinary knife.

※Only for use in Namazu society quests.

22744.name: Generous Gift
22744.description:
A gift crafted on behalf of the Namazu to show their appreciation to the Oronir.

※Only for use in Namazu society quests.

22745.name: Korrigan Doll
22745.description:
A doll made in the spitting image of a korrigan.

※Only for use in Namazu society quests.

23030.name: Wind-up Sadu
23030.description:
Will most likely not call any of your companions a stunted chuluu.

Use item to acquire the wind-up Sadu minion.

23037.name: Lunar Barding
23037.description: A suit of chocobo armor designed to resemble Tsukuyomi, Lady of the Moon.

23097.name: Grand Chair
23097.description: An imposing chair with an ornately wrought chocobo motif.

23143.name: Gyr Abanian Remedies
23143.description: An assortment of highly effective traditional medicines originating in Gyr Abania.

23144.name: Anti-shark Harpoon
23144.description: A harpoon particularly effective for warding off sharks...by stabbing them.

23145.name: Coerthan Cold-weather Gear
23145.description: Various items so effective against the cold that no Coerthan would leave home without them.

23146.name: Sui-no-Sato Special
23146.description: A new luxury product designed for the express purpose of representing Sui–no–Sato.

23147.name: Cloud Pearl
23147.description: A synthetic version of a rare treasure occasionally found in the Sea of Clouds.

23153.name: Gyr Abanian Remedy Components
23153.description: A variety of components needed to create traditional Gyr Abanian remedies.

23154.name: Harpoon Components
23154.description: Several components needed to create a harpoon effective against sharks.

23155.name: Cold-weather Gear Components
23155.description: A variety of components needed to create cold-weather gear of the sort favored by Coerthans.

23156.name: Sui-no-Sato Special Components
23156.description: A variety of components necessary to create Sui–no–Sato's new product.

23157.name: Cloud Pearl Components
23157.description: A variety of components necessary to create a synthetic cloud pearl.

23167.name: Super-Potion
23167.description: This concentrated concoction instantly restores a significant amount of HP.

23168.name: Super-Ether
23168.description: Processed via the alchemical extraction of aetheric essence occurring in elemental crystals, the contents of this vial instantly restore a significant amount of MP.

23173.name: Elixir Mixing Paraphernalia
23173.description:
Exactly what the Namazu apothecary needs to finish his reinvigorating elixir.

※Only for use in Namazu society quests.

23183.name: Hawk's Eye Sand
23183.description: Conversion of the mineral hawk's eye via an alchemical process is the only way to create this incomparably fine sand.

23184.name: Veteran Tree Sap
23184.description: This sap has been reverted from hardened lumps to its original liquid state via an alchemical process.

23185.name: Konpeito
23185.description:
Colorful clusters of crystalline sugar─a childhood treat for Hingans and Domans alike.

**EXP Bonus:** +3% **Duration:** 30m
(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

23186.name: Banh Xeo
23186.description:
A traditional Nagxian dish consisting of meat and vegetables swaddled in a thin shell of crispy fried batter.

**EXP Bonus:** +3% **Duration:** 30m
(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

23187.name: Matcha
23187.description:
A sophisticatedly bitter infusion prepared by whisking fine-ground tea leaves into piping hot water. Drinking it properly requires such finesse that Hingashi is home to many a school focused solely on perfecting the art.

**EXP Bonus:** +3% **Duration:** 30m
(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

23188.name: Ema Datshi
23188.description:
Rich, oozing cheese complements the seething bite of inferno-hot peppers in this Azim Steppe staple.

**EXP Bonus:** +3% **Duration:** 30m
(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

23218.name: Hakutaku Eye Cluster
23218.description: A cluster of eyes from a legendary beast, the Hakutaku. The eyes are slowly yet steadily growing in number as they divide via mitosis.

23316.name: Ambient Abyss Orchestrion Roll
23316.description: Music roll of the soothing sound of the cobalt deep. Use to add to your orchestrion list.

23324.name: Black and White Orchestrion Roll
23324.description: Music roll for *Black and White*. Use to add to your orchestrion list.

23331.name: Nightbloom Orchestrion Roll
23331.description: Music roll for *Nightbloom*. Use to add to your orchestrion list.

23332.name: Wayward Daughter Orchestrion Roll
23332.description: Music roll for *Wayward Daughter*. Use to add to your orchestrion list.

23336.name: Faded Copy of Under the Moonlight

23349.name: Potion of Harmony
23349.description:
This innovative alchemical concoction assists the body in acclimating to Eureka's discordant aetheric environment.

**Elemental EXP Bonus:** +10%  **Duration:** 60m (if HQ, 90m)
※Only available for use in the Forbidden Land, Eureka.

23862.name: Pot of Cream Stew
23862.description:
A warming dish of familiar vegetables simmered for bells in a rich sauce of thickened milk.

※Cannot be retrieved once used.
※Can be used up to 10 times.

Meal benefits when used:
  **Spell Speed Bonus:** +4% (Max 10)
  **VIT Bonus:** +4% (Max 12)
  **Gear Durability Bonus:** +2
  **EXP Bonus:** +3%
  **Duration:** 30m
  (Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

23863.name: Suzaku Wall Hanging
23863.description:
An elegant relief depicting one of the Four Lords, alive with dancing flame.

※One per estate only.

23874.name: Redoubtable Rolanberry Tart
23874.description:
A flaky-crusted tart with a slight acidity that complements its pleasant sweetness, so enormous that it should only be served at parties. Of course, sometimes a party can be just one hungry homeowner and a clean fork. Or a dirty one. It doesn't really matter.

※Cannot be retrieved once used.
※Can be used up to 10 times.

Meal benefits when used:
  **Tenacity Bonus:** +4% (Max 10)
  **VIT Bonus:** +4% (Max 12)
  **Gear Durability Bonus:** +2
  **EXP Bonus:** +3%
  **Duration:** 30m
  (Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

23877.name: Imitation Shuttered Window
23877.description: Unlike those attached to non-imitation windows, these louvered shutters will ever remain pristine as they add a touch of the rustic to your interior décor.

23879.name: Wooden Showcase
23879.description: Spare a thought for the poor carpenter who toiled to make this furnishing both simple and elegant as you inevitably pile as many objects as physically possible atop its shelves.

23880.name: Unfinished Shawl
23880.description: A knitter's work is never done. In this case, literally.

23883.name: Bread Rack
23883.description: One could raise an entire army of ducks with this much bread. Hypothetically.

23884.name: Mahogany Bunk Bed
23884.description: For weary adults who have spent overmuch on alligator pears and cannot afford to live alone.

23885.name: Handbasket
23885.description: A large and lovely woven vessel. Be advised that if a Lalafell fits in it, she will sits in it.

23891.name: Mounted Plate Rack
23891.description: A sturdy wooden display. For the *good* plates, not the *food* plates.

23893.name: Bathroom Floor Tiles
23893.description: A large square of cerulean tiling with a built-in drain.

23894.name: Bathroom Wall Tiles
23894.description: A square of tiling used to prevent walls from becoming so waterlogged that the house slowly but surely collapses in on itself.

23896.name: Sofa Cushions
23896.description: Does one truly require a sofa if he has this many pillows?

23900.name: Carpeting
23900.description: Durable-yet-fuzzy loop carpet with a checkerboard pattern.

23902.name: Unfinished Interior Wall
23902.description: An interior wall of pale unvarnished wood.

23989.name: Scarlet Peacock
23989.description:
Prettier than your average peacock, and several times as flammable.

Use item to acquire the scarlet peacock minion.

24143.name: Suzaku Barding
24143.description: A suit of chocobo armor designed to resemble the Far Eastern auspice Suzaku.

24250.name: Chigusa Ingot
24250.description: An ingot of tatara-smelted Doman steel.

24251.name: Evergleam Ingot
24251.description: An ingot of smelted evergleam steel.

24253.name: Procoptodon Leather
24253.description: A large piece of cured procoptodon skin.

24254.name: Stardust Cotton Cloth
24254.description: Several yalms of undyed stardust cotton wrapped around a short distaff.

24256.name: Grade 4 Reisui of Strength
24256.description: When applied to items such as battle gear, this Far Eastern potation will, similarly to Eorzean dissolvents, dissolve away minute amounts of aether aspected to elements detrimental to strength, and by doing so, better attune the item and its wearer to the remaining beneficial elements.

24257.name: Grade 4 Reisui of Dexterity
24257.description: When applied to items such as battle gear, this Far Eastern potation will, similarly to Eorzean dissolvents, dissolve away minute amounts of aether aspected to elements detrimental to dexterity, and by doing so, better attune the item and its wearer to the remaining beneficial elements.

24258.name: Grade 4 Reisui of Vitality
24258.description: When applied to items such as battle gear, this Far Eastern potation will, similarly to Eorzean dissolvents, dissolve away minute amounts of aether aspected to elements detrimental to vitality, and by doing so, better attune the item and its wearer to the remaining beneficial elements.

24259.name: Grade 4 Reisui of Intelligence
24259.description: When applied to items such as battle gear, this Far Eastern potation will, similarly to Eorzean dissolvents, dissolve away minute amounts of aether aspected to elements detrimental to intelligence, and by doing so, better attune the item and its wearer to the remaining beneficial elements.

24260.name: Grade 4 Reisui of Mind
24260.description: When applied to items such as battle gear, this Far Eastern potation will, similarly to Eorzean dissolvents, dissolve away minute amounts of aether aspected to elements detrimental to mind, and by doing so, better attune the item and its wearer to the remaining beneficial elements.

24261.name: Grade 3 Infusion of Strength
24261.description:
This diluted brew temporarily increases strength, but for twice the duration of similar potions.

**Duration:** 30s

24262.name: Grade 3 Infusion of Dexterity
24262.description:
This diluted brew temporarily increases dexterity, but for twice the duration of similar potions.

**Duration:** 30s

24263.name: Grade 3 Infusion of Vitality
24263.description:
This diluted brew temporarily increases vitality, but for twice the duration of similar potions.

**Duration:** 30s

24264.name: Grade 3 Infusion of Intelligence
24264.description:
This diluted brew temporarily increases intelligence, but for twice the duration of similar potions.

**Duration:** 30s

24265.name: Grade 3 Infusion of Mind
24265.description:
This diluted brew temporarily increases mind, but for twice the duration of similar potions.

**Duration:** 30s

24274.name: Rooibos Tea
24274.description:
A healthful herbal tea known for its natural mellow sweetness.

**EXP Bonus:** +3% **Duration:** 30m
(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

24275.name: Ginger Salad
24275.description:
A zesty salad that beckons with the aroma of fresh-cut ginger.

**EXP Bonus:** +3% **Duration:** 30m
(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

24276.name: Laghman
24276.description:
A popular comfort food in Othard consisting of thick, chewy noodles and tender minced dzo in a wholesome broth.

**EXP Bonus:** +3% **Duration:** 30m
(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

24277.name: Imam Bayildi
24277.description:
Miniature Doman eggplants stuffed to bursting with juicy marinated vegetables─and enough peppers to knock a trained Fist of Rhalgr monk out cold.

**EXP Bonus:** +3% **Duration:** 30m
(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

24278.name: Papanasi
24278.description:
Thick dough kneaded with soft cheese and fried into a hearty donut, slathered with yet more creamy cheese and a sweet-and-tart berry sauce.

**EXP Bonus:** +3% **Duration:** 30m
(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

24279.name: Salmon Muffin
24279.description:
A buttery Ishgardian muffin topped with the winning combination of succulent fresh salmon, silky sliced alligator pear, and a drizzling of rich cheese.

**EXP Bonus:** +3% **Duration:** 30m
(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

24280.name: Shakshouka
24280.description:
Eggs perfectly poached in a robust, spicy tomato sauce.

**EXP Bonus:** +3% **Duration:** 30m
(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

24296.name: Sunrise Orchestrion Roll
24296.description: Music roll for *Sunrise*. Use to add to your orchestrion list.

24491.name: Mirific Mogshelf
24491.description: A charming bookshelf topped with decorative moogles beckoning readers to the myriad worlds that come alive through the written word.

24492.name: Tier 3 Metal Aquarium
24492.description:
A large reinforced glass tank that, when filled with water, can serve as a home for select wavekin caught in the wild. The higher an aquarium's tier, the larger the specimens that can be kept within.
※Private chambers (apartments), cottages, houses, and mansions can host 4, 6, 8, and 10 aquariums, respectively.

24493.name: Tier 4 Metal Aquarium
24493.description:
A massive reinforced glass tank that, when filled with water, can serve as a home for select wavekin caught in the wild. The higher an aquarium's tier, the larger the specimens that can be kept within.
※Private chambers (apartments), cottages, houses, and mansions can host 4, 6, 8, and 10 aquariums, respectively.

24495.name: Seiryu Statuette
24495.description:
An elegant carving of the venerable Seiryu. The geomantic orb in its claws reputedly fills one's home with auspicious energies.

※One per estate only.

24501.name: Small Imitation Window
24501.description: Despite its size─and the minor detail of it not being a real window─this plain would-be portal provides a surprising amount of light.

24502.name: Bag of Booty
24502.description: The shine of the historic coins contained within has been professionally restored with great care. Nevertheless, whether you tuck this bag safely away or wave it about while putting on a terrible faux-pirate accent is entirely up to you.

24506.name: Fat Cat Bank
24506.description: Presumably due to the resemblance in terms of rotundity, the fat cat has overtaken the pig as a popular motif for coin banks. Comes with a matching purse to better facilitate the spending of one's hard-earned savings.

24508.name: Botanist's Dried Herbs
24508.description: An assortment of pleasant-smelling medicinal and culinary herbs verified to be nontoxic. Mostly.

24509.name: Steppe Kitchen
24509.description: This cooking facility was fashioned after those used by the Xaela tribes of the Azim Steppe.

24511.name: Wooden Loft
24511.description: Create the perfect space for sleeping, reading, displays, or enjoying an insurmountable advantage in pillow fights with this wall-mounted platform.

24512.name: Wooden Steps
24512.description: Useful in climbing up to lofts or removing rival heirs.

24513.name: Wooden Beam
24513.description: For use with the wooden loft, though beam enthusiasts are sure to enjoy it regardless.

24514.name: White Rectangular Partition
24514.description: Thus named despite the fact that none would fain expect a blue triangle.

24515.name: Bowl of Oden
24515.description:
A heaping bowl of juicy fishcakes, tender daikon, hearty boiled eggs, and other savory ingredients steeped for hours in a warming broth.

※Cannot be retrieved once used.
※Can be used up to 10 times.

Meal benefits when used:
  **Spell Speed Bonus:** +4% (Max 10)
  **VIT Bonus:** +5% (Max 12)
  **Gear Durability Bonus:** +3
  **EXP Bonus:** +3%
  **Duration:** 30m
  (Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

24522.name: Prism Pouch
24522.description: A pouch for many standard-sized prisms, or one extremely large one.

24523.name: Marimo Lamp
24523.description: The product of a skilled yet not particularly creative metalworker who took inspiration from the lamp marimo to create...a lamp containing lamp marimo.

24524.name: Honey Pot
24524.description: Keeping this much honey in the house is just asking for bear-related trouble.

24525.name: Red Carpet
24525.description: A slim length of carpeting to welcome honored guests.

24526.name: Hanging Planter Shelf
24526.description: Various potted plants dangle from this wall-mounted shelf, leaving the space atop it free for other items. Or more plants.

24536.name: Botanist's Garden
24536.description: A vegetable patch so lovingly tended that it could only have been cultivated by an expert.

24538.name: Teal Blue Carpeting
24538.description: Durable-yet-fuzzy loop carpet in a soothing blue-green.

24539.name: Black-and-white Interior Wall
24539.description: A wooden interior wall painted with a monochrome pattern of wide horizontal stripes.

24562.name: Ishgardian Culinary Essentials
24562.description: Cooking tools and ingredients without which the making of authentic Ishgardian cuisine is simply impossible─or so Ishgardian culinarians claim.

24563.name: Fermented Juice
24563.description: A now-alcoholic liquid ready to be distilled into a strong but tasty liquor.

24564.name: Signature Buuz Cookware
24564.description: This assemblage of tools and ingredients strongly resembles that used by tribes of the Azim Steppe, but has been modified slightly for use in preparing a variety of buuz exclusive to the Hard Place.

24565.name: Hard Place Decorative Furnishings
24565.description: Décor perfect for convincing customers that they don't have to go home─and they *can* stay here.

24566.name: Arkhi Brewing Set
24566.description: An assortment of items for brewing the milk-based alcohol that is traditional on the Azim Steppe.

24572.name: Ishgardian Culinary Materials
24572.description: Processed materials that still look like any other sort of materials, but are nevertheless ready to be combined into authentic Ishgardian cooking essentials.

24573.name: Juice Fermenting Supplies
24573.description: Pulped fruit, yeast, and other prepared supplies necessary for fermenting juice into alcohol.

24574.name: Signature Buuz Cookware Materials
24574.description: Processed materials that can be combined into the necessary components for cooking authentic buuz.

24575.name: Decorative Tavern Furnishing Materials
24575.description: Processed materials that genuinely look as if they could be used to create stylish furnishings.

24576.name: Arkhi Brewing Vat Materials
24576.description: Processed materials that can be combined into the necessary components for brewing arkhi.

24634.name: Seitei
24634.description:
Dragon-ness is in the eye of the beholder.

Use item to acquire the Seitei minion.

24799.name: Seiryu Barding
24799.description: A suit of chocobo armor designed to resemble the Far Eastern auspice Seiryu.

24859.name: Red Lily of the Valley Corsage

24860.name: Blue Lily of the Valley Corsage

24861.name: Yellow Lily of the Valley Corsage

24862.name: Green Lily of the Valley Corsage

24863.name: Orange Lily of the Valley Corsage

24864.name: Purple Lily of the Valley Corsage

24865.name: White Lily of the Valley Corsage

24866.name: Black Lily of the Valley Corsage

24867.name: Rainbow Lily of the Valley Corsage

24868.name: Carbuncle Chandelier
24868.description: Because who doesn't want to be welcomed home from a hard day's adventuring by a few Carbuncles dangling from their ceiling?

25009.name: Kamacite
25009.description: A thin piece of smelted kamacite.

25058.name: From the Dragon's Wake Orchestrion Roll
25058.description: Music roll for *From the Dragon's Wake*. Use to add to your orchestrion list.

25086.name: Faded Copy of From the Dragon's Wake

26156.name: Ovim Wool Muffed Met of Healing

26162.name: Ovim Wool Muffed Met of Casting

26532.name: Pure Titanium Plate
26532.description: A thin, tiny plate of the purest titanium.

26782.name: Magicked Bed
26782.description: This flying furnishing eliminates the need to get up in the morning─or ever. Modern magic put to good use at last!

27232.name: Metal Gauntlets
27232.description: A pair of sturdy-yet-flexible gauntlets, designed to protect the hands from amaro bites.

27233.name: Metal Worm Jar
27233.description: A metal jar designed to keep worms fresh.

27234.name: Metal Trident
27234.description: A fearsome metal weapon ending in three deadly looking spikes.

27235.name: Nullifying Neckpiece
27235.description: An amulet imbued with magic-resisting properties.

27237.name: Intricate Censer
27237.description: A solid metal censer of exquisite design.

27239.name: Enchanting Ring
27239.description: This finely wrought ring gleams with an almost sorcerous sheen.

27240.name: Canvas Repair Materials
27240.description: Materials for repairing the canvas of the painting of Dampsole, Lakeland.

27241.name: Upholstery Repair Materials
27241.description: Materials for repairing the upholstery of the Voeburtite jewelry box.

27242.name: Amaro Barding Repair Materials
27242.description: Materials for repairing the inner lining of the antique amaro barding.

27243.name: Lute Repair Materials
27243.description: Materials for repairing Harig's broken lute.

27245.name: Workshop Sign
27245.description: The sign for Cherished Memories, masterfully crafted by your good self.

27247.name: Lute Modification Component
27247.description: The modification component that you hope will make Harig's lute sing as it once did.

27248.name: Edible Antidote
27248.description: A potent medicinal concoction mixed into a vegetable purée catering to amaro sensibilities.

27249.name: Nutrient-rich Porridge
27249.description: Wholesome and easily digestible food for delicate amaro stomachs.

27250.name: Fortifying Soup
27250.description: A comforting and invigorating vegetable and herb medley sure to have a restorative effect on both body and soul.

27251.name: Berube Feed
27251.description: This dish of assorted greens will be instantly recognizable to any Berube skipper as the feed it was raised on.

27253.name: Offering of Sweets
27253.description: A variety of colorful confections to excite and delight the fae.

27255.name: Zun-style Amaro Feed
27255.description: The traditional nutritious feed used by the Zun in raising healthy and happy amaro.

27268.name: Walnut Interior Wall
27268.description: A rustic interior wall of simple wooden boards.

27269.name: Brick Flooring
27269.description: Flooring of evenly laid red brick that calls to mind urban spaces.

27270.name: Crystarium Chandelier
27270.description: A bright and elegant ceiling light identical to those found throughout the Crystarium.

27271.name: Lily Floor Lamp
27271.description: This elegant lamp, its natural motifs rendered in polished and painted metal and glass, will make a master of white magic feel right at home.

27272.name: Lily Wall Lamp
27272.description: The reason that the sight of one of these warmly glowing light fixtures puts those with a penchant for healing so very much at ease will ever remain a mystery to people not versed in the secrets of white magic.

27274.name: Simple Curtain
27274.description: A yellow curtain gathered with a polished wooden fastener.

27278.name: Hunting Supplies
27278.description: The requisite weapons and traps for a foray into the wilds.

27279.name: War Chest
27279.description: The requisite defensive and offensive accoutrements for combat.

27280.name: Imitation Stained Crystal Pane
27280.description: Though this is neither real crystal nor a real windowpane, the rear lighting makes it appear sumptuous all the same.

27282.name: Crystarium Bench
27282.description: A wrought-iron seat identical to those found throughout the Crystarium.

27284.name: Crystarium Stove
27284.description: A warmly glowing iron kitchen stove.

27285.name: Crystarium Kitchen Hanger
27285.description: This wall-mounted hanger provides easy access to pots and pans for use in cooking or punctuating one's statements with loud clanging noises.

27286.name: Crystarium Teapot
27286.description: This metal teapot comes with a serving tray, cup, and jar of tea leaves for your convenience.

27291.name: Crystarium Mechanical Till

27838.description: Oil extracted from frantoio olives, suitable for cooking and certain medicinal concoctions.

27840.description: This sticky, stygian liquid─decidedly an acquired taste─was harvested from a spearhead squid.

27842.description: This shimmering, pure-gold honey comes courtesy of the giant honey bee.

27843.name: Night Vinegar
27843.description: A high-quality distilled vinegar made from royal grapes.

27853.name: Grilled Rail
27853.description:
The succulent tenderloin of an island rail, seared to savory perfection and garnished with garlic and rock salt.

**EXP Bonus:** +3% **Duration:** 30m

27854.name: Purple Carrot Juice
27854.description:
A hearty and healthful beverage prepared from the pulp of purple carrots and pixie apples.

**EXP Bonus:** +3% **Duration:** 30m

27855.name: Caramels
27855.description:
Beet sugar, melted butter, and cream are blended, then chilled and molded to form these bite-sized chewy candies.

**EXP Bonus:** +3% **Duration:** 30m

27856.name: Broad Bean Soup
27856.description:

**EXP Bonus:** +3% **Duration:** 30m

27857.name: Spaghetti al Nero
27857.description:
A tangy dish of thin noodles tossed with squid ink and blood tomato sauce that has the unfortunate side effect of turning your teeth jet black.

**EXP Bonus:** +3% **Duration:** 30m
(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

27858.name: Broad Bean Salad
27858.description:
This nourishing salad of broad beans, purple carrots, and lettuce is dressed lightly with frantoio oil and parsley.

**EXP Bonus:** +3% **Duration:** 30m
(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

27859.name: Grilled Platinum Bream
27859.description:
A single platinum bream, seasoned simply with rock salt and grilled to a golden brown to seal in all the juices.

**EXP Bonus:** +3% **Duration:** 30m
(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

27860.name: Baguette
27860.description:
This rustic loaf of bread exudes the appetizing aroma of upland wheat.

**EXP Bonus:** +3% **Duration:** 30m
(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

27861.name: Blood Tomato Juice
27861.description:
Ripe, pulpy tomatoes have been crushed and mixed with fresh fruit juice to create this blood red beverage.

**EXP Bonus:** +3% **Duration:** 30m
(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

27862.name: Pixie Apple Pie
27862.description:
A flaky, buttery crust surrounds a sweet compote of stewed pixie apples flavored with a hint of cinnamon.

**EXP Bonus:** +3% **Duration:** 30m
(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

27863.name: Nut Bake
27863.description:
A veritable sackful of luscious seeds and nuts went into this sweet and tasty pastry.

**EXP Bonus:** +3% **Duration:** 30m
(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

27864.name: Blood Tomato Salad
27864.description:
The dark vinegar topping this salad draws out the flavors of each fresh vegetable without overpowering them. Unless you have poured too much on, that is.

**EXP Bonus:** +3% **Duration:** 30m
(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

27865.name: Mushroom Saute
27865.description:
The rich, creamy texture of this dish comes not from the hearty creamtop mushrooms, but from the specially selected butter in which they have been cooked to perfection.

**EXP Bonus:** +3% **Duration:** 30m
(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

27866.name: Sausage Links
27866.description:
Though this is a surprisingly difficult dish to master, as the casings that hold in the rich blend of flavors can easily split during cooking, the resulting greasy, salty links are well worth the effort─particularly if said effort is someone else's.

**EXP Bonus:** +3% **Duration:** 30m
(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

27867.name: Roast Ovim
27867.description:
A carefully presented selection of the finest ovim cutlets, accompanied with a serving of popotoes and a delicately seasoned sauce.

**EXP Bonus:** +3% **Duration:** 30m
(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

27868.name: Mushroom Skewer
27868.description:
The creamtop mushrooms take center stage in this simple yet filling dish, though the blood tomatoes and ramhorn zucchinis perform admirably in supporting roles.

**EXP Bonus:** +3% **Duration:** 30m
(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

27869.name: Baked Megapiranha
27869.description:
The fearsome megapiranha makes for a succulent main course, served with a delightfully simple butter sauce. Better to eat a piranha than be eaten by one.

**EXP Bonus:** +3% **Duration:** 30m
(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

27870.name: Peppered Popotoes
27870.description:
A pleasing plate of popotoes peppered and prepared to perfection, playing pleasurably on the palate.

**EXP Bonus:** +3% **Duration:** 30m
(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

27871.name: Popotoes au Gratin
27871.description:
Though the wonderfully flavorsome russet popotoes are undoubtedly the star attraction, it is arguably the cream cheese that steals the show with its distinctive flavor.

**EXP Bonus:** +3% **Duration:** 30m
(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

27872.name: Masala Chai

**EXP Bonus:** +3% **Duration:** 30m
(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

27873.name: Risotto al Nero

**EXP Bonus:** +3% **Duration:** 30m
(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

27874.name: Espresso con Panna

(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

27884.description:

27890.description:

**EXP Bonus:** +3% **Duration:** 30m

27891.description:
The finest quality dzo, seared lightly to add a note of smokiness to the still-bleeding meat's naturally savory flavor, and topped with a drizzle of salty au jus.

(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

**EXP Bonus:** +3% **Duration:** 30m
(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

28721.name: Arros Negre
28721.description:
Though the squid ink makes for an unusual appearance, its contribution to this dish's flavor profile is undeniable─ it blends with several herbs and spices to complement the buttery mussels and hearty rice for an immensely satisfying culinary experience.

**EXP Bonus:** +3% **Duration:** 30m
(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

28725.name: Skybuilders' Plywood
28725.description: Sturdy enough to support the weight of several large Roegadyn. Until it isn't.

28726.name: Skybuilders' Alloy
28726.description: At this stage, it is anyone's guess what this alloy will become. If it is extremely lucky, it may even end up as a door knocker.

28727.name: Skybuilders' Steel Plate
28727.description: Unless a skilled blacksmith or armorer can intervene, this steel is doomed to spend eternity as a useless metal square.

28728.name: Skybuilders' Ingot
28728.description: Even the skybuilders themselves are not quite sure what goes into these ingots, although the general consensus is that it is nothing valuable.

28729.name: Skybuilders' Leather
28729.description: Leather made *for* skybuilders, not *from* them. Apparently.

28730.name: Skybuilders' Rope
28730.description: How long is a length of rope? In this particular rope's case, this long.

28731.name: Skybuilders' Ink
28731.description: Used for writing in ledgers to keep track of who is owed what. Considering the scale of the Ishgardian restoration, it is expected that a fair few bottles will be exhausted before the work is completed.

28732.name: Skybuilders' Hemp Milk
28732.description: By all accounts, this plant-based milk has a pleasant enough taste, though Ishgardian culinarians have yet to succeed in efforts to turn it into cheese.

28733.name: Skybuilders' Wain
28733.description: Surprisingly maneuverable, even when loaded with bricks and such.

28734.name: Skybuilders' Nails
28734.description: Thankfully, this is a handful of *metal* nails, not ones grown from the fingers of the skybuilders themselves. That would be far less pleasant.

28735.name: Skybuilders' Rivets
28735.description: Those with a penchant for having little bits of metal sticking out from every surface in sight will be delighted to receive these carefully crafted metal studs.

28736.name: Skybuilders' Rings
28736.description: An object without a clear purpose but will “probably come in handy one day,” as hoarders of useless junk are wont to say.

28737.name: Skybuilders' Leather Straps
28737.description: Can be attached to the handles of tools to allow them to be hung from belts and so forth, though care should be taken while walking to avoid having them flailing around wildly.

28738.name: Skybuilders' Cloth
28738.description: It seems this cloth is destined to become part of a comfortable couch, or perhaps a nice set of drapes.

28739.name: Skybuilders' Plant Oil
28739.description: Used in the preparation of several varieties of Ishgardian cooking and, on some occasions, as a condiment.

28740.name: Skybuilders' Uncooked Pasta
28740.description: Uncooked pasta that is perfect for eating during construction. If you like uncooked pasta.

28741.name: Skybuilders' Barrel
28741.description: The expression “a barrel of laughs” was never meant to be taken literally, though if it were, one could fit a fair few in this voluminous wooden container.

28742.name: Skybuilders' Hammer
28742.description: In days to come, this most versatile of tools will become the bane of every nail that dared to stick out. And the occasional thumb.

28743.name: Skybuilders' Cooking Pot
28743.description: In times of war, this metallic item of cookware can double as a makeshift helmet, provided the wearer has an unnaturally large head.

28744.name: Skybuilders' Candelabra
28744.description: It almost seems a shame to cover this in layers of melted wax, though sadder still would be a candelabra without a candle.

28745.name: Skybuilders' Rug
28745.description: The eventual owner of this majestic piece of thick cloth will be as snug as a bug in a rug. Or on a rug, to be precise.

28746.name: Skybuilders' Broom
28746.description: As the saying goes, “A new broom sweeps clean,” though the person wielding said broom is also due at least some of the credit for any increase in cleanliness that may result.

28747.name: Skybuilders' Charcoal
28747.description: The recipients of the other items in your inventory would probably prefer that you refrained from carrying loose pieces of charcoal about your person.

28748.name: Skybuilders' Tea
28748.description: As is tradition with tea brewed for builders, it contains enough sugar to make the spoon stand on end.

28749.name: Skybuilders' Pedestal
28749.description: Though one should avoid putting other people on a pedestal, the placement of inanimate objects should not pose any problems.

28750.name: Skybuilders' Crosscut Saw
28750.description: It is not only double-edged blades that cut both ways.

28751.name: Skybuilders' Counter
28751.description: Considering that it lacks the ability to count anything whatsoever, “counter” seems to be something of a misnomer.

28752.name: Skybuilders' Stone
28752.description: If the time you have spent in Ishgard has taught you anything, it is that the locals *really* like stone.

28753.name: Skybuilders' Longboots
28753.description: Ideal for leaping from scaffold to scaffold as one merrily frolics about the construction site, while others go about their backbreaking labor.

28754.name: Skybuilders' Gloves
28754.description: Any Ishgardian with any sense will already own a pair of gloves, but for those who do not, these will be a welcome gift.

28755.name: Skybuilders' Soap
28755.description: Be careful to whom you give this. They may think you are trying to tell them something.

28756.name: Skybuilders' All-purpose Infusion
28756.description: Though the recipe states that this mysterious concoction can cure any ailment, one must remember that it will under no circumstances reattach dismembered fingers, which is a remarkably common complaint among the skybuilders.

28757.name: Skybuilders' Bed
28757.description: Children who fail to heed the word of their parents will be sent here without any supper.

28758.name: Skybuilders' Oven
28758.description: In many Ishgardian residences, the oven doubles as a means of heating the house, with the occupants finding themselves subconsciously drawn to the kitchen during the colder months. Which is all of them.

28759.name: Skybuilders' Lamppost
28759.description: Of all the items you have managed to stow about your person, this surely ranks as one of the largest and most cumbersome. Even the most proficient of aetherochemists would be baffled by the unsolved mystery of your impossibly deep pockets.

28760.name: Skybuilders' Brazier
28760.description: Not only can this be used for the cooking of various dishes, it also works wonders in the prevention of frostbite, as many residents of the Brume will attest.

28761.name: Skybuilders' Overalls
28761.description: Designed to be worn on top of other layers of clothing to protect them from dust and dirt and provide additional protection against the cold. Since Ishgardians tend to wear several layers of clothing to begin with, these overalls are cut much larger than those worn in warmer climes.

28762.name: Skybuilders' Waterproof Sheet
28762.description: Serves to keep out not only water, but wind as well, though the cold inevitably finds a way through eventually.

28763.name: Skybuilders' Alchemic
28763.description: One of many concoctions that serves little purpose on its own, but can be mixed with others for a variety of effects upon consumption, the large majority being some sort of agonizing death.

28764.name: Skybuilders' Stew
28764.description: One unfortunate rail was left to stew in its own juices after finding its way into the pot. Literally.

28887.name: Invincible Orchestrion Roll
28887.description: Music roll for *Invincible*. Use to add to your orchestrion list.

28960.name: Rough Stone Interior Wall
28960.description: An imposing interior wall of haphazardly arranged hunks of stone.

28961.name: Rough Stone Flooring
28961.description: Unpolished flagstone─for everyone's favorite seedy tavern ambience.

28962.name: Wooden Chandelier
28962.description: Ideal for swinging on with roguish grace─though do try not to burn the place down.

28965.name: Cosmetics Box
28965.description: This enormous case is replete with enough paints and powders to satisfy an entire Eorzean theater troupe─or one Eulmoran dame.

28970.name: Dish Rack
28970.description: A spacious box in which to dry dishware, with accompanying mat for glasses.

28973.name: Manor Dressing Table
28973.description: A haunting dressing table custom-made for Haukke Manor. ...In retrospect, Lady Amandine wasn't very subtle about the whole voidsent issue.

28974.name: Cheese Collection
28974.description: Why in the gods' name would a person amass such an amount of cheese? A peculiar obsession? A craving that transcends all reason? Some manner of cheese-related divination known only to a forbidden sect? Whatever the reason, one can only hope that the results are still saleable.

28975.name: Oldrose Wall Planter
28975.description: A riot of vibrant red and pale pink blooms within this quaint wall-mounted box.

28976.name: Folded Futon
28976.description: Put it away─quick, before the guests see!

28977.name: The Bismarck
28977.description:
Impressive enough to bear the name of Limsa's premier culinary establishment as its own, this is the sort of sandwich one eats off of a *nice* plate.

※Cannot be retrieved once used.
※Can be used up to 10 times.

Meal benefits when used:
  **Tenacity Bonus:** +4% (Max 10)
  **VIT Bonus:** +5% (Max 12)
  **Gear Durability Bonus:** +3
  **EXP Bonus:** +3%
  **Duration:** 30m
  (Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

28978.name: Devil's Salad Bowl
28978.description:
A pleasant mix of crisp greens topped by satisfying and zesty deviled eggs.

※Cannot be retrieved once used.
※Can be used up to 10 times.

Meal benefits when used:
  **Critical Hit Bonus:** +4% (Max 10)
  **VIT Bonus:** +5% (Max 12)
  **Gear Durability Bonus:** +3
  **EXP Bonus:** +3%
  **Duration:** 30m
  (Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

28983.name: Picnic Basket
28983.description: Includes everything required for a sunlit meal in the outdoors.

28984.name: First Chair's Trumpet
28984.description: Designed in homage to a legendary trumpeter, its majesty may someday inspire someone to finally pick up that instrument they have been meaning to learn.

28991.name: Used Banquet Table
28991.description: There's no telling how many banquets have been eaten off of this table.

28992.name: Steppe Bed
28992.description: Sleep as soundly as the nomadic peoples of the Azim Steppe do.

28994.name: Ruby Weapon Bust
28994.description:
The heart of this Garlond Ironworks scale replica of a select portion of the Ruby Weapon pulsates menacingly. Accept no substitutes.

※One per estate only.

29402.name: Ruby Barding
29402.description: A suit of chocobo armor designed to resemble the Ruby Weapon.

29492.name: Grade 3 Tincture of Strength
29492.description:
This diluted brew temporarily increases strength for twice the duration of similar potions.

**Duration:** 30s

29493.name: Grade 3 Tincture of Dexterity
29493.description:
This diluted brew temporarily increases dexterity for twice the duration of similar potions.

**Duration:** 30s

29494.name: Grade 3 Tincture of Vitality
29494.description:
This diluted brew temporarily increases vitality for twice the duration of similar potions.

**Duration:** 30s

29495.name: Grade 3 Tincture of Intelligence
29495.description:
This diluted brew temporarily increases intelligence for twice the duration of similar potions.

**Duration:** 30s

29496.name: Grade 3 Tincture of Mind
29496.description:
This diluted brew temporarily increases mind for twice the duration of similar potions.

**Duration:** 30s

29497.name: Ovim Meatballs
29497.description:
Savory, round chunks of minced ovim meat accented with a lingonberry sauce that's sweet yet tart.

**EXP Bonus:** +3% **Duration:** 30m
(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

29498.name: Mors
29498.description:
A traditional beverage brewed from the extract of fermented lingonberries.

**EXP Bonus:** +3% **Duration:** 30m
(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

29499.name: Lemon Waffle
29499.description:
Crispy on the outside and moist on the inside, this baked delight with a distinctive texture has a slight hint of citrus.

**EXP Bonus:** +3% **Duration:** 30m
(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

29500.name: Honey Croissant
29500.description:
A flaky, decadent pastry sweetened with rich, golden honey.

**EXP Bonus:** +3% **Duration:** 30m
(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

29501.name: Sausage and Sauerkraut
29501.description:
Aromatic, herb-seasoned meat and pickled cabbage come together in a mouthwatering combination.

**EXP Bonus:** +3% **Duration:** 30m
(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

29502.name: Stuffed Highland Cabbage
29502.description:
This traditional dish of minced meat seasoned and packed inside leafy highland cabbage, then stewed in a light broth, is sure to warm you up on the coldest of nights.

**EXP Bonus:** +3% **Duration:** 30m
(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

29503.name: Pickled Herring
29503.description:
Succulent chunks of platinum herring marinated in vinegar and topped with finely sliced lemonette to give it a hint of tang.

**EXP Bonus:** +3% **Duration:** 30m
(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

29504.name: Herring Pie
29504.description:
Chunks of seasoned herring baked into a flaky crust that's been shaped like a fish so as to inform the eater to expect savory instead of sweet.

**EXP Bonus:** +3% **Duration:** 30m
(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

29505.name: Farmer's Breakfast
29505.description:
This simple-yet-delightful dish of popotoes and lightly scrambled eggs will fill you up before a day of tilling the fields.

**EXP Bonus:** +3% **Duration:** 30m
(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

29506.name: Silkie Pudding
29506.description:
The distinctively smooth texture and rich taste of this lightly sweet, boiled dessert will have your mouth watering.

**EXP Bonus:** +3% **Duration:** 30m
(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

29645.name: Oddly Specific Petrified Orb
29645.description: A sphere of fossilized wood sanded to exacting specifications.

29646.name: Oddly Specific Rivets
29646.description: Far too many painstakingly forged metal bolts.

29648.name: Oddly Specific Whetstone
29648.description: Whether this whetstone is materially much different from others or simply much more aesthetically appealing is difficult to discern.

29649.name: Oddly Specific Leather
29649.description: It is fortunate that the Skysteel engineers provided instructions as to how this leather ought to be tanned, as it is still impossible to tell what manner of creature it came from.

29651.name: Oddly Specific Synthetic Resin
29651.description: This compound is the result of hours of painstaking experimentation─which likely could have been avoided if the Skysteel engineers who ordered it had thought to provide the ratio of ingredients alongside their excruciatingly detailed description of what the end result ought to look, smell, and taste like.

29652.name: Oddly Specific Seed Extract
29652.description: An exact quantity of extract produced through an exacting extraction process.

29653.name: Oddly Specific Shaft
29653.description: Neillemard doubtless regrets allowing Denys to write out the order sheet for this particular material.

29654.name: Oddly Specific Fitting
29654.description: On one hand, it is a relatively simple matter to understand why precision in the measurement and shaping of this joining piece is required. On the other, the instructions also requested that it “smell lightly of La Noscean orange,” so perhaps some skepticism is warranted.

29655.name: Oddly Specific Chainmail Sheet
29655.description: Far too many painstakingly forged metal links, fastened together equally painstakingly.

29656.name: Oddly Specific Gemstone
29656.description: A jewel cut and polished to perfection─or arbitrary preference. One of the two.

29657.name: Oddly Specific Vellum
29657.description: This page has been trimmed and prepared for its likely use in drafting plans.

29658.name: Oddly Specific Velvet
29658.description: The depth and density of this cloth's plush pile has been measured to 1/1000th of an ilm.

29659.name: Oddly Specific Glass
29659.description: This pane is “see-through, but not *too* see-through,” precisely as ordered.

29660.name: Oddly Specific Seed Flour
29660.description: A fine powder, ground and sifted with extraordinary─some might even say excessive─precision.

29680.name: Mahogany Aqueduct
29680.description: Reliable and stylish irrigation well suited to residential properties.

29681.name: Crystallized Coral
29681.description: This crystallized mass of coral matches almost any color scheme one could imagine.

29683.name: Siphon Coffee Brewer
29683.description: Many a connoisseur have sworn off all other methods of making coffee after trying a single sip of a cup made with this one.

29684.name: Fat Cat Wall Chronometer
29684.description: This convenient timekeeping device will always remind you when it is time to eat─unless, of course, it is time for your pets to eat, in which case you will be repeatedly reminded long before you have the chance to consult your timepiece.

29685.name: Bomb Cauldron
29685.description: Crafted with painstaking attention to detail, put this cauldron in any room to terrify guests and pets alike.

29686.name: Ronkan Rocking Chair
29686.description: A rocking chair representing Ronkan resourcefulness and resilience.

29687.name: Brick Garden Wall
29687.description: A portion of brick wall that would complement nearly any garden, be it full of flowers or full of more subdued plant life.

29792.name: Grade 2 Skybuilders' Plywood
29792.description: While this could be combined with a few bricks to create a makeshift bench, that may fall somewhat short of the skybuilders' rather more lofty aspirations.

29793.name: Grade 2 Skybuilders' Alloy
29793.description: Even in its current state, it would make a functional, if not especially elegant, murder weapon.

29794.name: Grade 2 Skybuilders' Steel Plate
29794.description: To some, it may seem a shame to ruin such a beautifully square piece of metal by battering it with a hammer.

29795.name: Grade 2 Skybuilders' Ingot
29795.description: These would make a suitable substitute for house bricks were it not for their natural propensity to conduct cold, which is less than ideal in the freezing climes of Ishgard.

29796.name: Grade 2 Skybuilders' Leather
29796.description: Considered to be particularly valuable, especially by the creature to which it originally belonged.

29797.name: Grade 2 Skybuilders' Rope
29797.description: Perfectly suited to pulling heavy objects. Less well suited to pushing them.

29798.name: Grade 2 Skybuilders' Ink
29798.description: While some may question the skybuilders' need for a specific type of ink, it is believed that this particular variety is more resistant to the cold. After all, frozen ink does not lend itself well to fine penmanship, or any sort of penmanship, for that matter.

29799.name: Grade 2 Skybuilders' Hemp Milk
29799.description: While the layman may question exactly how one goes about milking a plant, the process is much the same as milking anything else: you give it a damned good squeeze and hope for the best.

29800.name: Grade 2 Skybuilders' Crate
29800.description: Despite much of the work in the Firmament involving taking supplies *out of* boxes, the need occasionally arises to put them *into* boxes instead. Suggestions that the skybuilders simply reuse the boxes they already have were immediately shot down, presumably by someone who stands to profit from the production of new containers.

29801.name: Grade 2 Skybuilders' Nails
29801.description: Never was the description “tough as nails” more apt, because they are, in fact, nails.

29802.name: Grade 2 Skybuilders' Rivets
29802.description: Despite their name, discussions on these commonplace metal studs tend to be anything but riveting.

29803.name: Grade 2 Skybuilders' Rings
29803.description: Attempting to impress a potential spouse by presenting one of these mass-produced metallic circles will generally end in failure, and perhaps even a slap in the face for good measure.

29804.name: Grade 2 Skybuilders' Leather Straps
29804.description: Some may wonder whether this leather was in fact more useful before it was cut into long strips. It could have been used to make a nice coat, for example.

29805.name: Grade 2 Skybuilders' Cloth
29805.description: As the popular Coerthan adage attests, “One can never have too much cloth.”

29806.name: Grade 2 Skybuilders' Plant Oil
29806.description: Not only is it used by chefs, but also masseuses. Unfortunately, there is not much call for such work in Ishgard, as the general consensus is that clothes are best kept on at all times unless absolutely necessary.

29807.name: Grade 2 Skybuilders' Bread
29807.description: While it is true that man cannot live on bread alone, a little bit here and there certainly does not go amiss.

29808.name: Grade 2 Skybuilders' Grindstone
29808.description: Clearly, the expression “nose to the grindstone” was not meant to be taken literally, though some have chosen to find this out the hard way.

29809.name: Grade 2 Skybuilders' Hammer
29809.description: Tenderizing pork with this craftsman's tool does not, as one might be forgiven for thinking given the name, turn it into ham.

29810.name: Grade 2 Skybuilders' Still
29810.description: This bizarre contraption is coveted by alchemists and culinarians alike. When asked for what purpose, the response is generally along the lines of, “Mumble, mumble, steam, mumble, mumble.”

29811.name: Grade 2 Skybuilders' Embroidery Frame
29811.description: A firm favorite among ladies of leisure, oft held mid-stitch as they gaze wistfully from the window of their opulent bedchamber, high in their metaphorical─and in some cases, actual─ivory tower.

29812.name: Grade 2 Skybuilders' Rug
29812.description: Some things are best swept under one of these.

29813.name: Grade 2 Skybuilders' Broom
29813.description: Those expecting this perfectly ordinary broom to start speaking backwards or sweeping floors of its own accord will be disappointed to find it does neither, unless a passing witch is in the mood for a couple of incantations.

29814.name: Grade 2 Skybuilders' Dye
29814.description: Those thinking about using this colorful dye for their own purposes should put such thoughts aside, as it is strictly for skybuilder use only. After all, one can hardly expect them to go about their work deprived of the ability to turn something purple at a moment's notice.

29815.name: Grade 2 Skybuilders' Tea
29815.description: Skybuilders have garnered a reputation for punctuating their work with frequent tea breaks. The number of cups drunk by a laborer over the course of a single day can easily reach double digits.

29816.name: Grade 2 Skybuilders' Stepladder
29816.description: Unlike most other items requested by the skybuilders, this one actually seems to serve some practical purpose. It can even be carried on one shoulder, allowing the bearer to pivot quickly, which leads to all sorts of hilarity as their colleagues attempt, often in vain, to avoid having their skull cracked.

29817.name: Grade 2 Skybuilders' Crosscut Saw
29817.description: The sound it makes as it cleaves through timber is akin to that of a person snoring. One particular linguist even went so far as to investigate a possible connection between the words “sawing” and “snoring,” and to no one's surprise but her own, discovered that nothing of the sort exists.

29818.name: Grade 2 Skybuilders' Mesail
29818.description: Perfect for protecting one's face from the accusing glares of innocent bystanders during daylight robberies and so forth, although the skybuilders have a far more pedestrian use in mind.

29819.name: Grade 2 Skybuilders' Stone
29819.description: A strong contender for the heaviest item requested by the skybuilders. How the volunteers are expected to transport these without an exceedingly sturdy cart is anyone's guess.

29820.name: Grade 2 Skybuilders' Longboots
29820.description: As the name implies, these boots are what some might consider long, although longer still are the grade 2 skybuilders' longlongboots.

29821.name: Grade 2 Skybuilders' Gloves
29821.description: Keepers of hounds with the tendency to bite the hand that feeds will be delighted to receive a pair of these fine gloves. The smooth lining allows the wearer to slip out easily, leaving said dog with a mouthful of tough leather, which it will soon learn makes a poor substitute for proper food.

29822.name: Grade 2 Skybuilders' Soap
29822.description: When combined with an empty stocking, can be used as a makeshift weapon. In Ishgard, this appears to be the most common use, since many residents have discovered that the need to wash is largely mitigated by the wearing of multiple layers of thick clothing, which does little to prevent bodily odor, but does cause it to take longer to seep through and reach the nostrils of those in the immediate vicinity.

29823.name: Grade 2 Skybuilders' All-purpose Infusion
29823.description: There may be uncertainty surrounding its exact effects, although one thing is clear: it definitely tastes as if it does one good. That is to say, revolting.

29824.name: Grade 2 Skybuilders' Bed
29824.description: As it stands only a few ilms off of the floor, any things that go bump in the night will have trouble squeezing under this particular bed.

29825.name: Grade 2 Skybuilders' Oven
29825.description: Complete with raging fire and billowing smoke, which, while impressive, does make it rather troublesome to transport.

29826.name: Grade 2 Skybuilders' Lamppost
29826.description: Those with high ceilings in their chambers may wish to employ this as a rather extravagant bedside reading light.

29827.name: Grade 2 Skybuilders' Brazier
29827.description: Any meat fried on this outdoor brazier produces smoke with the uncanny ability to find its way into the eyes of those foolish enough to wander too near.

29828.name: Grade 2 Skybuilders' Overalls
29828.description: Designed to be worn on top of other, nicer clothes. Ideal for those who like to muck out their chocobo stables immediately before going for afternoon tea with an overbearing but wealthy aunt.

29829.name: Grade 2 Skybuilders' Gazebo
29829.description: Purpose-built for picnics in the great outdoors, protecting those beneath from any untimely precipitation. Unfortunately, the snow in most parts of Coerthas tends to fall in a rather sideways fashion, thus rendering this gazebo entirely pointless.

29830.name: Grade 2 Skybuilders' Alchemic
29830.description: The joy gained from sampling its fragrance─reminiscent of summer meadows─normally only lasts until the caustic vapors burn the skin from the inside of one's nostrils.

29831.name: Grade 2 Skybuilders' Stew
29831.description: The term “potluck” applies perfectly to this particular dish, as it is traditionally assembled from whatever the chef can dig up from an often poorly lit pantry. The fact that rats tend to squeak and wriggle a fair bit when picked up is probably all that prevents them from being added to the mix. The dead ones, on the other hand...

29832.name: Grade 2 Artisanal Skybuilders' Wardrobe
29832.description: If, for any reason, one has the need to hide inside, such as the unexpected return of one of the residents and so on, the air holes provided should prevent untimely suffocation. Not that there is such a thing as “timely suffocation.”

29833.name: Grade 2 Artisanal Skybuilders' Chandelier
29833.description: Most of the diamonds are actually imitations, but thankfully, chandeliers are usually positioned high enough that no one will notice.

29834.name: Grade 2 Artisanal Skybuilders' Fireplace
29834.description: The ideal place to put a fire, hence the clever name. Well, the last part, that is.

29835.name: Grade 2 Artisanal Skybuilders' Bathtub
29835.description: In mankind's ongoing quest to keep “water” and “not water” ever separate, few inventions have done more to further the cause than the humble bathtub.

29836.name: Grade 2 Artisanal Skybuilders' Overcoat
29836.description: If dapperness could be captured, refined, and made into a wearable material, that is what this fine garment would be made from. Until then, cloth and leather will have to suffice.

29837.name: Grade 2 Artisanal Skybuilders' Wallpaper
29837.description: Generally less messy than covering walls with paint, although its natural tendency to tear and wrinkle with the slightest provocation is enough to make a saint swear.

29838.name: Grade 2 Artisanal Skybuilders' Remedies
29838.description: It is assumed that each of these glass phials contains something useful, as none of them are labeled. Identification by taste is probably best left to a professional or someone who is not opposed to being lightly poisoned.

29839.name: Grade 2 Artisanal Skybuilders' Quiche
29839.description: In cases such as these, “artisanal” actually means “so complex that even the chef doesn't remember what went into it,” hence the impossibility of replicating the recipe.

29876.name: Approved Grade 2 Skybuilders' Crystal-clear Rock Salt

29877.name: Approved Grade 2 Skybuilders' Cloud Drop Water

29881.name: Approved Grade 2 Artisanal Skybuilders' Hardened Sap

29883.name: Approved Grade 2 Artisanal Skybuilders' Cotton Boll

29884.name: Approved Grade 2 Artisanal Skybuilders' Dawn Lizard

29886.name: Approved Grade 2 Artisanal Skybuilders' Rock Salt

29887.name: Approved Grade 2 Artisanal Skybuilders' Spring Water

29888.name: Approved Grade 2 Artisanal Skybuilders' Aurum Regis Sand

29890.name: Approved Grade 2 Skybuilders' Umbral Galewood Log

29958.name: Cobalt Alloy Ingot
29958.description: An ingot of smelted cobalt alloy.

29961.name: Duskcourt Cloth
29961.description: Finely woven cloth with that distinctive duskbloom hue that says, “wealthier than you.”

29962.name: Megalania Leather
29962.description: A large piece of cured megalania skin.

29963.name: Grade 3 Strength Alkahest
29963.description: When applied to items such as battle gear, this experimental alchemical liquid will dissolve away minute amounts of aether aspected to elements detrimental to strength, and by doing so, better attune the item and its wearer to the remaining beneficial elements.

29964.name: Grade 3 Dexterity Alkahest
29964.description: When applied to items such as battle gear, this experimental alchemical liquid will dissolve away minute amounts of aether aspected to elements detrimental to dexterity, and by doing so, better attune the item and its wearer to the remaining beneficial elements.

29965.name: Grade 3 Vitality Alkahest
29965.description: When applied to items such as battle gear, this experimental alchemical liquid will dissolve away minute amounts of aether aspected to elements detrimental to vitality, and by doing so, better attune the item and its wearer to the remaining beneficial elements.

29966.name: Grade 3 Intelligence Alkahest
29966.description: When applied to items such as battle gear, this experimental alchemical liquid will dissolve away minute amounts of aether aspected to elements detrimental to intelligence, and by doing so, better attune the item and its wearer to the remaining beneficial elements.

29967.name: Grade 3 Mind Alkahest
29967.description: When applied to items such as battle gear, this experimental alchemical liquid will dissolve away minute amounts of aether aspected to elements detrimental to mind, and by doing so, better attune the item and its wearer to the remaining beneficial elements.

30251.name: Ultima (The Primals) Orchestrion Roll
30251.description: Music roll for *Ultima (The Primals)*. Use to add to your orchestrion list.

30378.name: Factory Interior Wall
30378.description: An industrial wall resembling those seen in the Copied Factory.

30380.name: Factory Chandelier
30380.description: A rusted metal lighting fixture unlike any to which you are accustomed.

30381.name: Trophy of Light
30381.description:
A wall-mounted sword and shield to mark your victory in a battle of like wills.

※One per estate only.

30385.name: Wooden Staircase Bookshelf
30385.description: Versatile book storage that doubles as tiered shelving for other knickknacks.

30387.name: Bluebird Mobile
30387.description: If one bluebird brings happiness, surely those who adorn their homes with this revolving display have naught to fear─aside from taking a faux bluebird to the eye should they move carelessly.

30388.name: Nomad's Tent
30388.description: A little piece of the Azim Steppe, created by trade-minded Xaela using traditional methods and materials.

30389.name: Stage Curtain
30389.description: This sumptuous curtain impresses upon audiences that what they are about to witness is no two-gil production.

30390.name: Floor Sofa
30390.description: A spacious seating option for those who prefer to remain at floor level.

30391.name: Tako-yaki Boat
30391.description:
A steaming and sauce-slathered serving of enough doughy fried octopus to share.

※Cannot be retrieved once used.
※Can be used up to 10 times.

Meal benefits when used:
  **Determination Bonus:** +4% (Max 10)
  **VIT Bonus:** +5% (Max 12)
  **Gear Durability Bonus:** +3
  **EXP Bonus:** +3%
  **Duration:** 30m
  (Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

30393.name: Barrel Table
30393.description: This reused cask screams “adventure!” Or perhaps “alcohol,” depending on what sort of tavern patron you are.

30394.name: Indoor Pond
30394.description: Bring the outdoors indoors with this perfect imitation of nature. Toads not included...or are they?

30395.name: Giant Beaver Burger Set
30395.description:
No actual beavers were harmed in the making of this massive burger.

※Cannot be retrieved once used.
※Can be used up to 10 times.

Meal benefits when used:
  **Critical Hit Bonus:** +4% (Max 10)
  **VIT Bonus:** +5% (Max 12)
  **Gear Durability Bonus:** +3
  **EXP Bonus:** +3%
  **Duration:** 30m
  (Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

30396.name: Red Brick Kitchen
30396.description: This rustic outdoor cooking facility is more than capable of keeping any amount of garden party guests well fed.

30400.name: Factory Grate
30400.description: A rusted piece of grating. Watch your toes.

30401.name: Factory Staircase
30401.description: These metallic stairs make a satisfying clunking noise when stepped on. You know the one.

30402.name: Factory Railing
30402.description: An industrial safety rail. Given the visible wear and tear, one of those adjectives may have become less applicable over time.

30404.name: Factory Automatic Door
30404.description: The internal mechanisms that allow this door to open and close on its own remain something of a mystery. Luckily, this one was ripped from its surroundings wholesale, and operates regardless.

30406.name: Factory Wall Lamp
30406.description: A grimy lamp extracted from the machine graveyard.

30407.name: Factory Bench
30407.description: An iron bench that remains sturdy despite having seen better days.

30410.name: Marble Alcove Bed
30410.description: This indulgent bed frame constitutes an entire wall, and will banish any illusions guests might have held regarding your humility.

30421.name: Oriental Wooden Deck
30421.description: A slatted deck in the Far Eastern fashion, perfect for quiet contemplation or loud consumption of dango.

30427.name: Sliced Watermelon
30427.description:
This juicy, fresh-cut watermelon makes the perfect summer treat.

※Cannot be retrieved once used.
※Can be used up to 10 times.

Meal benefits when used:
  **Tenacity Bonus:** +4% (Max 10)
  **VIT Bonus:** +5% (Max 12)
  **Gear Durability Bonus:** +3
  **EXP Bonus:** +3%
  **Duration:** 30m
  (Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

30481.name: Crab Cakes
30481.description:
To preserve the toothsome texture of blue crab, chunks of flesh are gently folded into flour and molded into cakes, which are panfried to golden perfection.

**EXP Bonus:** +3% **Duration:** 30m
(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

30482.name: Chili Crab
30482.description:
A whole blue crab braised in its shell in a piquant sauce, which takes on a rich shellfish flavor in the course of cooking.

**EXP Bonus:** +3% **Duration:** 30m
(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

30483.name: Brashgold Plate
30483.description: A sheet of highly durable brashgold plate.

30484.name: Defthand's Dissolvent
30484.description: When applied to crafting or gathering gear, this alchemical liquid will dissolve away minute amounts of aether aspected to elements detrimental to dexterity, and by doing so, better attune the item and its wearer to the remaining beneficial elements.

30493.name: Custom Gathering Tool Components
30493.description: A variety of components necessary to create a tool a dragon can use for gathering.

30494.name: Custom Weaving Components
30494.description: A variety of components necessary to create a tool a dragon can use for weaving.

30495.name: Custom Crafting Tool Components
30495.description: A variety of components necessary to create a tool a dragon can use for crafting.

30496.name: Handpicked Culinary Essentials
30496.description: A variety of culinary essentials necessary to create a feast fit for dragons.

30497.name: Printing Essentials
30497.description: A variety of essentials that any budding author would be proud to use to print their book.

30678.name: True Barding of Light
30678.description: A suit of chocobo armor designed to resemble an ancient hero not wholly unlike yourself.

30828.name: Suzaku's Flame-kissed Pinions
30828.description: ※Weapon appearance may take precedence over the display of hand gear.

30970.name: Rarefied Cedar Longbow
30970.description:
A fine hunter's bow to display alongside that buffalo head above the fireplace. Which was also purchased.

※For collectable submissions only.

30971.name: Rarefied Cedar Fishing Rod
30971.description:
A shame this beautiful rod will likely never feel a drop of water, fresh or otherwise.

※For collectable submissions only.

30972.name: Rarefied Holy Cedar Spinning Wheel
30972.description:
This cedar spinning wheel will look stunning collecting dust in the sewing room.

※For collectable submissions only.

30973.name: Rarefied Dark Chestnut Rod
30973.description:
A dark, chestnut rod that whispers dark, chestnut lies about its owner's nonexistent magical talents.

※For collectable submissions only.

30974.name: Rarefied Hallowed Chestnut Ring
30974.description:
A lovingly carved ring to sit in a lovingly curated collection.

※For collectable submissions only.

30975.name: Rarefied Birch Signum
30975.description:
“No, dear, it's not a *cane*, it's a *signum*.”

※For collectable submissions only.

30976.name: Rarefied Beech Composite Bow
30976.description:
For when those “fancy” bows simply aren't fancy enough.

※For collectable submissions only.

30977.name: Rarefied Larch Necklace
30977.description:
A necklace of wood never looked this good.

※For collectable submissions only.

30978.name: Rarefied Pine Cane
30978.description:
Tool of conjury, or eye-catching centerpiece? You decide.

※For collectable submissions only.

30979.name: Rarefied Persimmon Bracelets
30979.description:
The percussive pleasure of pronouncing “persimmon” when replying to the predictable question.

※For collectable submissions only.

30980.name: Rarefied Zelkova Spinning Wheel
30980.description:
If you don't have one in zelkova, do you really have a spinning wheel collection?

※For collectable submissions only.

30981.name: Rarefied White Oak Partisan
30981.description:
A stately weapon, regal in appearance and lethal in practice. To be locked in a showcase.

※For collectable submissions only.

30982.name: Rarefied Applewood Staff
30982.description:
She had that applewood staff and the robes with the fur (with the fur!). The whole collector's club will be looking at her.

※For collectable submissions only.

30983.name: Rarefied White Ash Earrings
30983.description:
The pinnacle of wooden ear accessories for the discerning collector.

※For collectable submissions only.

30984.name: Rarefied Sandteak Fauchard
30984.description:
“Forget an eye─you could take someone's whole face off with that thing. Put it back on the wall.”

※For collectable submissions only.

30985.name: Rarefied Mythrite Katzbalger
30985.description:
A wonderful martial showpiece...if you can lift the bloody thing onto the table.

※For collectable submissions only.

30986.name: Rarefied Mythrite Pugiones
30986.description:
Just don't let the servants catch you slinking around in the dark, pretending to be a shadow warrior.

※For collectable submissions only.

30987.name: Rarefied Mythrite Halfheart Saw
30987.description:
The more expensive the mythrite, the more exquisite the cut. That's how it works...right?

※For collectable submissions only.

30988.name: Rarefied Titanium Creasing Knife
30988.description:
“What do you mean, 'what do I need it for?' Why, for *creasing* things, of course!”

※For collectable submissions only.

30989.name: Rarefied Titanium Mortar
30989.description:
The hardest part about owning this collector's dream is resisting the urge to see what things can be ground into a fine, smooth paste.

※For collectable submissions only.

30990.name: Rarefied Adamantite Bill
30990.description:
Large letter-opening problems require large letter-opener solutions.

※For collectable submissions only.

30991.name: Rarefied High Steel Guillotine
30991.description:
No smudgy fingerprints on the blade, or heads will roll.

※For collectable submissions only.

30992.name: Rarefied High Steel Claw Hammer
30992.description:
To complement that set of rarefied high steel nails.

※For collectable submissions only.

30993.name: Rarefied Doman Iron Uchigatana
30993.description:
Don't try checking the blade to see if it's sharp. It's sharp.

※For collectable submissions only.

30994.name: Rarefied Doman Steel Patas
30994.description:
A fine addition to any collection of eye-poking weaponry forged from Far Eastern materials.

※For collectable submissions only.

30995.name: Rarefied Molybdenum Pliers
30995.description:
“They're made of molydem...moldybe...a special kind of metal!”

※For collectable submissions only.

30996.name: Rarefied Deepgold Anelace
30996.description:
An anelace forged from the deepest gold, purchased by those with the deepest pockets.

※For collectable submissions only.

30997.name: Rarefied Deepgold Culinary Knife
30997.description:
Food tastes all the richer when prepared with this luxury utensil.

※For collectable submissions only.

30998.name: Rarefied Bluespirit Gunblade
30998.description:
“Placed in front of the window, the blade catches the morning sunlight *just so*.”

※For collectable submissions only.

30999.name: Rarefied Titanbronze Pickaxe
30999.description:
An epic tool destined for an attic stool.

※For collectable submissions only.

31000.name: Rarefied Mythrite Sallet
31000.description:
“Yes, I have the sallet. I'll be after the hauberk, next.”

※For collectable submissions only.

31001.name: Rarefied Mythrite Hauberk
31001.description:
“Now I have the hauberk, I suppose I must have the matching sallet.”

※For collectable submissions only.

31002.name: Rarefied Mythrite Bladed Lantern Shield
31002.description:
A finely wrought shield for a less-civilized age.

※For collectable submissions only.

31003.name: Rarefied Titanium Frypan
31003.description:
To be hung from a kitchen hook and admired as you pass through on your way to the Bismarck.

※For collectable submissions only.

31004.name: Rarefied Titanium Vambraces
31004.description:
“He was wearing them to prune the rose bushes. Unbelievable.”

※For collectable submissions only.

31005.name: Rarefied Adamantite Scutum
31005.description:
Such a coveted item will surely deflect the slings and arrows of your collection's critics...be they real or metaphorical.

※For collectable submissions only.

31006.name: Rarefied High Steel Thermal Alembic
31006.description:
Wait until your friends at the potion-making society see this shiny new toy. Envy guaranteed.

※For collectable submissions only.

31007.name: Rarefied High Steel Plate Belt
31007.description:
