Beautiful when displayed alone, but be warned─this is a gateway piece to collecting entire suits.

※For collectable submissions only.

31008.name: Rarefied Doman Iron Greaves
31008.description:
“I wasn't going to wear them <clunk> but the sound is so <clunk> satisfying!”

※For collectable submissions only.

31009.name: Rarefied Doman Steel Tabard
31009.description:
An impressive piece─though some collectors are disappointed to discover the “tabard” itself isn't actually made of Doman steel.

※For collectable submissions only.

31010.name: Rarefied Molybdenum Headgear
31010.description:
Never ask dedicated headgear enthusiasts how the thin strips of molybdenum protect the face...because they will tell you.

※For collectable submissions only.

31011.name: Rarefied Deepgold Cuirass
31011.description:
This classic (and expensive) edition of the deepgold cuirass might grace a manor entry hall or private study. “Battle-scarring” optional.

※For collectable submissions only.

31012.name: Rarefied Deepgold Wings
31012.description:
Such elegant design and divine workmanship could only be the work of the gods─or one highly determined and talented artisan.

※For collectable submissions only.

31013.name: Rarefied Bluespirit Gauntlets
31013.description:
Some armor aficionados claim that, with these splendid full-length gauntlets equipped, no other bodily protection is necessary.

※For collectable submissions only.

31014.name: Rarefied Titanbronze Tower Shield
31014.description:
“No, no, *titan*bronze. Far sturdier. A true masterpiece of a shield.”

※For collectable submissions only.

31015.name: Rarefied Mythrite Goggles
31015.description:
When one's eyesight is essential to one's livelihood, one cannot stint on the *proper* protections.

※For collectable submissions only.

31016.name: Rarefied Mythrite Bangle
31016.description:
It may appear exactly the same as other mythrite bangles, but this one is *special*.

※For collectable submissions only.

31017.name: Rarefied Mythrite Needle
31017.description:
A needle sufficiently fine to embroider the details of every leaf of vegetation on a goobbue's head.

※For collectable submissions only.

31018.name: Rarefied Hardsilver Monocle
31018.description:
“They said it provides an immediate +10 to sophistication! ...Nay, I've no idea what that means either.”

※For collectable submissions only.

31019.name: Rarefied Hardsilver Pole
31019.description:
All those moving parts help cycle the aether more efficiently. It's science! ...Magick science.

※For collectable submissions only.

31020.name: Rarefied Aurum Regis Earrings
31020.description:
A serious collector of aurum regis wares would never use these tiny sword-shaped accessories to stage tiny mock duels.

※For collectable submissions only.

31021.name: Rarefied Koppranickel Planisphere
31021.description:
Though its true majesty can only be appreciated when put in motion by an astrologian, this eccentric planisphere is nevertheless a fascinating talking point.

※For collectable submissions only.

31022.name: Rarefied Koppranickel Necklace
31022.description:
When one has experience collecting pointy necklaces, one quickly learns not to nod too vigorously.

※For collectable submissions only.

31023.name: Rarefied Durium Chaplets
31023.description:
The trick to displaying a stunning pair of chaplets is posing the fingers in a suitably mystical gesture. No, not that one.

※For collectable submissions only.

31024.name: Rarefied Durium Rod
31024.description:
Ornate. Gothic. Black. Purple. Gold. For when you really need a rod that screams “black mage.”

※For collectable submissions only.

31025.name: Rarefied Palladium Needle
31025.description:
Obsessed with tools made of materials that begin with the letter “P”? Look no further.

※For collectable submissions only.

31026.name: Rarefied Stonegold Degen
31026.description:
The epitome of style and elegance, with a hilt long enough for a six-fingered man.

※For collectable submissions only.

31027.name: Rarefied Stonegold Orrery
31027.description:
“A limited edition stonegold orrery? I must have one! ...What does it do?”

※For collectable submissions only.

31028.name: Rarefied Manasilver Ear Cuffs
31028.description:
How these ear cuffs improve craftsmanship is anyone's guess...but they sure are pretty.

※For collectable submissions only.

31029.name: Rarefied Titanbronze Headgear
31029.description:
Another set of headgear that should provide minimal protection, but it *is* made of titanbronze, so...

※For collectable submissions only.

31030.name: Rarefied Archaeoskin Belt
31030.description:
Sturdy, fashionable, and it has a pouch to hold your stuff!

※For collectable submissions only.

31031.name: Rarefied Archaeoskin Cloche
31031.description:
While an archaeornis is not what most would consider a “pretty” creature, this hat made from its leather is a feather in anyone's cap.

※For collectable submissions only.

31032.name: Rarefied Wyvernskin Mask
31032.description:
When you need to enhance your mystical talents whilst scaring the neighborhood children, this terrifyingly practical mask has you covered.

※For collectable submissions only.

31033.name: Rarefied Dhalmelskin Coat
31033.description:
Crafted from real dhalmel leather, this coat is prized for its “pre-weathered” appearance.

※For collectable submissions only.

31034.name: Rarefied Dragonskin Ring
31034.description:
Nothing quite compares to the feeling of wearing a ring which necessitated the slaying of an entire dragon.

※For collectable submissions only.

31035.name: Rarefied Serpentskin Hat
31035.description:
Crafted in the classic style, this shiny specimen of haberdashery will be the talk of the local coven.

※For collectable submissions only.

31036.name: Rarefied Gaganaskin Shoes
31036.description:
Considering the cost of acquiring such footwear, few collectors would dare to walk a malm in these shoes.

※For collectable submissions only.

31037.name: Rarefied Gyuki Leather Jacket
31037.description:
Many gyuki died to bring you this jacket. Actually, it was probably just one─those things are huge.

※For collectable submissions only.

31038.name: Rarefied Tigerskin Tricorne
31038.description:
“I'm sure many rare and expensive materials went into the making of this hat, but now that I have it, I'm not so sure I'll wear it...”

※For collectable submissions only.

31039.name: Rarefied Marid Leather Corset
31039.description:
Ironic that an item so sleek and shapely is crafted from a beast so large and ponderous.

※For collectable submissions only.

31040.name: Rarefied Gazelleskin Armguards
31040.description:
“Yes, these will pair beautifully with my twinsilk robe and turban!”

※For collectable submissions only.

31041.name: Rarefied Smilodonskin Trousers
31041.description:
“Tigerskin is nice, but have you ever draped your loins in smilodon?”

※For collectable submissions only.

31042.name: Rarefied Gliderskin Thighboots
31042.description:
They'll glide right on, but you'll need to peel them off.

※For collectable submissions only.

31043.name: Rarefied Atrociraptorskin Cap
31043.description:
When foraging in the wild, it helps to have the crafted remains of a vicious predator sat on your head as a constant reminder to maintain vigilance.

※For collectable submissions only.

31044.name: Rarefied Zonureskin Fingerless Gloves
31044.description:
They say steel blades can break on the hide of a venerable zonure. But if you plan on blocking swords with your hands, just be careful of your fingertips.

※For collectable submissions only.

31045.name: Rarefied Rainbow Bolero
31045.description:
Despite the straps and flaps and electrum adornments, this bolero affords the wearer a surprising amount of mobility.

※For collectable submissions only.

31046.name: Rarefied Rainbow Ribbon
31046.description:
If you were expecting a riot of color to wrap around your neck, you will be sorely disappointed.

※For collectable submissions only.

31047.name: Rarefied Holy Rainbow Hat
31047.description:
For when you need to gather in the afternoon, and compliment m'lady at dusk.

※For collectable submissions only.

31048.name: Rarefied Ramie Turban
31048.description:
“I find the little tassel jangling at the side of my head actually *improves* my concentration. I can't explain it...”

※For collectable submissions only.

31049.name: Rarefied Hallowed Ramie Doublet
31049.description:
Not to be confused with the unhallowed ramie doublet. This is the one with the ruffles.

※For collectable submissions only.

31050.name: Rarefied Chimerical Felt Cyclas
31050.description:
If you cannot find a stuffed chimera, an outfit made from its mane might be the next best thing.

※For collectable submissions only.

31051.name: Rarefied Bloodhempen Skirt
31051.description:
“These will be wonderful for traipsing about outdoors. ...Perhaps tomorrow!”

※For collectable submissions only.

31052.name: Rarefied Ruby Cotton Gilet
31052.description:
Arterial spray is hardly noticeable on this gorgeous shade of red. Until it dries, of course.

※For collectable submissions only.

31053.name: Rarefied Kudzu Hat
31053.description:
Just as the kudzu vine blocks the sun from the plants it envelops, so will this hat hide your face 'neath its brim. Probably for the best.

※For collectable submissions only.

31054.name: Rarefied Serge Hose
31054.description:
Anyone who thinks these hose simple has no idea how steppe serge is made.

※For collectable submissions only.

31055.name: Rarefied Twinsilk Apron
31055.description:
Made from twinsilk, which requires twinthread, which in turn is spun from twincoons. Feels wrong to own only one.

※For collectable submissions only.

31056.name: Rarefied Brightlinen Himation
31056.description:
The basic himation is a rectangle of linen wrapped around the body, but no one said you couldn't accessorize.

※For collectable submissions only.

31057.name: Rarefied Iridescent Top
31057.description:
A top which covers you from top to bottom. Belt dagger is purely ornamental.

※For collectable submissions only.

31058.name: Rarefied Pixie Cotton Hood
31058.description:
A hood woven from pixie cotton. Not a cotton hood for pixies.

※For collectable submissions only.

31059.name: Rarefied Ovim Wool Tunic
31059.description:
“Is that a wand holder in the back? How convenient!”

※For collectable submissions only.

31060.name: Rarefied Archaeoskin Grimoire
31060.description:
“The more exotic the beast, the more likely someone has tanned its hide to make a spellbook. This one is archaeoskin, doubly bound.”

※For collectable submissions only.

31061.name: Rarefied Archaeoskin Codex
31061.description:
Some scholars will spare no expense─nor fantastic beast─to obtain protective covers for their tomes. 

※For collectable submissions only.

31062.name: Rarefied Dissolvent
31062.description:
When the rarest of artifacts must be cleansed of impurities, only the rarest of dissolvent will suffice.

※For collectable submissions only.

31063.name: Rarefied Dhalmelskin Codex
31063.description:
Hopefully the rest of the dhalmel didn't go to waste.

※For collectable submissions only.

31064.name: Rarefied Max-Potion
31064.description:
What theoretical maximum could a max-potion reach if a max-potion could theoretically be maximized?

※For collectable submissions only.

31065.name: Rarefied Book of Aurum Regis
31065.description:
There are “noble” metals, and then there's aurum regis. Some collectors need to be the king.

※For collectable submissions only.

31066.name: Rarefied Koppranickel Index
31066.description:
“I'd *like* to put it down before I eat, but I seem to have impaled a finger...”

※For collectable submissions only.

31067.name: Rarefied Reisui
31067.description:
Try not to lose it amongst the regular bottles of reisui─that's an amateur's mistake.

※For collectable submissions only.

31068.name: Rarefied Tigerskin Grimoire
31068.description:
Though crafted with materials of indisputable quality, many quietly consider the quill clasp on the back cover to be its greatest feature.

※For collectable submissions only.

31069.name: Rarefied Growth Formula
31069.description:
When the pumpkin-growing crown is at stake, sometimes you need that little extra edge.

※For collectable submissions only.

31070.name: Rarefied Gazelleskin Codex
31070.description:
An elegant and sturdy volume, with attachments to store both quill and ink. Practical!

※For collectable submissions only.

31071.name: Rarefied Alkahest
31071.description:
“Dissolvent and reisui are all very well and good, but a true professional settles for nothing less than the highest quality alkahest.”

※For collectable submissions only.

31072.name: Rarefied Gliderskin Grimoire
31072.description:
Cracking open this tome is akin to swinging wide the gate to a lush garden of secrets.

※For collectable submissions only.

31073.name: Rarefied Bluespirit Codex
31073.description:
“I almost regret buying this one. It feels like all the other books are jealous.”

※For collectable submissions only.

31074.name: Rarefied Syrup
31074.description:
For when you absolutely, positively must not mess up that synthesis.

※For collectable submissions only.

31075.name: Rarefied Dhalmel Gratin
31075.description:
Made with the choicest cuts and creamiest of sauces. Try not to burn your tongue.

※For collectable submissions only.

31076.name: Rarefied Sohm Al Tart
31076.description:
This most mountainous of tarts will satisfy even the most famished of dragonslayers.

※For collectable submissions only.

31077.name: Rarefied Sauteed Porcini
31077.description:
This fragrantly perfect dish would take pride of place next to the greatest trophies of war...if it weren't for that inconvenient rotting business.

※For collectable submissions only.

31078.name: Rarefied Royal Eggs
31078.description:
You don't have to be royal to enjoy this delectable breakfast, but being friends with the royal culinarian might help.

※For collectable submissions only.

31079.name: Rarefied Peperoncino
31079.description:
The extra spicy kick in these noodles will propel you through a difficult battle...or an afternoon with your future spouse's parents.

※For collectable submissions only.

31080.name: Rarefied Marron Glace
31080.description:
You might think a chestnut soaked in any other honey would taste as sweet...but this is even sweeter.

※For collectable submissions only.

31081.name: Rarefied Baklava
31081.description:
In the words of a famous djinn, “How 'bout a little more Baklava?”

※For collectable submissions only.

31082.name: Rarefied Shorlog
31082.description:
A tantalizing skewer of dzo meat fit for a khan.

※For collectable submissions only.

31083.name: Rarefied Tempura Platter
31083.description:
It's the lightly fried batter which makes this platter better.

※For collectable submissions only.

31084.name: Rarefied Persimmon Pudding
31084.description:
A single bite of this steamed dessert will reaffirm your belief in the divine.

※For collectable submissions only.

31085.name: Rarefied Chirashi-zushi
31085.description:
Commonly eaten during celebrations, it is this dish which will be celebrated by salivating gourmands.

※For collectable submissions only.

31086.name: Rarefied Grilled Rail
31086.description:
You wonder if some culinary critic awaits this succulent delight, table set and waiting by the nearest convenient aetheryte...

※For collectable submissions only.

31087.name: Rarefied Spaghetti al Nero
31087.description:
“So tired of golden noodles, I want them to turn black.”

※For collectable submissions only.

31088.name: Rarefied Popotoes au Gratin
31088.description:
Popotoes? Mash 'em, boil 'em, stick them in a pot with a distinctive cream cheese sauce.

※For collectable submissions only.

31089.name: Rarefied Espresso con Panna
31089.description:
“Do not speak to me before I've had my espresso con panna.”

※For collectable submissions only.

31101.name: Oddly Specific Cedar Lumber
31101.description: Must be cut within twenty paces of a lark's call, beneath a double rainbow.

31102.name: Oddly Specific Iron Nails
31102.description: Each and every nail must produce a sound akin to a Starlight Celebration chime when dropped from a height of precisely fourteen and a half ilms.

31103.name: Oddly Specific Mythril Rings
31103.description: The requirement that each ring be the same size does not seem to be especially odd or specific at first, but such opinions soon change upon realizing they must be crafted while blindfolded.

31104.name: Oddly Specific Silver Nugget
31104.description: Each specimen must have precisely the correct amount of nuggetiness.

31105.name: Oddly Specific Gaganaskin Strap
31105.description: The entire strap must be made from a single piece of skin, and being over a malm in length, is something of a tall order. Or long order, to be more precise.

31106.name: Oddly Specific Cloth
31106.description: Though the Skysteel Manufactory staff were oddly specific regarding the material itself, this odd level of specificity did not extend to its name, which is oddly unspecific.

31107.name: Oddly Specific Glue
31107.description: Most glues are designed to be used on certain types of material, whereas this sort is specifically meant to glue everything to everything else, including any container one may choose to place it in. This can make transporting it somewhat troublesome.

31108.name: Oddly Specific Oil
31108.description: While the instructions relating to the oil itself were not particularly specific, the bottle must be made from glass expertly crafted in the light of a full moon and blessed by forest spirits. Luckily, those conditions cannot be easily verified, and can therefore be ignored.

31109.name: Oddly Specific Cedar Plank
31109.description: One may be forgiven that an entire plank of anything is probably too much raw material for any sort of artisan's tool.

31110.name: Oddly Specific Iron Ingot
31110.description: The exact number of hammer blows used in its forging was specified by the Skysteel Manufactory's staff, but an extra tap here and there will likely go unnoticed.

31111.name: Oddly Specific Mythril Plate
31111.description: The instructions regarding the exact dimensions of each sheet were annoyingly specific, though one should be thankful that they did not request plates of mythril sheet, which are considerably more troublesome to craft.

31112.name: Oddly Specific Silver Ingot
31112.description: Considering that this ingot will inevitably be melted and hit repeatedly with hammers and so forth, the effort spent on making it look pretty seems rather pointless.

31113.name: Oddly Specific Gagana Leather
31113.description: The gagana itself must come from good stock, supposedly, though such wild creatures are not in the habit of keeping detailed records of their lineage.

31114.name: Oddly Specific Undyed Woolen Cloth
31114.description: Given the number of steps needed for the wool to reach this state, the possibility of a near-endless list of oddly specific instructions would be enough to deter all but the most stalwart of artisans. In the end, however, the Skysteel Manufactory staff asked only that it be “free from any artificial colorings,” which is presumably what the “undyed” part of its name implies.

31115.name: Oddly Specific Rubber
31115.description: The procurement of this rubbery specimen did not differ significantly from that of lesser varieties, though the manner in which it is handled before use tends to raise eyebrows. It must be thrown against a wall with an overarm motion, and then bounce exactly three and a half times before being caught in a bowl of hot porridge.

31116.name: Oddly Specific Paste
31116.description: Great pains must be taken while mixing to ensure the paste does not end up as a semi-liquid, or even worse, a liquid.

31137.name: Workshop Supplies
31137.description:
Contains vital pieces of the puzzle that is Ronitt's workshop. Unfortunately, you are not privy to the details surrounding their assembly, though rather than being some closely guarded secret, it is largely due to the fact that Ronitt is hopeless when it comes to adequately explaining anything.

※Only for use in dwarf society quests.

31139.name: Brewery Supplies
31139.description:
A selection of parts and materials needed to build a brewery in the traditional Gogg style. That is to say, immediately adjacent to a place where heavy engineering takes place, thereby enabling the workers to drink themselves silly whenever it pleases them.

※Only for use in dwarf society quests.

31141.name: Crystal Cannon Supplies
31141.description:
The various components and concoctions contained within this crate will one day go on to form some of the most advanced weaponry in Norvrandt. No doubt the crate itself will look back on this time as one of the highlights of its career.

※Only for use in dwarf society quests.

31143.name: Workshop Expansion Supplies
31143.description:
While it seems that the production of the supplies within this crate could have been delegated to any one of the skilled engineers of Watts's Anvil, you alone have been chosen for this most prestigious of positions. Most prestigious among Ronitt's lackeys, that is.

※Only for use in dwarf society quests.

31145.name: Automaton Worker Supplies
31145.description:
Do automata dream of electric frogs? Those made from the contents of this crate certainly will not, as their every “thought” will be devoted only to the production of tank after tank, never to so much as rest, let alone dream.

※Only for use in dwarf society quests.

31147.name: Armament Repair Kit
31147.description:
This repair kit contains specialized items for the maintenance and mending of soldierly equipment.

※Only for use in dwarf society quests.

31149.name: Grooming Kit
31149.description:
This grooming kit contains items essential to a dwarf's beardcare routine.

※Only for use in dwarf society quests.

31151.name: Core Tank Component
31151.description:
This vitally important tank component is sure to impress even the most demanding dwarven engineer.

※Only for use in dwarf society quests.

31153.name: Axle Component
31153.description:
A component that can make the axles of the bulkiest tank turn as quietly as a mouse.

※Only for use in dwarf society quests.

31155.name: Blueprint Supplies
31155.description:
Blueprints are among the most prized possessions in the Anvil, and many dwarves will guard their own designs as jealously as they would a tankard of ale.

※Only for use in dwarf society quests.

31157.name: Steel Plate Component
31157.description:
The production of steel plates involves much more than an ingot and some fire, as can be plainly seen by the complexity of this component.

※Only for use in dwarf society quests.

31159.name: Cask Component
31159.description:
Only the choicest of materials are used in these casks, for many dwarves would rather see their own blood spilt than a single drop of ale.

※Only for use in dwarf society quests.

31161.name: Engine Component
31161.description:
The engine is the heart of a tank, and must be maintained with as much care as the heart of any living, breathing being.

※Only for use in dwarf society quests.

31163.name: Filtration Supplies
31163.description:
Science can only be perfected through a long series of experiments, which require a steady stream of supplies. Or in this case, a parcel of them.

※Only for use in dwarf society quests.

31165.name: Cooling Device Component
31165.description:
An overheated tank is no use to anyone.

※Only for use in dwarf society quests.

31167.name: Tavern Materials
31167.description:
Even dwarven taverns face plenty of competition, so every material used in its construction must be of the utmost quality.

※Only for use in dwarf society quests.

31169.name: Heat-resistant Component
31169.description:
A tank component capable of withstanding high temperatures.

※Only for use in dwarf society quests.

31171.name: Bespoke Barter Item
31171.description:
This creation is tailor-made to capture the heart─and lower the prices─of a Mord merchant.

※Only for use in dwarf society quests.

31173.name: Test-fire Target Dummy
31173.description:
This target dummy is destined for destruction by tank cannon test-firing.

※Only for use in dwarf society quests.

31175.name: Experimental Plating Component
31175.description:
An experimental component designed to strengthen a tank's armor plating.

※Only for use in dwarf society quests.

31177.name: Unfailing Eye Opener
31177.description:
A special “tool” designed to jolt the recipient into wakefulness with a one hundred percent success rate.

※Only for use in dwarf society quests.

31179.name: Eye-catching Custom Option
31179.description:
An attention-seeking custom option designed to distinguish a tank's exterior appearance.

※Only for use in dwarf society quests.

31181.name: Automaton Repair Component
31181.description:
A component needed for the repairs of a badly damaged automaton drudge.

※Only for use in dwarf society quests.

31183.name: Low-profile Custom Option
31183.description:
A stealth-enhancing custom option designed to camouflage a tank's exterior appearance.

※Only for use in dwarf society quests.

31184.name: Grade 3 Skybuilders' Plywood
31184.description: Some pieces of plywood have a thin veneer covering the surface to give the impression of being made from actual wood. This specimen, however, harbors no such pretensions and is every bit as cheap as it looks.

31185.name: Grade 3 Skybuilders' Alloy
31185.description: The favored alloy of the hoi polloi.

31186.name: Grade 3 Skybuilders' Steel Plate
31186.description: Despite the name, this is not a robust, metallic piece of tableware. The main reason it is unsuited to such a purpose is that there is nothing to stop peas from rolling off the edge.

31187.name: Grade 3 Skybuilders' Ingot
31187.description: Though ingots are fairly ubiquitous in most forms of metalworking, far less commonly seen is a variation known as an outgot, which is exactly the same but upside down.

31188.name: Grade 3 Skybuilders' Leather
31188.description: When choosing the name, the skybuilders were far more concerned with assigning a grade than specifying the animal from which the leather originally came. It does smell a bit like goat, if that is anything to go by.

31189.name: Grade 3 Skybuilders' Rope
31189.description: This is what string wants to be when it grows up.

31190.name: Grade 3 Skybuilders' Ink
31190.description:
“If you took away my paper, I would write on my heart. If you took away my ink, I would write on the wind.
...It wouldn't be an ideal way to work.”
─Unknown author, dreamweaver, visionary, plus actor

31191.name: Grade 3 Skybuilders' Hemp Milk
31191.description: Being made from plant extracts, this refreshing beverage stretches the definition of what is normally considered to be milk. Then again, if seahorses and starfish are anything to go by, names can often be misleading.

31192.name: Grade 3 Skybuilders' Crate
31192.description: With all the crates scattered around the Firmament, the skybuilders have need of a means of storing them. It is for this exact purpose that this particular container was designed. Calls for it to be renamed the “crate crate” have been largely ignored.

31193.name: Grade 3 Skybuilders' Nails
31193.description: Even a simple table leg can be transformed into a deadly bludgeon by hammering a few of these nails into the end. Perfect for adventurers on a tight budget.

31194.name: Grade 3 Skybuilders' Rivets
31194.description: Some may argue that rivets are nothing more than nails without the pointy bit.

31195.name: Grade 3 Skybuilders' Rings
31195.description: These metal rings can apparently be joined and unjoined at will, though the only people capable of such a feat are sleight of hand artists. The skybuilders, however, are reluctant to employ such unscrupulous characters for fear of them fleecing the other workers, leaving these rings in a decidedly unjoined state.

31196.name: Grade 3 Skybuilders' Leather Straps
31196.description: When times are hard, many of the poor resort to eating leather to survive. Cutting said material into strips beforehand makes it somewhat easier to digest, or at the very least, easier to chew.

31197.name: Grade 3 Skybuilders' Cloth
31197.description: In most regions, people dress according to their personal preferences. In Ishgard, people dress according to their need to not freeze to death. Cloth such as this is as essential to survival as basic sustenance, if not more, as the cold will kill you faster than an empty stomach.

31198.name: Grade 3 Skybuilders' Plant Oil
31198.description: The people of Ishgard have endless uses for plant oil, though the local climate is less than ideal for the cultivation of said plants, or anything to cook using said oil, for that matter.

31199.name: Grade 3 Skybuilders' Sesame Cookie
31199.description: In order to be classed as grade 3, each cookie must contain a certain number of sesame seeds. Needless to say, counting them is one of the most tedious tasks undertaken by the skybuilders, though it works remarkably well as a cure for insomnia.

31200.name: Grade 3 Skybuilders' Grinding Wheel
31200.description: Primarily used for filing down the various materials used in goldsmithing, as well as providing an effective─though not especially portable─means of keeping fingernails short.

31201.name: Grade 3 Skybuilders' Pickaxe
31201.description: Useful not only for clearing rocks and debris, but also for dispatching any creatures that may emerge. In the case of Copperbell Mines, however, such creatures are often armed with pickaxes of their own.

31202.name: Grade 3 Skybuilders' Cookpot
31202.description: Can also be used as a makeshift bathtub by Lalafells, provided they refrain from sloshing water everywhere by making the pot sway back and forth.

31203.name: Grade 3 Skybuilders' Embroidery Frame
31203.description: Though there is little discernible difference between the grade 2 and grade 3 embroidery frames, the name alone strongly implies that this version is infinitely superior.

31204.name: Grade 3 Skybuilders' Leather Sack
31204.description: If one of the workers in the Firmament is given one of these sacks, it should be taken as meaning “pack up your things and leave.” Ishgard maintains the tradition of literally giving someone the sack when their employment has been terminated.

31205.name: Grade 3 Skybuilders' Broom
31205.description: Those who believe the tales of witches flying around on broomsticks have obviously never tried flying one for themselves. They take to the air about as well as a heavily armored Temple Knight takes to water, which is to say, not very.

31206.name: Grade 3 Skybuilders' Holy Water
31206.description: Believed to cure zombification. Grade 3 is claimed to grant a full recovery, whereas grade 2 only delays the onset of the symptoms, and grade 1 merely replaces the need to feast on the flesh of the living with a craving for copious amounts of bacon.

31207.name: Grade 3 Skybuilders' Tea
31207.description: A grade 3 cup is stirred using a figure of eight motion, rather than the traditional circular movement used for the grade 2 variety. Claims that this has any discernible effect on the flavor are largely regarded as nonsense, however.

31208.name: Grade 3 Skybuilders' Stepladder
31208.description: Perhaps when man and dragon have formed a stronger bond of trust, the skybuilders may take to the air on dragonback to perform all manner of tasks at higher altitudes. Until that day, mankind will just have to rely on good, old-fashioned stepladders.

31209.name: Grade 3 Skybuilders' Crosscut Saw
31209.description: Extremely effective at producing sawdust. Also cuts wood.

31210.name: Grade 3 Skybuilders' Mesail
31210.description: This would be perfect for protecting one's eyes from flying sparks while performing metalwork─the task it was primarily designed for─were it not for the large eyeholes.

31211.name: Grade 3 Skybuilders' Stone
31211.description: Despite its abundance in Coerthas, the skybuilders are quick to remind others that “stone like this doesn't grow on trees.” Factually accurate, yes. Logically sound, not so much.

31212.name: Grade 3 Skybuilders' Longboots
31212.description: In other parts of Hydaelyn, people would consider wearing two pairs of socks ample protection against the cold. In Coerthas, it is common to wear two pairs of boots, one over the other, as well as maybe a couple more pairs of socks for good measure.

31213.name: Grade 3 Skybuilders' Gloves
31213.description: For those wondering what the distinction between the grade 2 and grade 3 varieties might be, they need only smell the glove.

31214.name: Grade 3 Skybuilders' Soap
31214.description: When strategically placed on the floor, a wet bar of soap can be used to form a makeshift death trap for offing heiresses and the like.

31215.name: Grade 3 Skybuilders' All-purpose Infusion
31215.description: Whereas many concoctions are said to prevent various ailments, this one supposedly prevents all manner of accidents. In addition to drinking the recommended daily dose, one must avoid physical exertion, unnecessary excursions, and anything even remotely resembling danger to enjoy the effects of the infusion to their fullest.

31216.name: Grade 3 Skybuilders' Bed
31216.description:
Bed, bedder, bedst.
Never let it rest.
Till your bed is bedder, and your bedder bedst.

31217.name: Grade 3 Skybuilders' Oven
31217.description: Large enough to fit a whole witch inside.

31218.name: Grade 3 Skybuilders' Lamppost
31218.description: Keep this lamppost away from dogs, or alternatively, keep dogs away from this lamppost. Whichever is more feasible.

31219.name: Grade 3 Skybuilders' Brazier
31219.description: This traditional cooking apparatus offers Ishgardians the opportunity to enjoy two of their favorite pastimes: fried meat and not freezing to death.

31220.name: Grade 3 Skybuilders' Overalls
31220.description: Overall the best thing to wear over all of one's clothes.

31221.name: Grade 3 Skybuilders' Awning
31221.description: Protects one's eyes from the glaring sunlight, should any of it manage to find its way through the layers of dense cloud that hang almost perpetually over Ishgard.

31222.name: Grade 3 Skybuilders' Growth Formula
31222.description: The original creator claims it works on almost anything, within reason. Stone, for example, stubbornly refuses to grow no matter how much formula is applied.

31223.name: Grade 3 Skybuilders' Stew
31223.description: The grade 3 stew actually contains ingredients with names other than “dunno” or “not sure, but it was definitely dead when I threw it in.”

31224.name: Grade 3 Artisanal Skybuilders' Goldsmithing Bench
31224.description: Not only is the workbench rather lavishly made, it can also be used in the crafting of further lavishly made items.

31225.name: Grade 3 Artisanal Skybuilders' Smithing Bench
31225.description: Suited to almost any sort of smithing besides wordsmithing, for which a regular desk will suffice.

31226.name: Grade 3 Artisanal Skybuilders' Door
31226.description:
“When one door closes, another one opens? Sounds like you'd have trouble keeping out the draught.”
─Unknown carpenter

31227.name: Grade 3 Artisanal Skybuilders' Chronometer
31227.description: Though the use of such timepieces is still fairly limited in Ishgard, this particular model includes a bell that be set to ring at a specified time, earning it the rather catchy appellation “alarum chronometer.”

31228.name: Grade 3 Artisanal Skybuilders' Leather Chair
31228.description: Luckily, only the upholstery is made from leather. If the inner frame were made from the same material, it would have a difficult time supporting the weight of anything heavier than a medium-sized cat.

31229.name: Grade 3 Artisanal Skybuilders' Apron
31229.description: Basically a large dishcloth with a few straps attached. However, it is these straps that earn the apron the right to be called artisanal, as they will not come undone no matter how hard they are tugged by needy children begging for cookies.

31230.name: Grade 3 Artisanal Skybuilders' Tiled Flooring
31230.description: The use of materials that are naturally cold to the touch in the chilly land of Coerthas may be considered a design flaw, but it is actually a designer floor.

31231.name: Grade 3 Artisanal Skybuilders' Luncheon
31231.description: Though an army may march on its stomach, the skybuilders choose a more effective means of forward locomotion: walking with their legs. It is for this reason they require sustenance, and this hearty meal provides exactly that, along with enough grease to kill a sasquatch.

31247.name: Approved Grade 3 Skybuilders' Diadem Iron Ore

31250.name: Approved Grade 3 Skybuilders' Diadem Iron Sand

31255.name: Approved Grade 3 Skybuilders' Gossamer Cotton Boll

31257.name: Approved Grade 3 Skybuilders' Aurum Regis Ore

31258.name: Approved Grade 3 Skybuilders' Finest Rock Salt

31264.name: Approved Grade 3 Artisanal Skybuilders' Cotton Boll

31268.name: Approved Grade 3 Artisanal Skybuilders' Basilisk Egg

31272.name: Approved Grade 3 Skybuilders' Umbral Galewood Sap

31274.name: Approved Grade 3 Skybuilders' Umbral Magma Shard

31652.name: Rarefied Lignum Vitae Grinding Wheel
31652.description:
A grinding wheel so exquisite, it will set the teeth of those who behold it to grinding out of sheer envy.

※For collectable submissions only.

31653.name: Rarefied Mythril Hatchet
31653.description:
When they say “bury the hatchet,” they don't mean this one. Magnificent as it is, it should always be proudly and prominently displayed.

※For collectable submissions only.

31654.name: Rarefied Mythril Alembic
31654.description:
“You can taste the difference! Trust me on this!”

※For collectable submissions only.

31655.name: Rarefied Mythril Ring
31655.description:
“He told me to cast it into the fire and destroy it. I said, 'No.'”

※For collectable submissions only.

31656.name: Rarefied Swallowskin Coat
31656.description:
Many sea swallows died to bring you this coat. *Rare* ones.

※For collectable submissions only.

31657.name: Rarefied Dwarven Cotton Beret
31657.description:
So beautifully crafted is this cotton beret, all dwarven folk would be proud for it to bear their name.

※For collectable submissions only.

31658.name: Rarefied Dwarven Mythril Grimoire
31658.description:
It doesn't take a dwarf to recognize that this dwarven mythril grimoire boasts superior craftsmanship.

※For collectable submissions only.

31659.name: Rarefied Lemonade
31659.description:
Made from the rarest of ingredients and bottled in the rarest of vessels, this lemonade is certified rarefied.

※For collectable submissions only.

31662.name: Eternal Wind - Shadowbringers Orchestrion Roll
31662.description: Music roll for *Eternal Wind - Shadowbringers*. Use to add to your orchestrion list.

31663.name: To the Edge Orchestrion Roll
31663.description: Music roll for *To the Edge*. Use to add to your orchestrion list.

31687.name: Faded Copy of To the Edge

31750.name: Oddly Delicate Pine Lumber
31750.description: Though it may seem as sturdy as any other length of lumber, it will be robbed of its intrinsic qualities if one so much as sneezes near it.

31751.name: Oddly Delicate Silver Gear
31751.description: Perhaps it would be prudent to match this gear with others of a similarly delicate disposition.

31752.name: Oddly Delicate Wolfram Square
31752.description: This delicate square must be treated with the utmost care before holding it over a blazing forge and smashing it repeatedly with a hammer.

31753.name: Oddly Delicate Celestine
31753.description: The rays of light refracted by this crystal are so delicate that they can be broken simply by waving one's hand through them.

31754.name: Oddly Delicate Gazelle Leather
31754.description: This leather somehow managed to retain its delicacy despite being subjected to the far-from-gentle tanning process.

31755.name: Oddly Delicate Rhea Cloth
31755.description: Great care must be taken not to stretch, crumple, crease, or─if possible─touch this specimen, lest its intrinsic delicateness be marred.

31756.name: Oddly Delicate Holy Water
31756.description: Most water is delicate by its very nature, this sort even more so.

31757.name: Oddly Delicate Shark Oil
31757.description: The treatment to which the shark was subjected to extract its oil was anything but delicate.

31893.name: Grade 4 Tincture of Strength
31893.description:
This diluted brew temporarily increases strength for twice the duration of similar potions.

**Duration:** 30s

31894.name: Grade 4 Tincture of Dexterity
31894.description:
This diluted brew temporarily increases dexterity for twice the duration of similar potions.

**Duration:** 30s

31895.name: Grade 4 Tincture of Vitality
31895.description:
This diluted brew temporarily increases vitality for twice the duration of similar potions.

**Duration:** 30s

31896.name: Grade 4 Tincture of Intelligence
31896.description:
This diluted brew temporarily increases intelligence for twice the duration of similar potions.

**Duration:** 30s

31897.name: Grade 4 Tincture of Mind
31897.description:
This diluted brew temporarily increases mind for twice the duration of similar potions.

**Duration:** 30s

31898.name: Pizza
31898.description:
A simple-but-satisfying dish of thinly worked dough topped with tomatoes and cheese, baked in a wood-fired oven until crispy. 

**EXP Bonus:** +3% **Duration:** 30m
(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

31899.name: Mist Spinach Quiche
31899.description:
Using choice ingredients such as mist spinach and mozzarella, this variation of spinach quiche satisfies even the fussiest gourmand.

**EXP Bonus:** +3% **Duration:** 30m
(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

31900.name: Chicken Fettuccine
31900.description:
Flat, thick pasta smothered in a rich cream sauce with tender slices of chicken thigh.

**EXP Bonus:** +3% **Duration:** 30m
(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

31901.name: Smoked Chicken
31901.description:
A leg of chicken patiently smoked to perfection.

**EXP Bonus:** +3% **Duration:** 30m
(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

31902.name: Golden Pineapple Juice
31902.description:
Tart and invigorating juice freshly squeezed from golden pineapples.

**EXP Bonus:** +3% **Duration:** 30m
(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

31903.name: Pineapple Salad
31903.description:
A salad featuring chunks of golden pineapple tossed with a flavorsome frantoio oil dressing.

**EXP Bonus:** +3% **Duration:** 30m
(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

31904.name: Zefir
31904.description:
An irresistibly soft and airy confectionary made from whipped twilight apple purée.

**EXP Bonus:** +3% **Duration:** 30m
(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

31905.name: Twilight Popoto Salad
31905.description:
Shredded twilight apples give this popoto salad a crunchy texture and fruity tang.

**EXP Bonus:** +3% **Duration:** 30m
(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

31906.name: Broad Bean Curry
31906.description:
Broad beans stewed with fragrant spices, served with a side of steamed rice.

**EXP Bonus:** +3% **Duration:** 30m
(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

31907.name: Lemon Muffin
31907.description:
A sweet and zesty muffin made by mixing lemonette rind and juice into the dough.

**EXP Bonus:** +3% **Duration:** 30m
(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

31913.name: Grade 4 Skybuilders' Plywood
31913.description: The skybuilders are known for plying their trade by applying plies to provide supplies of plywood. Now try saying that ten times fast with a mouthful of porridge.

31914.name: Grade 4 Skybuilders' Alloy
31914.description: A marvelous mixture of malleable metals melded into magnificently molded...blocks.

31915.name: Grade 4 Skybuilders' Steel Plate
31915.description: To be fair is rare, and to be square even rarer, but to be both fair and square is miraculous indeed.

31916.name: Grade 4 Skybuilders' Ingot
31916.description: It is believed in certain circles that the word “ingot” is derived from the verb “to inget” meaning “to breathe in and out simultaneously, causing the air to become trapped in the larynx, creating a sound akin to a hiccupping buffalo.”

31917.name: Grade 4 Skybuilders' Leather
31917.description: The time and effort spent on cutting each hide into perfect circles would have been better spent on...well, anything else. Not to mention the amount of wasted leather now lying in a pile of offcuts. However, one thing can be said of the skybuilders: there is madness in their method.

31918.name: Grade 4 Skybuilders' Rope
31918.description: While this may seem like a good choice for a children's skipping rope, it is weighty enough to leave a painful welt on either the temples or ankles of those with a poor sense of timing. Still, some might say that only adds to the fun.

31919.name: Grade 4 Skybuilders' Ink
31919.description: The grade 4 variety of ink is said to be especially quick-drying, which helps to prevent smudging. Some claim, however, that the ink dries before it even has time to reach the parchment, which does rather defeat the purpose of the ink in the first place.

31920.name: Grade 4 Skybuilders' Hemp Milk
31920.description:
“We challenged Ishgardians to taste the difference between hemp milk and a leading dairy-based competitor. Eight in ten participants claimed they tasted exactly the same, while the remainder complained of a stomachache from drinking too much milk.”
─Culinarians' Guild researcher

31921.name: Grade 4 Skybuilders' Crate
31921.description:
“If you see a crate, try looking inside. There may be a small amount of gil or even potions or medicinal herbs inside. Don't worry about the owners catching you pilfering their wares; you'd be surprised how many are willing to turn a blind eye, especially if you're carrying a big sword.”
─*Adventuring for Fun and Profit, First Edition*

31922.name: Grade 4 Skybuilders' Nails
31922.description: In traditional Doman carpentry, the wooden pieces are carefully carved to allow them to snugly interlock and remain steadfast for years to come. In Ishgard, however, the wood is considerably less cooperative, and must have little metal spikes driven through it to stay where it is told.

31923.name: Grade 4 Skybuilders' Rivets
31923.description: Although being covered in rivets tends to make basically anything look a lot more sturdy, the act of driving them in to begin with probably compromises the object's structural integrity to some degree. It certainly has that effect on a person's skull.

31924.name: Grade 4 Skybuilders' Rings
31924.description: Those who cannot afford proper metal gauntlets can try threading these metallic rings onto their fingers to produce a similar effect. Just be sure to keep your fists clenched to stop them falling off.

31925.name: Grade 4 Skybuilders' Leather Straps
31925.description: The artisans responsible for the creation of such wares are often described as “strapping,” but usually in a literal rather than figurative sense.

31926.name: Grade 4 Skybuilders' Cloth
31926.description: How long is a bolt of cloth? Twice as long from the middle to the end.

31928.name: Grade 4 Skybuilders' Sesame Cookie
31928.description: Ishgardian parents often tell their children that the sesame seeds are in fact dead flies that were trapped in the batter prior to baking. Not only does this have the effect of keeping the young ones' hands out of the cookie jar, it also leads them to a few raised eyebrows in regard to their parents' choice of confectionery.

31929.name: Grade 4 Skybuilders' Spinning Wheel
31929.description: One of the few wheels that can turn all day and not move an ilm.

31930.name: Grade 4 Skybuilders' Hatchet
31930.description: A common choice of weapon in civilian uprisings, though it leaves much to be desired in the “long and pointy” stakes, unlike the ever-popular pitchfork.

31931.name: Grade 4 Skybuilders' Cookpot
31931.description: Almost identical to the grade 3 version but with a better warranty, providing cover against “irremovable stains except for in cases where strange or unusual ingredients have been used, such as Lalafell fat.”

31932.name: Grade 4 Skybuilders' Embroidery Frame
31932.description: A frame so intricately detailed and immaculately crafted that it threatens to upstage the embroidery it is designed to keep in place.

31933.name: Grade 4 Skybuilders' Leather Sack
31933.description: The leather of this sack once held the flesh, bones, and organs of a large beast, but has now been granted the opportunity to store a much wider and more interesting range of objects. Unless, that is, it is purchased by a butcher, in which case the contents may end up being largely the same as its previous incarnation.

31934.name: Grade 4 Skybuilders' Broom
31934.description: Combatants who claim they will “sweep the floor” with their opponent should try one of these brooms instead. Twice the cleanliness with none of the violence.

31935.name: Grade 4 Skybuilders' Holy Water
31935.description:
“Why's this called holy water? I don't see any holes in it.”
─A confused and somewhat illiterate skybuilder

31936.name: Grade 4 Skybuilders' Tea
31936.description: Contains so much sugar that some claim the smell alone is enough to make one's teeth fall out.

31937.name: Grade 4 Skybuilders' Stepladder
31937.description: “Takes just as many steps to climb up as it does to climb down” is the slogan used by the skybuilders when pitching their stepladders to potential customers, though any sales made tend to be in spite of said slogan rather than because of it.

31938.name: Grade 4 Skybuilders' Crosscut Saw
31938.description: Strangely enough, it is not particularly well suited to cutting crosses.

31939.name: Grade 4 Skybuilders' Mesail
31939.description: As any smith will attest, the heat of the forge can be overwhelming. Were it not for the conveniently placed air holes, their heads would be baked inside their mesails like cow-brain pies (an Ishgardian delicacy).

31940.name: Grade 4 Skybuilders' Stone
31940.description: Since ancient times, man has sought to move exceedingly large blocks of stone from one location to another. In the past, methods such as conveying the material atop a series of rolling logs or ferrying it on extremely buoyant rafts were employed, whereas all it requires these days is one plucky volunteer with bottomless pockets.

31941.name: Grade 4 Skybuilders' Longboots
31941.description: It is said that over the years, the design for longboots grew longer and longer, until the two boots eventually met in the middle and lost the part covering the foot entirely─perhaps to save on materials─and became what are now known as trousers.

31942.name: Grade 4 Skybuilders' Gloves
31942.description: Long have gloves waged war in the marketplace against mittens, their archrivals, though the wearer's ability to move each finger individually has proved to be a deciding factor in securing their popularity.

31943.name: Grade 4 Skybuilders' Soap
31943.description: In a stroke of sheer genius, the skybuilders have succeeded in inventing a variety of soap that floats on water, much to the delight of the people of Ishgard─those who actually wash, that is.

31944.name: Grade 4 Skybuilders' All-purpose Infusion
31944.description: A remarkable concoction that is able to treat any ailment the salesperson is able to imagine. The lack of complaints following purchase indicates that the customer is either entirely satisfied with the effects, or dead from poisoning.

31945.name: Grade 4 Skybuilders' Bed
31945.description: The mattress is made from a spongelike material to help absorb any...nocturnal spillages.

31946.name: Grade 4 Skybuilders' Oven
31946.description: Sometimes, the phrase “she's got a bun in the oven” is meant to be taken literally. In fact, this common saying has led to all sorts of hilarious misunderstandings, particularly in cases where the woman in question likes to bake her own bread.

31947.name: Grade 4 Skybuilders' Lamppost
31947.description: Spare a thought for the poor souls whose job it is to light each of the lanterns that line the streets of the Firmament every evening. Perhaps one day, someone will be so kind as to invent a system whereby they may be lit and extinguished remotely. Unfortunately, many of Ishgard's civic engineers are preoccupied with far more frivolous pursuits, such as imbuing tools with mystic energy using oddly specific materials.

31948.name: Grade 4 Skybuilders' Brazier
31948.description: One must take great care not to confuse this with the similarly named ladies' undergarment.

31949.name: Grade 4 Skybuilders' Overalls
31949.description: While it is common for mud, paint, and other stains to collect on overalls, some of the skybuilders have taken to deliberately dirtying their clothing to fool others into thinking they have been hard at work. Since a skybuilder's pay is largely based on their performance, however, those who attempt such tricks are normally left with naught but soiled overalls and empty pockets.

31950.name: Grade 4 Skybuilders' Awning
31950.description: Is there anything more pleasant than yawning in the morning as day is dawning, beneath an awning?

31951.name: Grade 4 Skybuilders' Growth Formula
31951.description: There are rumors that claim the remarkable height of Elezen is due to doses of growth formula being slipped into their morning porridge from a young age. Attempts to reproduce such an effect on the Lalafells who willingly volunteered as test subjects have yet to yield results, other than an unnatural aversion to porridge.

31952.name: Grade 4 Skybuilders' Stew
31952.description: Many culinarians believe the secret to a good stew is to never allow the pot to become empty by constantly topping it up with fresh ingredients. This may in fact be an elaborate ploy to avoid ever having to wash the pot, not to mention that some parts of the stew may have been in the mix for several years without being served. Diners are advised to “eat around” anything that seems a bit suspicious.

31953.name: Grade 4 Artisanal Skybuilders' Icebox
31953.description: Though such a device would seem to have little use in Ishgard, where foodstuffs may be kept chilled simply by placing them outside, the icebox does offer protection from rats and crows. But then again, so would any other type of box.

31954.name: Grade 4 Artisanal Skybuilders' Chocobo Weathervane
31954.description: If it starts spinning wildly, it means the wind is blowing in all of the directions at once.

31955.name: Grade 4 Artisanal Skybuilders' Company Chest
31955.description: This communal deposit relies on the honesty of not only every member of the company─to give what they can and take only what they need─but every other person who passes through the Firmament, as it is left completely unlocked at all times. The members of said companies are often surprised to find the chest completely empty upon opening it, while opportunistic thieves enjoy their easy pickings.

31956.name: Grade 4 Artisanal Skybuilders' Astroscope
31956.description: Such devices are often found pointing in the direction of the open-air baths, which is in keeping with the letter─rather than the spirit─of its intended purpose, that being “the observation of heavenly bodies.”

31957.name: Grade 4 Artisanal Skybuilders' Tool Belt
31957.description: While it may not seem especially voluminous, this belt is capable of holding up to thirty-five primary tools and the same number of secondary tools. One might have trouble actually moving with an entire shed's worth of heavy equipment hanging from one's waist, however.

31958.name: Grade 4 Artisanal Skybuilders' Vest
31958.description: Far more luxurious than most other garments of its kind, with a price to match. Most would think twice before investing in this vest.

31959.name: Grade 4 Artisanal Skybuilders' Tincture
31959.description:
“Should you find any mysterious phials of liquid, be sure to take them with you. After all, the clinking of glass from all the potions, ethers, and elixirs an adventurer is known for carrying about their person is one of the easiest ways for a potential client to distinguish them from a marauding barbarian.”
─*Adventuring for Fun and Profit, First Edition*

31960.name: Grade 4 Artisanal Skybuilders' Sorbet
31960.description: Although a lot of care and effort went into the preparation of this sweet treat, a similar effect could easily be achieved by leaving a glass of fruit juice outside in the cold Ishgardian air for half a bell or so.

31981.name: Approved Grade 4 Skybuilders' White Cedar Log

31984.name: Approved Grade 4 Skybuilders' Gossamer Cotton Boll

31987.name: Approved Grade 4 Skybuilders' Finest Rock Salt

31997.name: Approved Grade 4 Artisanal Skybuilders' Spring Water

31998.name: Approved Grade 4 Artisanal Skybuilders' Ice Stalagmite

32001.name: Approved Grade 4 Skybuilders' Umbral Galewood Branch

32202.name: Grilled Eel Set
32202.description:
An Eastern delicacy that fills stomachs as quickly as it empties coinpurses. Connoisseurs advise eating only the smallest amount at a time, so as to make it last as long as possible.

※Cannot be retrieved once used.
※Can be used up to 10 times.

Meal benefits when used:
  **Direct Hit Bonus:** +4% (Max 10)
  **VIT Bonus:** +5% (Max 12)
  **Gear Durability Bonus:** +3
  **EXP Bonus:** +3%
  **Duration:** 30m
  (Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

32206.name: Emerald Weapon Bust
32206.description:
Includes six floating manipulators, all of which appear to be offering to take one's coat.

※One per estate only.

32212.name: Shakshouka Pot
32212.description:
Of the many and varied ingredients that comprise this dish, it is the humble hen's egg that takes center stage.

※Cannot be retrieved once used.
※Can be used up to 10 times.

Meal benefits when used:
  **Critical Hit Bonus:** +4% (Max 10)
  **VIT Bonus:** +5% (Max 12)
  **Gear Durability Bonus:** +3
  **EXP Bonus:** +3%
  **Duration:** 30m
  (Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

32221.name: Rose Trellis
32221.description: Keeps even the wildest of roses neatly organized.

32224.name: Swag Valance
32224.description:
“This room has too much...wall. We should cover some of it in cloth.”
─Unknown furnishing connoisseur

32225.name: Rustic Chocobo Counter
32225.description: Bring the delights of a genuine chocobo stable to the inside of your home, complete with that unmistakable aroma.

32226.name: Wood Slat Partition
32226.description: Useful for when one wishes to block something from view while still being able to see it.

32227.name: Homemade Cookie Set
32227.description: This decorative ornament is ideal for giving guests the impression that one is an accomplished culinarian. Little will they know that the “dough” is in fact entirely inedible.

32228.name: Florist's Counter
32228.description: For some reason, the name “flowermonger” never quite caught on.

32229.name: Paissa Swing Chair
32229.description: For those who wish to be gently rocked by a hanging piece of furniture resembling the most terrifying creature in the known world.

32233.name: Toy Showcase
32233.description: It appears that stuffed animals have infested this showcase, which is normally reserved for more austere pieces of ornamentation.

32234.name: Apparel Showcase
32234.description: Some people like others to see their items of finery even when they are not being worn.

32235.name: Armament Showcase
32235.description: While such arms are largely displayed for heraldic purposes, they would still come in handy in a pinch.

32236.name: Art Showcase
32236.description: Provides fine pieces of art some degree of protection from the sticky hands of overly curious children.

32237.name: Baked Goods Showcase
32237.description: Though some people may be baffled by the idea of using pastries as ornaments, this display case is not for those people.

32242.name: Toymaker's Show Window
32242.description: A perfect demonstration of one's toy-making abilities, or perhaps “toy-buying” abilities.

32243.name: Designer's Show Window
32243.description: Placing anything in a glass display case has the effect of making it appear expensive and luxurious, which many designers rely on to justify their ludicrously high prices.

32244.name: Smith's Show Window
32244.description: In case of emergency, smash glass and commence hacking and slashing.

32245.name: Artist's Show Window
32245.description: Though it is customary to charge for admission to art exhibitions, passersby can experience these works of fine art for free.

32246.name: Baker's Show Window
32246.description: When the sunlight hits the glass at the right angle, it has the effect of keeping the bread inside warm.

32249.name: Brick Paving
32249.description: All these squares make a square.

32250.name: La Noscean Grape Pergola
32250.description: This wooden frame gives grape vines the means to climb to greater heights, in a quite literal sense.

32251.name: Fruitful Fountain
32251.description: Where most fountains would produce an upward-pointing spray of water, this one includes what experts call an “arboreal protrusion.”

32252.name: Herringbone Flooring
32252.description: Most herring would argue that their bones bear little resemblance to this flooring design.

32253.name: Skylight Chandelier
32253.description: This exquisite piece utilizes natural sunlight to provide illumination. How it continues to work at night, however, is a closely guarded secret.

32254.name: Varied Wood Interior Wall
32254.description: While the wooden pieces may appear to be randomly placed, there is method in the madness. Or possibly madness in the method.

32823.name: Emerald Barding
32823.description: A suit of chocobo armor designed to resemble the Emerald Weapon.

32936.name: Solstice Ingot
32936.description: A large block of solid crystal, ready to be chiseled into whatever form the craftsman desires.

32937.name: Saffron Cloth
32937.description: Finely woven cloth dyed a vibrant orange with gardenia fruit, rather than the expensive spice after which the color was named.

32938.name: Thylacoleo Leather
32938.description: A large piece of cured thylacoleo skin.

32939.name: Grade 4 Strength Alkahest
32939.description: When applied to items such as battle gear, this experimental alchemical liquid will dissolve away minute amounts of aether aspected to elements detrimental to strength, and by doing so, better attune the item and its wearer to the remaining beneficial elements.

32940.name: Grade 4 Dexterity Alkahest
32940.description: When applied to items such as battle gear, this experimental alchemical liquid will dissolve away minute amounts of aether aspected to elements detrimental to dexterity, and by doing so, better attune the item and its wearer to the remaining beneficial elements.

32941.name: Grade 4 Vitality Alkahest
32941.description: When applied to items such as battle gear, this experimental alchemical liquid will dissolve away minute amounts of aether aspected to elements detrimental to vitality, and by doing so, better attune the item and its wearer to the remaining beneficial elements.

32942.name: Grade 4 Intelligence Alkahest
32942.description: When applied to items such as battle gear, this experimental alchemical liquid will dissolve away minute amounts of aether aspected to elements detrimental to intelligence, and by doing so, better attune the item and its wearer to the remaining beneficial elements.

32943.name: Grade 4 Mind Alkahest
32943.description: When applied to items such as battle gear, this experimental alchemical liquid will dissolve away minute amounts of aether aspected to elements detrimental to mind, and by doing so, better attune the item and its wearer to the remaining beneficial elements.

33110.name: The Black Wolf Stalks Again Orchestrion Roll
33110.description: Music roll for *The Black Wolf Stalks Again*. Use to add to your orchestrion list.

33135.name: Faded Copy of The Black Wolf Stalks Again

33224.name: Patient Necessities
33224.description: From bars of soap to dining utensils, the patients of Ser Vaindreau's Grace have need of myriad items during their stay.

33225.name: Medical Supplies
33225.description: An infirmary without medical supplies is no infirmary at all.

33226.name: Rehabilitation Aids
33226.description: No few patients of Ser Vaindreau's Grace suffer from debilitating injuries, and rehabilitation aids are needed to help them recover and regain independence.

33227.name: High Tea Essentials
33227.description: Tea is good and high tea is better. With this assortment of items, the infirmary will be able to host an event the patients will remember.

33228.name: Art Supplies
33228.description: Painting is at once relaxing and rehabilitative, and these art supplies will do much good for the patients of Ser Vaindreau's Grace.

33248.name: Storm Blue Interior Wall
33248.description: A blue interior wall for those estate owners who wish to make a simple statement.

33249.name: Cream Yellow Carpet
33249.description: Durable-yet-fuzzy loop carpet in a cozy cream yellow.

33250.name: Cloud Acorn Chandelier
33250.description: “Quaint” does not begin to describe this chandelier made with cloud acorns still hanging on the branch.

33253.name: Diamond Weapon Bust
33253.description:
Arguably more shoulders than bust, but undeniably menacing in either case.

※One per estate only.

33258.name: Eastern Indoor Pond
33258.description: Constructed in the Eastern fashion, this pond is hemmed in natural stone and comes with carp swimming gracefully.

33259.name: Grocery Counter Cart
33259.description: A mobile kitchen counter designed in the likeness of a wagon, laden with a selection of breads and fresh produce.

33263.name: Wooden Reel Table
33263.description: Formerly used to carry ropes and cables, this wooden reel has been repurposed as a table.

33264.name: Violin Showcase
33264.description: A wooden cabinet custom-made for displaying violins. Comes complete with instruments.

33266.name: Pub Signboard
33266.description: When it comes to indicating the presence of a pub, nary a word is needed.

33267.name: Windowed Partition
33267.description: Extending to the ceiling, this partition incorporates a wide rectangular window.

33268.name: Hingan Windowed Partition
33268.description: Extending to the ceiling, this partition incorporates a round Hingan-style window.

33271.name: Wooden Spiral Staircase
33271.description: Spiral staircases are ideal for situations where there is insufficient space for conventional stairs.

33272.name: Approved Ishgardian Lunch
33272.description:
Tasty and wholesome, this lunch set is said to be a favorite among skybuilders.

※Cannot be retrieved once used.
※Can be used up to 10 times.

Meal benefits when used:
  **Control Bonus:** +4% (Max 10)
  **VIT Bonus:** +5% (Max 12)
  **Gear Durability Bonus:** +3
  **EXP Bonus:** +3%
  **Duration:** 30m
  (Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

33273.name: Country Dining Set
33273.description: Enjoy the bucolic life with this wooden dining set for four, finished with a checkered tablecloth.

33275.name: Icebox
33275.description: Rather than with magic or magitek, this wooden box keeps its contents chilled the old-fashioned way─with a large block of ice.

33276.name: Red Brick Counter
33276.description: For years, academics have sought to explain why such counters of brick and timber enhance the flavor of liquor. Thus far, they have little to show for their research except ferocious hangovers.

33278.name: Hand-poured Coffee
33278.description:
Aromatic coffee brewed by the time-honored pour-over method.

※Cannot be retrieved once used.
※Can be used up to 10 times.

Meal benefits when used:
  **Perception Bonus:** +4% (Max 10)
  **VIT Bonus:** +5% (Max 12)
  **Gear Durability Bonus:** +3
  **EXP Bonus:** +3%
  **Duration:** 30m
  (Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

33279.name: Back Bar
33279.description: A tall wooden shelf commonly used in taverns to store and display liquor.

33280.name: Pixie Apple Basket
33280.description:
A basket of pixie apples and a bottle of grape juice, perfect as a palate cleanser or simply a snack.

※Cannot be retrieved once used.
※Can be used up to 10 times.

Meal benefits when used:
  **Piety Bonus:** +4% (Max 10)
  **VIT Bonus:** +5% (Max 12)
  **Gear Durability Bonus:** +3
  **EXP Bonus:** +3%
  **Duration:** 30m
  (Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

33281.name: Philosopher's Stone Table
33281.description: A round table of polished stone with a tree growing at its center, all of which is said to be conducive to enlightened debate.

33282.name: Crystarium Wardrobe
33282.description: A simple-yet-elegant wardrobe designed in the Crystarium style, complete with an array of outfits.

33283.name: Low Bookshelf
33283.description: A low, wide bookshelf featuring both open and closed compartments.

33284.name: Qiqirn Shelf
33284.description: Designed in a Qiqirn motif, this wooden shelf is as charming as it is practical.

33285.name: Mogbureau
33285.description: A writing table with storage designed in a moogle motif. Do not attempt to remove the pom-pom.

33286.name: Bar Rack
33286.description: A wooden rack for holding a selection of drinks and glasses. Hanging the glasses upside down prevents dust from gathering inside while avoiding chips to the rims.

33291.name: Goobbue Wall Chronometer
33291.description: A wall chronometer designed in a goobbue motif, a dazed look upon the creature's face.

33292.name: Armor Hanger
33292.description: Originally designed for ceremonial purposes for those of the Elezen persuasion, the attachments on the side of the helm allow it to be worn without bending the ears out of shape.

33293.name: Mounted Dinosaur Skull
33293.description: In a case of the hunter becoming the hunted, the cranium of this ferocious predator is now doomed to spend eternity in ignominy mounted as a trophy on an adventurer's wall. Its headless body must be rolling in its grave.

33295.name: Glade Gazebo
33295.description: A gazebo designed in the glade fashion.

33296.name: Garden Tool Shelf
33296.description: A wooden shelf used for storing gardening implements.

33299.name: Forging Bench
33299.description: An outdoor furnishing perfect for those who prefer to do their smithing out in the open. After all, attempting to do so in an enclosed space does come with the rather bothersome side effects brought on by smoke inhalation.

33300.name: Garden Anvil
33300.description: Best placed outdoors, as it tends to leave rather an undesirable impression on all but the most durable of floors.

33301.name: Materiel Table
33301.description: An outdoor furnishing including an assortment of arms and armor. Ideal for those situations where one finds oneself uttering, “Choose your weapon,” to an unruly houseguest.

33673.name: Diamond Barding
33673.description: A suit of chocobo armor designed to resemble the Diamond Weapon.

33696.name: Wanderer's Campfire
33696.description:
Perfect for driving away the darkness and the chill and, most importantly, toasting marshmallows.

Use item to acquire the wanderer's campfire minion.

33818.name: Faded Copy of In the Arms of War

33839.name: In the Arms of War Orchestrion Roll
33839.description: Music roll for *In the Arms of War*. Use to add to your orchestrion list.
