35434.name: AR-Caean Velvet Work Cap of Crafting

35435.name: AR-Caean Velvet Work Shirt of Crafting

35439.name: AR-Caean Velvet Trapper's Hat of Gathering

35555.name: Orchestrion Phonograph
35555.description:
A tabletop furnishing with a trumpetesque funnel designed to spread sweet melodies around a given space.

※One orchestrion of any type per estate only.

35556.name: Shoe Rack
35556.description: A stack of shelves suited for storing shoes.

35559.name: Matching Cushions
35559.description: A pair of fluffy pillows that support not only your neck and shoulders, but each other as well.

35560.name: Marimba
35560.description: A mallet-sounded instrument with an intricate design so beautiful as to rival its woody timbre.

35561.name: Indoor Oriental Waterfall
35561.description: A fabulous water feature that will bless any space with a touch of Far Eastern flair.

35563.name: Heavenly Ornamental Array
35563.description: A string of celestial lights for those who wish to gaze upon the night sky without craning their necks upward.

35564.name: Woodland Chair
35564.description: A seat that was lost in the woods, never to be reunited with its original owner.

35565.name: Apothecary's Workbench
35565.description: A wooden workspace filled with enough tonics and tinctures to make one's fire burn and cauldron bubble.

35566.name: Candlelit Sundries
35566.description: This trio of potted plant, letter frame, and waxen candle makes for the most charming fire hazard you'll see today.

35567.name: Fat Cat Rug
35567.description: A carpet almost as cozy as the fluffy familiar that inspired it.

35568.name: Walnut Flower Vases
35568.description: A stable set of wooden stands, each adorned with a brightly colored blossom.

35569.name: Fluffy Pancakes
35569.description:
A two-tiered treat served with butter, powdered sugar, and a side of maple syrup.

※Cannot be retrieved once used.
※Can be used up to 10 times.

Meal benefits when used:
  **Determination Bonus:** +4% (Max 10)
  **VIT Bonus:** +5% (Max 12)
  **Gear Durability Bonus:** +3
  **EXP Bonus:** +3%
  **Duration:** 30m
  (Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

35571.name: Wooden Blinds
35571.description: A set of wooden slats designed to keep interiors dim and idle hands a-dusting.

35574.name: Wooden Bin
35574.description: A container assembled from materials not much greater in quality than the waste that fills it.

35575.name: Imitation Wooden Skylight
35575.description: A ceiling fixture for those who prefer their sunlight simulated.

35576.name: Square Niche Partition
35576.description: There are two types of people: those who use this divider as storage space for cubic containers, and those who spend their time pretending to be a haunted portrait.

35577.name: Pendant Wall Light
35577.description: A chain-strung lamp whose diminutive glow prioritizes fashion over function.

35578.name: Loft Bed
35578.description: A bed-over-desk set for authors whose solution to writer's block is sleeping on it.

35579.name: Restaurant Showcase
35579.description: A cabinet filled with eerily realistic recreations of various dishes.

35582.name: Il Mheg Garden Fountain
35582.description: A petit water feature inspired by the land of the pixies.

35583.name: Hanging Bench
35583.description: A seat strung from a sturdy branch and securely fastened so to assuage any safety concerns.

35585.name: Poroggo Lawn Ornament
35585.description: An adorable little waterwheel adorned with an even cuter amphibian familiar.

35586.name: Miniature Antique Clock Tower
35586.description: An outdoor clock that will always tell you the time─so long as you keep it wound.

35587.name: Shirogane Pinwheel
35587.description: A tiny spinning toy that is quite popular among Hingan children.

35588.name: Gold Plating
35588.description: Plating required to repair Rurusha's mysterious relic.

35589.name: Gold Cog
35589.description: A cog required to repair Rurusha's mysterious relic.

35590.name: Gold Motor Component
35590.description: A component required to repair Rurusha's mysterious relic.

35591.name: Gold Mechanical Voice Box
35591.description: A component required to repair Rurusha's mysterious relic.

35593.name: Aetherial Lens
35593.description: Allows the starlens to capture aetherial flickers.

35594.name: Aetherial Amplifier
35594.description: Allows one to channel enough magic to operate the starlens.

35595.name: Aetherial Conductor
35595.description: Allows one to project the aether captured by the starlens onto water.

35596.name: Panaloaf Sweetener
35596.description: This sweet concoction is designed to bind together the disparate flavors of the foul-tasting panaloaf.

35597.name: Panaloaf Yeast
35597.description: This special yeast should greatly improve the powdery texture of panaloaf.

35598.name: Panaloaf Oil
35598.description: This fragrant oil will infuse freshly baked panaloaf with a delicious, savory aroma.

35599.name: Ascorbic Additive
35599.description: Extracted from coconut milk, this additive has been meticulously crafted to elevate the Mervynbread's ascorbic acid content to acceptable levels.

35626.name: Rarefied Horse Chestnut Kasa
35626.description:
Tired of carrying around an umbrella due to a chance of rain? Put this on your head instead and save yourself the trouble!

※For collectable submissions only.

35627.name: Rarefied Palm Bracelet
35627.description:
Each one of these accessories comes with a gemstone that is, as one might surmise, not made of palm.

※For collectable submissions only.

35628.name: Rarefied Red Pine Spinning Wheel
35628.description:
If this wheel keeps on turning and the red pine smells like burning, you're probably spinning it too fast.

※For collectable submissions only.

35629.name: Rarefied Ironwood Grinding Wheel
35629.description:
Not especially suitable when you have a bone to pick with someone, but the ideal implement when you have an axe to grind.

※For collectable submissions only.

35630.name: Rarefied Integral Armillae
35630.description:
Little is known about the trees from which these integral accessories are made, but that air of mystery adds to the appeal.

※For collectable submissions only.

35631.name: Rarefied High Durium Pistol
35631.description:
This firearm eschews function for fashion, covering the cylinder with an ostentatious metal plate.

※For collectable submissions only.

35632.name: Rarefied High Durium Greatsword
35632.description:
Some blade wielders believe a weapon of this caliber would be more accurately dubbed an “excellentsword,” but it's a tad cumbersome as far as names go.

※For collectable submissions only.

35633.name: Rarefied Bismuth Sledgehammer
35633.description:
This tool wants to be your sledgehammer; why don't you call its name?

※For collectable submissions only.

35634.name: Rarefied Manganese Cross-pein Hammer
35634.description:
Whoever decided “cross” would be a more easily understood substitute for “perpendicular” really hit the nail on the head.

※For collectable submissions only.

35635.name: Rarefied Chondrite Culinary Knife
35635.description:
One *could* use this utensil outside of the kitchen, but conventional wisdom advises against bringing a culinary knife to a gunlance fight.

※For collectable submissions only.

35636.name: Rarefied High Durium Knuckles
35636.description:
Some say one punch from these is all it takes to fell any foe, but only when wielded by expert pugilists.

※For collectable submissions only.

35637.name: Rarefied High Durium Kite Shield
35637.description:
Great for defending the wielder against incoming enemy attacks; not quite as great for flying on a windy day.

※For collectable submissions only.

35638.name: Rarefied Bismuth Fat Cat Frypan
35638.description:
Though this pan may be feline shaped, using it to fry a fat cat would be morally unacceptable.

※For collectable submissions only.

35639.name: Rarefied Manganese Armor of the Behemoth King
35639.description:
Perfect for edgy adventurers who want to show off their hunting prowess without sacrificing their dark and brooding image.

※For collectable submissions only.

35640.name: Rarefied Chondrite Sollerets
35640.description:
One can quite literally never go chond-wrong with a pair of these leg guards.

※For collectable submissions only.

35641.name: Rarefied High Durium Milpreves
35641.description:
A word of sage advice: never cross someone with an array of these in their possession.

※For collectable submissions only.

35642.name: Rarefied Pewter Choker
35642.description:
Do not let the name intimidate you: this accessory actually sits quite comfortably around the wearer's neck.

※For collectable submissions only.

35643.name: Rarefied Phrygian Earring
35643.description:
This syringe-shaped accessory is sure to inject one's ensemble with a touch of avant-garde style.

※For collectable submissions only.

35644.name: Rarefied Manganese Horn of the Last Unicorn
35644.description:
Watch where you point this thing: you might poke an eye out─or worse!

※For collectable submissions only.

35645.name: Rarefied Star Quartz Choker
35645.description:
Some say you can make a wish upon the gem embedded within this accessory─which is technically true─but there is no guarantee it will be granted.

※For collectable submissions only.

35646.name: Rarefied Gajaskin Shoes
35646.description:
These shoes made of gaja leather feature distinct flared collars that prioritize fashion over function─but they sure look neat!

※For collectable submissions only.

35647.name: Rarefied Luncheon Toadskin Hose
35647.description:
Some dislike the bumpy texture of these stockings, but comfort is in the legs of the beholder...or however the saying goes.

※For collectable submissions only.

35648.name: Rarefied Saigaskin Gloves
35648.description:
These hand coverings are made from the tanned hide of the snow-loving saiga. What they lack in coverage, they make up for in style.

※For collectable submissions only.

35649.name: Rarefied Kumbhiraskin Shoes
35649.description:
A durable pair of white footwear. Though slightly hidden behind the laces, the bright-red tongue adds some visual contrast.

※For collectable submissions only.

35650.name: Rarefied Ophiotauroskin Top
35650.description:
This vest features a fastener across the chest because─as all style savants know─one can never have too many belts.

※For collectable submissions only.

35651.name: Rarefied Darkhempen Hat
35651.description:
A charcoal black cap that offers excellent coverage for the top of one's head but little for anything below the brow. 

※For collectable submissions only.

35652.name: Rarefied Almasty Serge Gloves
35652.description:
These fluffy handwarmers ensure the wearer never gets frostbitten, but their black coloration means one must always be wary of potential staining.

※For collectable submissions only.

35653.name: Rarefied Snow Linen Doublet
35653.description:
Though dubbed the “doublet,” this garment performs not only two functions, but several: it offers warmth, creates a striking silhouette, supports the wearer's hose, and so forth.

※For collectable submissions only.

35654.name: Rarefied Scarlet Moko Wedge Cap
35654.description:
A neatly fitted hat with a crimson fabric lining that gives rise to the question, “Why is the inside not the outside?” and other such philosophical ruminations.

※For collectable submissions only.

35655.name: Rarefied AR-Caean Velvet Bottoms
35655.description:
Made from AR-Caean cotton, these trousers are softer to the touch than most, providing the wearer with extra lower-body comfort.

※For collectable submissions only.

35656.name: Rarefied Gajaskin Codex
35656.description:
Collecting gaja tusks is generally frowned upon, but poaching gaja for their pelts is apparently fair game.

※For collectable submissions only.

35657.name: Rarefied Luncheon Toadskin Grimoire
35657.description:
Contrary to what its name might suggest, this book is actually bound with leather made from a Sharlayan toad.

※For collectable submissions only.

35658.name: Rarefied Moon Gel
35658.description:
This supremely sticky adhesive is said to be strong enough to withstand the pull of an interstellar vacuum─which makes sense, given its place of origin.

※For collectable submissions only.

35659.name: Rarefied Enchanted Manganese Ink
35659.description:
Infused with manganese ore, this reagent boasts impressive aetherial conductivity.

※For collectable submissions only.

35660.name: Rarefied Draught
35660.description:
This delightful drink was distilled from the finest ingredients to help struggling craftsfolk get their creative juices flowing.

※For collectable submissions only.

35661.name: Rarefied Archon Loaf
35661.description:
Diners can set their hearts at rest: no sages were harmed in the making of this bread.

※For collectable submissions only.

35662.name: Rarefied King Crab Cake
35662.description:
It is unclear which is “king”─this cake or the crab from which it was made─but it tastes like royalty either way.

※For collectable submissions only.

35663.name: Rarefied Happiness Juice
35663.description:
Although this drink's name suggests a joyful experience for all who imbibe it, the only folks who will find true happiness in this bottle are those who really like carrots.

※For collectable submissions only.

35664.name: Rarefied Giant Haddock Dip
35664.description:
An ideal alternative for those particularly picky eaters who can't stand the sight of seafood but don't mind the taste.

※For collectable submissions only.

35665.name: Rarefied Giant Popoto Pancakes
35665.description:
One stack of these delectable discs is sure to fill any adventurer's belly and satisfy their sweet tooth.

※For collectable submissions only.

35793.name: Trophy of Eternal Darkness
35793.description:
An ideal conversation piece and focal point for clandestine rituals. Though it does not possess any arcane properties, it certainly looks the part.

※One per estate only.

35794.name: Trophy of Divine Light
35794.description:
A somewhat abstract imagining of the god of Light. Perhaps it is best to give it a wide berth to avoid snagging one's clothing─and eyes─on the featherlike projections.

※One per estate only.

35796.name: New World Burrito Lunch
35796.description:
One of many delicious dishes invented by inhabitants of the New World, this lunch stars a well-seasoned assortment of beans, vegetables, and meats wrapped in soft tortillas.

※Cannot be retrieved once used.
※Can be used up to 10 times.

Meal benefits when used:
  **Piety Bonus:** +4% (Max 10)
  **VIT Bonus:** +5% (Max 12)
  **Gear Durability Bonus:** +3
  **EXP Bonus:** +3%
  **Duration:** 30m
  (Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

35809.name: Garlean Concrete Inner Wall
35809.description: A cold, stark interior wall for those who fear their home is becoming a little *too* cozy.

35810.name: Varied Wood Flooring
35810.description: This style of flooring is also known as “carpenters' leftovers.”

35811.name: Leafy Ceiling Lamp
35811.description: Ceiling-mounted lighting designed to resemble a ceiling-mounted, glowing bush.

35836.name: Gold Core
35836.description: A gold core required to repair Rurusha's mysterious relic.

35838.name: Gold Connector
35838.description: A gold connector required to repair Rurusha's mysterious relic.

35840.name: Writing Utensils
35840.description: A stellar set of writing utensils.

35842.name: Starlens Wand
35842.description: A wand capable of channeling magic into the starlens.

35844.name: Golden Spice
35844.description: With this spice added into the mix, a standard curry dish is transformed into a flavorful culinary masterpiece.

35846.name: Sharlayan Fishcake Ingredient
35846.description: A key ingredient for making Sharlayan fishcakes.

35984.name: Adventure Basket
35984.description:
Because no one should have to save the world on an empty stomach.

Use item to acquire the adventure basket minion.

36011.name: Barding of Eternal Darkness
36011.description: A suit of chocobo armor that radiates Darkness.

36012.name: Barding of Divine Light
36012.description: A suit of chocobo armor that radiates Light.

36036.name: Archon Loaf
36036.description:
Baked with either fish or vegetable flour, this fluffy loaf of rye bread is─from a nutritional standpoint─wholesome indeed.

**EXP Bonus:** +3% **Duration:** 30m
(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

36037.name: Zurek
36037.description:
This filling rye soup is overflowing with soft vegetables and has a satisfyingly sour kick.

**EXP Bonus:** +3% **Duration:** 30m
(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

36038.name: Amra Salad
36038.description:
This salad, tossed with light dressing and filled with chopped amra fruit, is a sweet and savory treat.

**EXP Bonus:** +3% **Duration:** 30m
(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

36039.name: Amra Lassi
36039.description:
A blend of yoghurt and spices, this refreshing drink is infused with the mellow sweetness of the amra fruit.

**EXP Bonus:** +3% **Duration:** 30m
(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

36040.name: Island Miq'abob
36040.description:
A skewer of hamsa breast and bell peppers grilled to perfection. This recipe was brought to the islands by way of Miqo'te seafarers.

**EXP Bonus:** +3% **Duration:** 30m
(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

36041.name: King Crab Cake
36041.description:
Tender spiny king crab meat fills this crispy fried pastry which is topped with a spoonful of creamy herb-filled sauce.

**EXP Bonus:** +3% **Duration:** 30m
(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

36042.name: Ukha
36042.description:
A fish and vegetable stew popular in Garlemald. The perfect meal for a snowy night spent indoors.

**EXP Bonus:** +3% **Duration:** 30m
(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

36043.name: Borscht
36043.description:
A traditional red Garlean soup made of beetroot. Simple to cook, it is a great favorite in both civilian and military kitchens.

**EXP Bonus:** +3% **Duration:** 30m
(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

36044.name: Wine-dark Soup
36044.description:
A creamy variety of beet soup─though no self-respecting Sharlayan would ever utilize such vulgar nomenclature. *Ever.*

**EXP Bonus:** +3% **Duration:** 30m
(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

36045.name: Glory Be Soup
36045.description:
This stew, consisting of lentils and chestnuts boiled in red wine, derives its name from Garlean soldiers singing the praises of Emperor Solus, who shared a warm meal with them after a round of military exercises one chilly night.

**EXP Bonus:** +3% **Duration:** 30m
(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

36046.name: Happiness Juice
36046.description:
This uniquely sweet drink consists of an entire squeezed carrot, along with an assortment of other scrumptious additions to give it a kick.

**EXP Bonus:** +3% **Duration:** 30m
(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

36047.name: Carrot Nibbles
36047.description:
Ribbons of thinly sliced carrots of happiness dressed with vinegar make for a healthful and blissfully refreshing dish.

**EXP Bonus:** +3% **Duration:** 30m
(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

36048.name: Hamsa Curry
36048.description:
A Radz–at–Han staple consisting of hamsa breast stewed to perfection in a spice-rich sauce.

**EXP Bonus:** +3% **Duration:** 30m
(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

36049.name: Karniyarik
36049.description:
Topped with a single slice of tomato, this baked stuffed eggplant is positively bursting with hamsa meat and rich spices.

**EXP Bonus:** +3% **Duration:** 30m
(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

36050.name: Spicy Shakshouka
36050.description:
A hearty and delicious dish for any mealtime, its base is a flavorful, rich tomato sauce filled with potent spices, in which an egg has been perfectly poached.

**EXP Bonus:** +3% **Duration:** 30m
(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

36051.name: Lentil Curry
36051.description:
A dish that combines lentils with a sumptuous blend of spices in a silky coconut milk stew.

**EXP Bonus:** +3% **Duration:** 30m
(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

36052.name: Skyr
36052.description:
A dairy dish created through a special Sharlayan fermentation process passed down for generations. 

**EXP Bonus:** +3% **Duration:** 30m
(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

36053.name: Giant Haddock Dip
36053.description:
A delectable dip made from a mixture of fish roe and mashed giant popoto.

**EXP Bonus:** +3% **Duration:** 30m
(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

36054.name: Yakow Moussaka
36054.description:
A Near Eastern dish that takes yakow meat and eggplant and bakes them into a gratin.

**EXP Bonus:** +3% **Duration:** 30m
(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

36055.name: Philosopher's Sandwich
36055.description:
Perfectly nutritionally balanced, this handheld dish is a busy Sharlayan researcher's best friend.

**EXP Bonus:** +3% **Duration:** 30m
(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

36056.name: Salted Thavnairian Cod
36056.description:
A whole shallows cod, broiled and sprinkled with salt to bring out its fishy flavor.

**EXP Bonus:** +3% **Duration:** 30m
(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

36057.name: Coconut Cod Chowder
36057.description:
A Near Eastern soup, brimming with shallows cod simmered in silky coconut milk.

**EXP Bonus:** +3% **Duration:** 30m
(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

36058.name: The Noodles of Elpis
36058.description:
A creamy, cheesy pasta dish topped off with a decadent bird of Elpis egg.

**EXP Bonus:** +3% **Duration:** 30m
(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

36059.name: Giant Popoto Pancakes
36059.description:
Giant popotoes are mashed, mixed with eggs, then cooked to create these light and fluffy treats.

**EXP Bonus:** +3% **Duration:** 30m
(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

36060.name: Tsai tou Vounou
36060.description:
A herbal drink with impressive medicinal properties. Sometimes called “mountain tea.”

**EXP Bonus:** +3% **Duration:** 30m
(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

36061.name: Sideritis Cookie
36061.description:
A baked treat that gives off a sweet, herbal aroma.

**EXP Bonus:** +3% **Duration:** 30m
(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

36062.name: Elpis Deipnon
36062.description:
This hearty dish takes ground bird of Elpis meat and sears it to tender, juicy perfection.

**EXP Bonus:** +3% **Duration:** 30m
(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

36063.name: Baked Alien Soup
36063.description:
Alien onions are sautéed, simmered in a savory bouillon, then topped with crispy cheese for a simple yet satisfying meal.

**EXP Bonus:** +3% **Duration:** 30m
(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

36064.name: Sykon Salad
36064.description:
The sykon serves as the star of this fruit-filled dish, complex and nutritious.

**EXP Bonus:** +3% **Duration:** 30m
(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

36065.name: Sykon Compote
36065.description:
Sykon are boiled in sugar water to create these sweet, bite-sized treats.

**EXP Bonus:** +3% **Duration:** 30m
(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

36066.name: Sykon Bavarois
36066.description:
Sliced sykon floats atop a fluffy bed of chilled gelatin in this tasty dessert.

**EXP Bonus:** +3% **Duration:** 30m

38674.description: Adopt the modest─yet still somehow incredibly expensive─style of the Leveilleur estate walls.

38758.description: A piece crafted to satisfy the discerning eye of an avid collector. The wind will find no gaps to whistle through with this perfectly fitted portal.

38759.description: A piece crafted to satisfy the discerning eye of an avid collector. Its flawless surface faithfully reflects the truth, fair or foul.

38760.description: A piece crafted to satisfy the discerning eye of an avid collector. No toes will ever feel a chill through this thick, luxurious rug.

38764.description: A piece crafted to satisfy the discerning eye of an avid collector. Each note sounds with a delightfully deep and resonant timbre.

38765.description: A device crafted to satisfy the discerning tongue of an avid gourmet. Draws forth every last onze of flavorful goodness from the bean.

38766.description: A piece crafted to satisfy the discerning eye of an avid collector, as well as the most particular of posteriors.

38768.description: A piece crafted to satisfy the discerning eye of an avid collector. So dreamily soft and comfortable, it should come with a warning.

38769.description: A piece crafted to satisfy the discerning eye of an avid collector. To walk down this elegant stretch of scarlet is to feel the glow of success─whether it was earned or not.

38770.description: A piece crafted to satisfy the discerning eye of an avid collector. Rather more costly than the typical specimen in a jam jar collection.

38771.description: A dessert concocted to satisfy the discerning tongue of an avid gourmet. One nibble is enough to fall under the spell of this tart's fae enchantment.

38817.name: Classic Voeburtite Cuisine
38817.description: A steaming pot of homemade cooking to fill the stomach and warm the cockles.

38818.description: This expertly crafted statue reflects what the Voeburtite people truly valued: sheep.

38819.description: This gift bursting with charming objects is said to be wildly popular amongst pixies. Funnily enough, the ones saying this are also pixies.

38843.name: Musicking Station Component
38843.description:
This soon-to-be element of Dreamingway's dream stage has been carefully crafted to prevent injury to frolicking Loporrits.

※Only for use in Loporrit society quests.

38845.description:
These handcrafted items─provided in bulk─will hopefully result in the creation of inventive machines without any Loporrits being harmed in the process.

※Only for use in Loporrit society quests.

Supplies indispensable to the sophisticated and sanitary serving of cuisine.

※Only for use in Loporrit society quests.

Judging by the requested volume, Loporrits really go through art supplies.

※Only for use in Loporrit society quests.

Delicate supplies for the broadcasting station, carefully packaged so as to sustain minimal damage from inevitable Loporrit excitement.

※Only for use in Loporrit society quests.

38853.description:
Useful parts for Loporrits who prefer surround sound.

※Only for use in Loporrit society quests.

─Pipingway

※Only for use in Loporrit society quests.

※Only for use in Loporrit society quests.

※Only for use in Loporrit society quests.

※Only for use in Loporrit society quests.

※Only for use in Loporrit society quests.

※Only for use in Loporrit society quests.

38868.name: Parasital Infection Protection Suit Component Materials

※Only for use in Loporrit society quests.

※Only for use in Loporrit society quests.

At the rate his cookbooks are being printed, Cookingway's authorial exploits may soon eclipse his culinary achievements.

※Only for use in Loporrit society quests.

38875.description:
This component will serve to repair the cooking station's cherished carrot chiller─until it inevitably breaks down again.

※Only for use in Loporrit society quests.

※Only for use in Loporrit society quests.

※Only for use in Loporrit society quests.

39783.name: Connoisseur's Escutcheon

39784.name: Connoisseur's Baghnakhs

39785.name: Connoisseur's Drinking Apkallu
39785.description: A piece crafted to satisfy the discerning eye of an avid collector. The apkallu's unquenchable thirst mirrors the insatiable desires of its destined owner.

39786.name: Connoisseur's Jacket
39786.description: An outerwear set tailored to satisfy the discerning eye of an avid collector, as well as the glazed eye of any fellow attendee at belabored ceremonies.

39787.name: Connoisseur's Planter Partition
39787.description: A piece crafted to satisfy the discerning eye of an avid collector. When gazing upon it, one can almost hear a faint “la-hee” in the distance.

**EXP Bonus:** +3% **Duration:** 30m
(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

Mashed dragonfruit is blended together with cloud banana and coconut milk to create this creamy, refreshing drink.

**EXP Bonus:** +3% **Duration:** 30m
(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

39871.name: Baba Ghanoush
39871.description:

(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

39872.name: Baked Eggplant

**EXP Bonus:** +3% **Duration:** 30m

39873.name: Spicy Stellar Soup

Simmered with diced alien onions and carrots of happiness aplenty, this stellar soup's flavor is quite literally out of this world.

**EXP Bonus:** +3% **Duration:** 30m
(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

39874.name: Tandoori Raptor
39874.description:
A Near Eastern staple consisting of tender chunks of baked raptor meat marinated in mouthwatering spices and creamy yoghurt.

**EXP Bonus:** +3% **Duration:** 30m
(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

39875.name: Caviar Sandwich
39875.description:
Its every bite extraordinary enough to render one speechless, this sandwich incorporates eggs from the caviar sturgeon and bird of Elpis both. Given the further inclusion of alligator pear slices, one cannot help but wonder at its inventor's obvious preference for ovoid foodstuffs.

**EXP Bonus:** +3% **Duration:** 30m
(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

(Duration can be extended to 60m by consuming multiple servings)

39877.name: Marinated Broccoflower

39878.name: Broccoflower Stew
39878.description:
Broccoflower slices boiled in a savory broth alongside tender poultry and root vegetables.

**EXP Bonus:** +3% **Duration:** 30m

This statue emanates the menace of a deadly undertow.

※One per estate only.

It is uncertain what is on display here: the greatsword, or the shadowy energies which crackle and writhe along its length.

40679.name: Ornate Fountain

40758.name: Suzaku Sculpture
40758.description: An imposing rendition of the fiery auspice Suzaku. Place southward for best results.

41057.name: Abyssal Barding

41063.description: A set of soft and profoundly healing pillows ideal for relieving back pain.

41064.description: This apparatus has been guaranteed by science to entertain cats. Whether cats care to entertain the notion of said science, however, is another matter entirely.

41065.description: A carefully handcrafted replication of a monstrous creature. The longer you stare at it, the longer it stares at you...

41066.description: Apply directly to the eyeball for optimal exhaustion relief. If you experience side effects such as loss of vision, dizziness, nausea, or death, stop use immediately and seek the counsel of your nearest chirurgeon.

41067.name: Researcher's Relaxation Kit
41067.description: A delightful box brimming with relaxation implements of notable quality.

41082.name: Fern Interior Wall
41082.description: An interior wall delicately stenciled with a cascading leafy design.

41083.name: Greige Carpet
41083.description: For the ambivalent designer who cannot commit to grey or beige. Guaranteed unremarkable!

41084.name: Seabed Ceiling Lamp
41084.description: Simply install this light fixture to be immersed in the magic of the deep. Unsettling fish sold separately by popular request.

41086.name: Abyssal Wings Display
41086.description:
A sculpture incorporating several of Zeromus's key features, the power to destroy life as we know it thankfully not among them.

※One per estate only.

41087.name: Crystarium Wall Canopy
41087.description: An elegant fixture reminiscent of Crystarium sensibilities.

41088.name: Nursery Canopy
41088.description: Lounge like a highborn tot with this elegant and cozy nursery canopy.

41089.name: Ronkan Fireplace
41089.description: A solid stone hearth rendered in the Ronkan architectural style.

41090.name: Tomestool
41090.description: Features a nook beneath the seat for all manner of tomes, dusty or otherwise.

41092.description: This rounded screen designed to resemble the heavens above is a must-have for astrologians, astrologists, astronomers, and whoever decides to prefix their vocation with “astro” next.

41094.name: Imitation Trapdoor
41094.description: All of the excitement of a true trapdoor, with none of the deadly pits below.

41095.name: Manderville's Adventurer Flakes

Manderville & Manderville's lovingly crafted Manderville's Adventurer Flakes (Manderville Mark Certified) supplement the diets of growing adventurers with the nutrients they need, while providing the convenience and non-perishability they crave. Now with flavor!

Appearing as though it came straight from a Garlean castrum, one would be forgiven for attempting to maintain magitek armor with this repair station.
* Not an actual repair station; cannot be used in the maintenance of magitek armor.

41145.name: Labyrinthos Grape Lamppost
41145.description: Seeking to make grapes more transportable, a researcher at Meryall Agronomics is rumored to have produced a variety that grew in blocky clusters. Although complaints that they looked unappetizing led to a new strain with rounder edges, the original was regarded fondly by some, and so it was immortalized in the form of this lamppost.

41147.name: Sharlayan Reflecting Pool
41147.description: A shallow decorative pool constructed in accordance with Sharlayan sensibilities.

41254.name: Connoisseur's Bamboo Fence
41254.description: A piece crafted to satisfy the discerning eye of an avid collector. Though the Far Eastern regions of the First were lost to the Flood, this priceless hedge carries on its legacy.

41255.name: Connoisseur's Rousing Chronometer
41255.description: A piece crafted to satisfy the discerning eye of an avid collector. Even the heaviest of sleepers will wake up to this chronometer's clarion call.

41256.description: A piece crafted to satisfy the discerning eye of an avid collector. Its melodious timbre will soothe the souls of all who hear it...unless the souls in question are standing directly in front of it.

41257.name: Connoisseur's Washbasin
41257.description: A piece crafted to satisfy the discerning eye of an avid collector. This immaculately sculpted basin dispenses only the finest artisanal water, presumably for washing the finest artisanal faces.

41258.name: Connoisseur's Targe
41258.description: A piece crafted to satisfy the discerning eye of an avid collector. The patterns carved into it are so painstakingly detailed, it may be more suited to a gallery than a battlefield.

41259.name: Connoisseur's Petasos
41259.description: A piece crafted to satisfy the discerning eye of an avid collector. Stitched with care, this hat was made with mages in mind.

41260.name: Connoisseur's Lunar Curtain
41260.description: A reagent crafted to satisfy the discerning eye of an avid collector. Though this powder can supposedly resist formidable magicks and repel otherworldly flares, it can also be imbibed to reduce bouts of morning drowsiness.

41261.name: Connoisseur's Crab Cakes
41261.description: A meal concocted to satisfy the discerning tongue of an avid gourmet. Under the golden brown crust of this entrée lies a savory-yet-fluffy crab filling that could win over the pickiest of eaters.

41262.description: A piece crafted to satisfy the discerning eye of an avid collector. Eulmoran elites would pay unthinkable sums of coin for this relic of lands long lost.

41263.description: A piece crafted to satisfy the discerning eye of an avid collector. Ringing the bell several times in a row may attract itinerant pixies.

41264.name: Connoisseur's Marching Horn
41264.description: A piece crafted to satisfy the discerning eye of an avid collector. The rich, baritone notes that echo from its bell must be heard to be believed.

41265.description: A piece crafted to satisfy the discerning eye of an avid collector. Why build a fountain from any old stone when it could be marble-ous instead?

41266.name: Connoisseur's Leather Jacket
41266.description: A piece crafted to satisfy the discerning eye of an avid collector. Despite its antique appearance, the leather is durable enough to withstand all manner of inclement weather.

41267.name: Connoisseur's Fat Cat Sofa
41267.description: A piece crafted to satisfy the discerning eye of an avid collector. Few can resist its charmingly cozy cushioning.

41268.name: Connoisseur's Tincture of Vitality
41268.description: A reagent crafted to satisfy the discerning eye of an avid collector. Drinking this concoction allegedly promotes growth. Allegedly.

41269.name: Connoisseur's Chili Crab
41269.description: A meal concocted to satisfy the discerning tongue of an avid gourmet. The tender crab flesh has been spiced to perfection, providing an intense heat while complementing the dish's milder flavors.
